instructions: Blend almond milk, banana, strawberries, ice cubes, protein powder, vanilla extract, honey, ground flax seeds, ground chia seeds, and cinnamon in a blender until smooth.

3622.title: Purple Power Punch Smoothie (My Kids' Fave)
3622.description: This kid-pleasing power smoothie made with strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, and raspberries is sure to become your go-to smoothie of choice.
ingredients: 0.5 cup nonfat vanilla yogurt (such as Dannon® Light and Fit®)
3 tablespoons turbinado sugar (such as Sugar in the Raw®)
instructions: Pulse yogurt, strawberries, water, powdered milk, banana, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, and protein powder together in a blender until well-mixed. Add ice, sugar, and honey and blend until smooth.

3623.title: Morning Energy Booster Smoothie
3623.description: Prune juice, yogurt, berries, and flax seed are blended together creating an energy-boosting smoothie to start your day off right.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh spinach, or to taste
1 cup frozen blueberries, or to taste
instructions: Pour prune juice into a blender. Layer Greek yogurt, spinach, blueberries, strawberries, peach, and flax seeds in the blender, in this order. Start blender on low speed and gradually increase speed until smoothie is well blended.

3624.title: PBnJ "Workday" Smoothie
3624.description: Peanut butter, strawberries, yogurt, and banana are blended together creating a pb and j smoothie perfect for on-the-go meals for weekdays.
instructions: Place strawberries, banana, water, and yogurt in a blender; blend until smooth, gradually adding more water if a thinner smoothie is desired. Add peanut butter blend until smooth.

3625.title: Skinny Vegan Green Smoothie
3625.description: This skinny vegan green smoothie is the perfect start in the day with unsweetened almond milk, strawberries, banana, and 2 cups of fresh spinach!
instructions: Combine spinach, strawberries, banana, almond milk, and agave in a blender; blend until smooth.

3626.title: Summer Sweet Smoothies
3626.description: Fresh fruit blends with cranberry juice for a quick and sweet summertime smoothie.
instructions: Process the cranberry juice, strawberries, blueberries, watermelon, banana, and figs in a blender until smooth and creamy. Enjoy immediately or keep cool in refrigerator.

3627.title: Strawberry Sensation Smoothie
3627.description: Strawberry and orange flavors will be sure to perk up your morning!
instructions: Blend the strawberries, orange pieces, apple juice, vanilla yogurt, and almonds together in a blender until smooth.

3628.title: Healthy Strawberry Smoothie
3628.description: This strawberry smoothie made with oats, yogurt, and banana is a great on-the-go meal made with a Nutribullet® or blender.
instructions: Blend almond milk, banana, strawberries, yogurt, oats, and almonds together in a NutriBullet® or blender until smooth.

3629.title: Mango-Strawberry Smoothie with Yogurt
3629.description: A quick and easy mango strawberry smoothie made with nonfat vanilla yogurt. Great for an after-workout snack or just to enjoy on a hot day!
instructions: Combine mango, strawberries, and apple juice in a blender. Place ice over the fruit and pour in yogurt. Blend on high speed until smooth. Pour into a glass.

3630.title: Easy Paradise Smoothie
3630.description: Pineapple, strawberries, coconut, and a hint of vanilla give this smoothie the refreshing taste of paradise.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) can pineapple in juice, chilled
1 (15 ounce) can cream of coconut (such as Coco Lopez®)
instructions: Blend pineapple, strawberries, cream of coconut, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth.

3631.title: Backyard Berry Bowl
3631.description: A berry smoothie is topped with more berries, banana, and granola in this quick and easy smoothie bowl.
ingredients: 1 cup ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Blend ice, 1/2 cup strawberries, 1 banana, blackberries, and apple juice together in a blender until smooth, adding more ice depending on your desired consistency. Pour smoothie into a bowl.
Top smoothie with remaining strawberries, remaining banana, blueberries, and granola. Drizzle honey over the top.

3632.title: Watermelon Strawberry Mango Lemonade Smoothie
3632.description: Watermelon, strawberries, and mango are blended a good amount of lemon juice creating a sweet and tasty on-the-go lemonade smoothie.
instructions: Blend watermelon, water, strawberries, mango, sugar, and lemon juice in a blender until smooth, about 5 minutes.

3633.title: Strawberry Peach Smoothie from Yoplait®
3633.description: A creamy, peach and orange smoothie is layered on top of a strawberry smoothie--pretty as a picture and oh so delicious.
ingredients: 1 (5.3 ounce) container Yoplait® Greek 100 Vanilla Yogurt, divided
instructions: Combine the strawberries, half the banana, 1/2 container of yogurt, milk and honey (if using) in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into 2 glasses and rinse out the blender.
Combine the remaining half the banana, remaining yogurt, peaches and orange juice in the blender and blend until smooth. Pour over the strawberry smoothie layer and serve.

3634.title: Ginger Berry Smoothie
3634.description: This invigorating smoothie made with strawberries, blueberries, and agave gets and extra kick from fresh ginger.
ingredients: 1 cup water, or more as needed
4 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
1 (1 inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Blend water, blueberries, strawberries, ginger, and agave nectar together in a blender until thick and smooth.

3635.title: Chocolate-Covered Strawberry Smoothie
3635.description: Ovaltine® is the secret ingredient in this chocolate-covered strawberry smoothie that is perfect for breakfast or as an anytime snack!
ingredients: 6 tablespoons powdered chocolate-flavored malt drink mix (such as Ovaltine®)
instructions: Blend milk, strawberries, yogurt, chocolate-flavored malt drink mix, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth.

3636.title: Strawberry-Pineapple Smoothie II
3636.description: Delicious and refreshing smoothie full of flavor!
instructions: Pour the apple juice and pineapple into a blender; add the yogurt, pineapple chunks, and frozen strawberries and blend until smooth.

3637.title: Ultimate Fruit Smoothie
3637.description: Milk, orange juice, strawberries, mango, peach, and pineapple combine to make this delightful smoothie that has a little tang with dash of sweet.
ingredients: 0.5 mango - peeled, seeded, and cut into chunks
0.5 fresh peach - peeled, pitted, and sliced
instructions: Blend milk, orange juice, mango, peach, pineapple, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3638.title: Chocolate, Strawberry, and Banana Smoothie
3638.description: Chia seeds, flax seed, chocolate soy milk, and plain yogurt are the base for this smoothie with bananas and strawberries.
instructions: Blend soy milk, yogurt, bananas, strawberries, flax seed, and chia seeds in a blender until smooth.

3639.title: Gordon's Berry Breakfast Drink
3639.description: This berry drink recipe makes an easy and satisfying breakfast-on-the-go and is equally wonderful served as a part of a sit down breakfast or brunch. Blend frozen blueberries and strawberries with juice, yogurt, and bananas to make this colorful and tasty drink.
instructions: Place the orange juice, pineapple juice, yogurt, blueberries, strawberries, and bananas into a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. The berry drink will be very thick. Serve immediately.

3640.title: Nobody's Strawberry Watermelon Shakedown
3640.description: Frozen strawberries and watermelon take a spin in the blender with cream, yogurt, and orange juice for a sensational summer smoothie! Serve with a slice of fresh watermelon, or a dollop of whipped cream!
instructions: Blend the strawberries, watermelon, cream, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, and vanilla in a blender until smooth.

3641.title: Banana Banana Strawberry Smoothie
3641.description: Banana extract provides this smoothie with a double dose of fruit flavor!
instructions: Place banana, banana extract, milk, yogurt, and sugar into a blender. Blend until smooth and serve.

3642.title: California Smoothie
3642.description: Strawberries are frozen, then blended with lemon yogurt and orange juice.
instructions: Place strawberries in a plastic container and freeze for about an hour.
In a blender, combine frozen strawberries, yogurt and orange juice. Blend until smooth. Pour into a tall glass and serve.

3643.title: Strawberry Peach Smoothie
3643.description: Fresh peaches and strawberries perk up an ice-cold smoothie made with vanilla ice cream and soy milk. It's great on a hot day.
instructions: Pour soy milk into a blender and add vanilla ice cream, frozen strawberries, fresh strawberries, and peach slices. Blend until smooth and pour into a large glass.

3644.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
3644.description: This peanut butter banana smoothie requires just 4 ingredients and a blender to prepare and enjoy for a sweet on-the-go breakfast or snack.
instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Place bananas, milk, peanut butter, honey, and ice cubes in a blender; blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3645.title: Chocolate Banana Peanut Butter Protein Shake
3645.description: This chocolate protein shake is creamy, filling, and quickly made in a blender with banana, protein powder, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and honey.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice cubes, milk, banana, protein powder, peanut butter, honey, and cocoa powder together in a blender until smooth.

3646.title: Fruit and Yogurt Smoothie
3646.description: This yogurt smoothie recipe blends strawberries, banana, pineapple juice, orange juice, and plain yogurt together for a delicious, refreshing drink.
instructions: Combine strawberries, banana, yogurt, pineapple juice, sugar, orange juice, and milk in a blender; blend until smooth.

3647.title: Strawberry Oatmeal Breakfast Smoothie
3647.description: This oatmeal smoothie has a deep pink color and a rich, creamy texture. It's fast, filling, and delicious — perfect for a quick on-the-go breakfast!
instructions: Blend soy milk, oats, strawberries, and banana in a blender until smooth. Add sugar and vanilla and blend again until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve.

3648.title: Spinach and Banana Power Smoothie
3648.description: This vegan banana spinach smoothie provides a dairy-free and protein-rich pick-me-up that tastes delicious. It's easy to blend and take anywhere.
instructions: Blend soy milk and spinach together in a blender until smooth. Add banana and pulse until thoroughly blended.

3649.title: Basic Fruit Smoothie
3649.description: A tasty fruit smoothie recipe with strawberries, banana, peaches, fruit juice, and ice. Feel free to experiment with your favorite fruits!
ingredients: 2 fresh peaches - peeled, pitted, and sliced
instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Combine strawberries, peaches, and banana in a blender; blend until smooth.
Add ice and pour in juice; blend again to desired consistency.

3650.title: Pineapple and Banana Smoothie
3650.description: This pineapple smoothie with banana is quick, tropical, fruity goodness with just four ingredients. Easily blend together and your smoothie is served.
ingredients: 0.25 fresh pineapple - peeled, cored and cubed
instructions: Place ice cubes, pineapple, banana, and pineapple juice into the container of a blender. Puree on high until smooth.

3651.title: Easy Mango Banana Smoothie
3651.description: This fresh mango banana smoothie made with milk and vanilla yogurt makes a quick, easy, and deliciously creamy breakfast or mid-afternoon snack.
instructions: Combine mangos, banana, vanilla yogurt, and milk in a blender; blend until smooth.

3652.title: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
3652.description: This balanced strawberry banana protein smoothie is easy to make with banana, strawberries, almonds, and protein powder; great for after a workout.
instructions: Place strawberries, banana, almonds, and water into a blender; blend to combine. Add ice cubes and puree until smooth. Add protein powder and mix until evenly incorporated, about 30 seconds.

3653.title: Strawberry Orange Banana Smoothie
3653.description: This orange juice smoothie with strawberries and banana is a delicious source of antioxidants, fiber, potassium, and vitamin C, ready in 5 minutes.
ingredients: 1 cup ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Blend strawberries, orange juice, banana, and ice in a blender until smooth and frothy.

3654.title: Healthy Chocolate Smoothie
3654.description: This chocolate smoothie uses bananas, peanut butter, milk, vanilla, and cocoa for a healthy, kid-friendly beverage perfect for breakfast or a snack.
instructions: Combine bananas, milk, ice cubes, cocoa powder, peanut butter, and vanilla in a blender; blend on high speed until smooth. Pour into 2 glasses.

3655.title: Kale and Banana Smoothie
3655.description: This kale smoothie with banana is perfect to help get your daily fruits and veggies. Nutrient-rich kale is mixed in with this tasty, easy smoothie.
instructions: Place kale, banana, soy milk, flax seeds, and maple syrup into a blender. Cover and purée until smooth. Serve over ice.

3656.title: Banana, Avocado, and Spinach Smoothie
3656.description: This banana, avocado, and spinach smoothie recipe makes a quick and easy breakfast or snack that is perfect for a healthy, delicious meal on-the-go.
instructions: Blend banana, avocado, spinach, milk, ice cubes, honey, and vanilla together in a blender until smooth.

3657.title: The Best Post-Workout Shake
3657.description: This is the best post-workout protein shake. Made with almond milk, banana, whey protein powder, frozen berries, and peanut butter, it's a delicious treat.
instructions: Layer protein powder, flax meal, cocoa powder, and brown sugar in a blender. Add almond milk, frozen berries, banana, and peanut butter. Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

3658.title: Kiwi Strawberry Smoothie
3658.description: This kiwi strawberry smoothie is easy to make with pineapple and orange juice, vanilla frozen yogurt, and banana for a tropical, fruity quencher.
ingredients: 0.75 cup pineapple and orange juice blend
instructions: Place juice blend, frozen yogurt, banana, strawberries, and kiwi into a blender. Blend until smooth and pour into 2 glasses.

3659.title: Orange Banana Smoothie
3659.description: A delightful blend of orange and banana - filling enough to have as a breakfast!
instructions: In a blender, combine milk, oranges, banana, sugar, salt and yogurt. Blend for about 1 minute. Insert ice cubes, and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3660.title: Strawberry Banana Protein Shake
3660.description: This strawberry banana protein powder shake is made with skim milk and natural peanut butter for a great post-workout meal or on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer milk, protein powder, ice, strawberries, banana, and peanut butter in a blender in this order; blend until creamy and smooth.

3661.title: Blueberry, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3661.description: This is a perfect peanut butter and berry smoothie to start your day or enjoy as a snack. Flax gives a boost to this recipe. It's kid-friendly too!
instructions: Put flaxseed meal into a blender to grind and further break down.
Place banana, milk, blueberries, yogurt, peanut butter, and honey into the blender. Cover and purée until smooth.
Pour into glasses to serve.

3662.title: Strawberry-Banana-Peanut Butter Smoothie
3662.description: This creamy treat has protein and no added sugar for a yummy breakfast or dessert!
instructions: Place yogurt, peanut butter, banana, strawberries, and ice cubes into a blender. Puree until smooth.

3663.title: Healthy Cocoa, Banana, PB Smoothie
3663.description: This cocoa, banana, and peanut butter smoothie is loaded with protein to keep you going on the morning or post-workout.
ingredients: 0.5 chopped frozen banana, or more to taste
instructions: Blend milk, banana, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and honey together in a blender until smooth.

3664.title: Apple Banana Smoothie
3664.description: Thick and healthy fruit drink with apple, banana and orange juice. The frozen banana takes the place of shaved ice and results in a smooth, creamy texture. Serve with dollop of whipped cream for added effect.
ingredients: 1 Gala apple, peeled, cored and chopped
instructions: In a blender combine frozen banana, orange juice, apple and milk. Blend until smooth. pour into glasses and serve.

3665.title: Flax Seed Smoothie
3665.description: This flaxseed smoothie combines frozen strawberries, banana, soy milk, and flaxseed meal to create a dairy-free smoothie that's perfect for on-the-go.
ingredients: 0.5 frozen banana, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Place soy milk, strawberries, banana, and flaxseed meal into a blender; blend until smooth.

3666.title: Peach Banana Smoothie
3666.description: Canned peaches, bananas, yogurt, and orange juice deliver a delicious smoothie in mere minutes.
ingredients: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Blend yogurt, peaches, bananas, orange juice, sugar, and ice in a blender on high until the ice is crushed and the smoothie is to your desired consistency.

3667.title: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
3667.description: This delicious banana peanut butter smoothie is made with powdered peanut butter, cocoa, and a touch of cinnamon.
instructions: Blend almond milk, banana, ice, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and cinnamon together in a blender until smooth.

3668.title: Green Monster Smoothie
3668.description: Banana, spinach, and peanut butter blend with yogurt and milk for a power-packed smoothie.
instructions: Blend milk, yogurt, banana, peanut butter, spinach, and ice cubes until smooth.

3669.title: All-Fruit Smoothies
3669.description: There's nothing in this smoothie except pineapple juice, banana, and frozen strawberries and blueberries. It's smooth, frosty, and dairy-free.
instructions: Pour pineapple juice into a blender and add banana, strawberries, and blueberries. Cover and blend until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour into 2 glasses.

3670.title: Nectarine Sunshine Smoothie
3670.description: Enjoy the brief, sweet season of fresh nectarines with this delicious smoothie.
ingredients: 1 banana, cut into pieces and frozen
instructions: Place the nectarines, frozen banana chunks, orange, vanilla yogurt, orange juice, and honey into a blender, and blend until smooth.

3671.title: Banana Smoothie I
3671.description: A smooth drink that is a meal in itself. Banana, milk and a nice raw egg - all topped off with a pinch of cinnamon. This recipe contains raw eggs. We recommend that pregnant women, young children, the elderly and the infirm do not consume raw eggs.
instructions: In a blender, combine banana, milk, vanilla, egg and sugar. Blend until smooth. Pour into a tall glass and top with a pinch of cinnamon.

3672.title: Banana Lassi
3672.description: If you don't have any mango on hand, why not substitute in a banana to make a creamy banana lassi to go with your Indian food?
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup milk, or more to taste
instructions: Blend bananas, yogurt, milk, ice cubes, and sugar together in a blender until smooth.

3673.title: Raspberry Blackberry Smoothie
3673.description: A quick and delicious smoothie made with raspberries, blackberries, bananas and yogurt.
instructions: Place banana, blackberries, raspberries, yogurt, honey, and ice cubes into a blender. Blend until smooth.

3674.title: Bananerberry Smoothie
3674.description: Strawberries, bananas, peaches, and apples blended with vanilla ice cream for a delightful fruit smoothie.
instructions: In a blender combine strawberries, banana, peaches, apples, and ice cream. Blend until smooth. Add ice, pour in milk and blend again until smooth. Serve immediately.

3675.title: Breakfast Banana Green Smoothie
3675.description: Spinach, banana, and carrot provide a wealth of nutrients to this smoothie recipe for a quick breakfast option when adjusting to your back-to-school schedule!
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach leaves, or to taste
1 carrot, peeled and cut into large chunks
0.75 cup plain fat-free Greek yogurt, or to taste
instructions: Put spinach, banana, carrot, yogurt, ice, and honey in a blender; blend until smooth.

3676.title: Cranberry Smoothie
3676.description: Cranberries add a fresh and fall-like flavor to this easy, almond milk-based smoothie.
instructions: Blend almond milk, banana, mixed berries, and cranberries in a blender until smooth; refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.

3677.title: Fresh Grapefruit Juice Smoothie
3677.description: Whip up this tangy-sweet smoothie in minutes using freshly squeezed red grapefruit juice, strawberries, bananas, yogurt, and honey for a refreshing drink.
instructions: Place the grapefruit juice, strawberries, bananas, yogurt, honey, and ice into a blender. Cover, and blend until smooth.

3678.title: Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
3678.description: A blueberry and banana smoothie is topped with coconut and almonds in this quick and easy blueberry smoothie bowl recipe.
instructions: Blend blueberries, 1/2 banana, water, cashew butter, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl.
Top smoothie with sliced banana, almonds, and coconut.

3679.title: Fig Smoothie
3679.description: Sticky, sweet fresh figs are a delightful addition to the morning smoothie.
instructions: Place the bananas, figs, milk, and orange juice into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth. Pour into glasses to serve.

3680.title: Chocolate Banana Smoothie
3680.description: A quick, cool, tasty treat, perfect for a hot summer day!
instructions: In a blender, combine banana, chocolate syrup, milk and crushed ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3681.title: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
3681.description: In addition to the fruit, this smoothie also has vanilla yogurt, wheat germ, and honey for the best strawberry banana smoothie recipe.
instructions: Combine yogurt, bananas, strawberries, wheat germ, and honey in a blender; blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

3682.title: Strawberry Banana Nutella Smoothie
3682.description: Enjoy strawberries, banana, and your favorite chocolate-hazelnut spread together in smoothie-form!
instructions: Blend milk, yogurt, banana, strawberries, and chocolate-hazelnut spread together in a blender until smooth.

3683.title: Kiwi Banana Apple Smoothie
3683.description: This kiwi, banana, apple smoothie is made hearty with chia seeds and maca powder added to the mix for a quick and easy, on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Blend apple, banana, kiwifruit, milk, ice, chia seeds, and maca powder together in a blender until smooth.

3684.title: Sweet Potato and Banana Smoothie
3684.description: Sweet potato and banana are blended together with soy milk and cinnamon for a creamy and colorful sweet potato smoothie.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake sweet potato in the preheated oven until tender and cooked through, about 1 hour. Remove skin, then cool in the refrigerator 8 hours to overnight.
Blend sweet potato, banana, soy milk, and cinnamon together in a blender until smooth.

3685.title: Peanut Butter and Banana Smoothie
3685.description: Like a peanut butter and banana sandwich in liquid form. Makes a nice thick breakfast smoothie.
instructions: In a blender, combine banana, peanut butter and soy milk. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and drizzle with honey for garnish.

3686.title: Milk Banana Smoothie
3686.description: Milk, bananas, and a pinch of sweetener are all you need for this creamy, smooth drink.
ingredients: 5 (1 gram) packets low calorie granulated sugar substitute (such as Sweet 'n Low®)
instructions: Blend milk, bananas, and sugar substitute in a blender or food processor until smooth.

3687.title: Strawberry-Yogurt Shake
3687.description: Strawberries, bananas, yogurt and ice are all you need in your blender for this refreshing, ice-cold treat.
instructions: Blend strawberries, bananas, half of the ice cubes, and yogurt in a blender on high until smooth. Add the remaining ice and blend further until smooth again. Serve immediately.

3688.title: Banana Avocado Yogurt Smoothie
3688.description: This quick and easy banana avocado yogurt smoothie has no added sugar and is a guaranteed hit with the kids. Simply blend the ingredients together.
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat Greek yogurt (such as Chobani®)
instructions: Place yogurt, avocado, and banana in a blender and purée until smooth. Add water for a thinner smoothie.

3689.title: PB Banana Oat Smoothie
3689.description: This peanut butter, banana, and oat smoothie is flavored with cinnamon and honey for a deliciously creamy and filling on-the-go breakfast.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Put banana, ice, oats, yogurt, skim milk, peanut butter, honey, and cinnamon, respectively, in a blender; blend until smooth.

3690.title: Vegan Strawberry Oatmeal Breakfast Smoothie
3690.description: This is a fast smoothie recipe using oats, creating a filling vegan strawberry and banana drink with a deep pink color and a creamy texture.
instructions: Blend almond milk, oats, strawberries, banana, agave nectar, and vanilla extract in a blender until smooth.

3691.title: Refreshing Banana Drink
3691.description: This banana drink is a refreshing beverage made with banana, almond milk, vanilla, and a touch of cinnamon that's ready in minutes.
instructions: Combine almond milk, banana, ice cubes, cinnamon, and vanilla in a blender; blend on medium speed until frothy and smooth, about 1 minute.

3692.title: Vitamix Green Smoothie
3692.description: Use a Vitamix blender to mix up this wholesome green smoothie that's so fruity and delicious, you won't taste the spinach!
ingredients: 15 seedless red grapes, or more to taste
instructions: Pour water into a Vitamix blender. Add grapes, banana, pear, orange, spinach, ground flax seeds, and ice, in that order. Blend until smooth and creamy.

3693.title: Starter Smoothie
3693.description: Customize this base recipe with your favorite fruits and vegetables for a tasty, calorie-conscious smoothie every time!
ingredients: 1 banana, cut into chunks and frozen
instructions: Blend blueberries, grape juice, banana, yogurt, ice, and honey in a blender until smooth, at least 3 minutes.

3694.title: Green Power Mojito Smoothie
3694.description: Spinach, pineapple, banana, and fresh mint leaves are blended to create this delicious, bright green smoothie with a taste similar to a mojito!
ingredients: 3 cups ice cubes, or as desired
2 cups baby spinach leaves, or to taste
10 fresh mint leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice, spinach, pineapple, water, banana, orange, mint, lemon juice, and lime juice in a blender until smooth.

3695.title: Kale, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3695.description: Kale in smoothies is all the rage. Try this kale peanut butter smoothie made with peanut butter and bananas in vanilla-flavored almond milk.
ingredients: 0.5 bunch kale - stems removed and discarded, leaves torn into bite-size pieces
4 cubes ice, or more if desired
instructions: Blend bananas, almond milk, kale, ice, and peanut butter in a blender until smooth.

3696.title: Kale Orange Banana Smoothie
3696.description: A fresh orange, a pair of ripe bananas, and a kale leaf are blended into a pudding-like smoothie for a wholesome breakfast drink.
ingredients: 1 leaf kale, torn into several pieces
instructions: Blend orange in a blender until mostly juice.
Add water and kale; blend again on High speed until kale is liquefied.
Break bananas into chunks and add to the blender. Start blending at a lower speed until banana is incorporated. Increase speed to blend the mixture into a pudding-like texture.

3697.title: Tropical Sunshine Smoothie
3697.description: This tropical sunshine smoothie is loaded with banana, pineapple, and coconut water for a refreshing way to start the day.
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh chocolate mint, finely chopped
instructions: Blend banana, orange juice, mango, pineapple, coconut water, lime juice, and mint in a blender until smooth.

3698.title: Dairy-Free Peanut Butter and Banana Smoothie
3698.description: This quick banana smoothie without milk uses cultured coconut milk, peanut butter, and honey to make a great breakfast or a cool afternoon snack.
instructions: Blend coconut milk, banana, peanut butter, and honey in a blender until smooth, about 1 minute. Add ice and blend again until ice is crushed, 2 to 3 minutes.

3699.title: Banana Coconut Smoothie
3699.description: Coconut cream blends with milk and banana in this Caribbean-inspired smoothie recipe.
instructions: Blend banana, milk, coconut cream, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth.

3700.title: Jumpstart Chocolate Workout Smoothie
3700.description: Blend chocolate protein powder, almond milk, coffee, and banana together for a smoothie that will jump-start your day!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted natural peanut butter, or more to taste
instructions: Blend almond milk, ice cubes, banana, coffee, protein powder, honey, and peanut butter in a blender on low speed. Gradually turn speed up to high and blend until smooth, 20 to 30 seconds.

3701.title: Mango Banana Smoothie
3701.description: The orange mango smoothie from that famous coffee shop isn't available any longer, but you can make your own at home with this simple, 4-ingredient recipe.
instructions: Blend banana, mango, juice, and yogurt in a blender until nearly smooth.

3702.title: Hot Banana Milkshake
3702.description: An easy banana smoothie sweetened with honey and served hot makes a nice alternative to hot chocolate.
instructions: Mash bananas and brown sugar together in a bowl. Transfer to a small saucepan, place over medium heat and cook until bananas begin to brown, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually mix 1 cup of milk into bananas and heat until mixture begins to steam. Stir honey and cinnamon into mixture until honey has dissolved.

Pour banana mixture into a blender no more than half full. Cover and hold the lid down; pulse a few times before leaving on to blend. Purée until smooth. Blend remaining 1/2 cup of milk into mixture until creamy.

3703.title: Mango-Pineapple Smoothie
3703.description: I invented this one day when I had leftover mango and pineapple juice. A spoonful of cream of coconut added the sweetness and special flavor with a tropical flare. You may use frozen pineapple juice ice cubes instead for more of a slush drink (about 8 pineapple ice cubes). Enjoy!
instructions: In a blender, blend the vanilla yogurt, pineapple juice, banana, mango, milk, and cream of coconut until smooth.

3704.title: Heavenly Blueberry Smoothie
3704.description: This blueberry, banana, and flax smoothie is to die for! It tastes so good, you forget that it's good for ya!
ingredients: 1 frozen banana, thawed for 10 to 15 minutes
instructions: Cut banana into small pieces and place into the bowl of a blender. Add the soy milk, yogurt, flax seed meal, and honey. Blend on lowest speed until smooth, about 5 seconds. Gradually add the blueberries while continuing to blend on low. Once the blueberries have been incorporated, increase speed, and blend to desired consistency.

3705.title: Banana Chocolate Almond Milk Smoothie
3705.description: Start your day with this filling chocolate almond milk smoothie made with dark chocolate and a full scoop of whey protein powder. It's a great afternoon snack too!
ingredients: 1.5 ounces dark chocolate bar (such as Hershey's® Special Dark), broken into pieces
instructions: Combine almond milk, banana, dark chocolate, and protein powder in a blender; blend until smooth.

3706.title: Triple Threat Fruit Smoothie
3706.description: A wonderful, delightful fruit smoothie...it will help you cool down after a hot day in the sun.
instructions: In a blender, blend the kiwi, banana, blueberries, strawberries, ice, orange juice, and yogurt until smooth.

3707.title: Orange Banana Smoothie
3707.description: A delightful blend of orange and banana - filling enough to have as a breakfast!
instructions: In a blender, combine milk, oranges, banana, sugar, salt and yogurt. Blend for about 1 minute. Insert ice cubes, and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3708.title: Simple Cantaloupe Smoothie
3708.description: This cantaloupe smoothie recipe uses vanilla yogurt blended with fresh cantaloupe and orange juice for a creamy and delicious way to start your day.
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla yogurt (such as Dannon® Light and Fit®)
4 ice cubes, crushed, or as needed
instructions: Process yogurt, orange juice, cantaloupe, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3709.title: Apple Banana Smoothie
3709.description: Thick and healthy fruit drink with apple, banana and orange juice. The frozen banana takes the place of shaved ice and results in a smooth, creamy texture. Serve with dollop of whipped cream for added effect.
ingredients: 1 Gala apple, peeled, cored and chopped
instructions: In a blender combine frozen banana, orange juice, apple and milk. Blend until smooth. pour into glasses and serve.

3710.title: Peach Banana Smoothie
3710.description: Canned peaches, bananas, yogurt, and orange juice deliver a delicious smoothie in mere minutes.
ingredients: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Blend yogurt, peaches, bananas, orange juice, sugar, and ice in a blender on high until the ice is crushed and the smoothie is to your desired consistency.

3711.title: Nectarine Sunshine Smoothie
3711.description: Enjoy the brief, sweet season of fresh nectarines with this delicious smoothie.
ingredients: 1 banana, cut into pieces and frozen
instructions: Place the nectarines, frozen banana chunks, orange, vanilla yogurt, orange juice, and honey into a blender, and blend until smooth.

3712.title: Easy Orange Cream Slush
3712.description: This is a simple and delicious recipe for a cool and creamy orange drink.
instructions: Combine the orange juice, milk, sugar, and ice cubes in a blender; blend until smooth.

3713.title: Vitamix Green Smoothie
3713.description: Use a Vitamix blender to mix up this wholesome green smoothie that's so fruity and delicious, you won't taste the spinach!
ingredients: 15 seedless red grapes, or more to taste
instructions: Pour water into a Vitamix blender. Add grapes, banana, pear, orange, spinach, ground flax seeds, and ice, in that order. Blend until smooth and creamy.

3714.title: Starter Smoothie
3714.description: Customize this base recipe with your favorite fruits and vegetables for a tasty, calorie-conscious smoothie every time!
ingredients: 1 banana, cut into chunks and frozen
instructions: Blend blueberries, grape juice, banana, yogurt, ice, and honey in a blender until smooth, at least 3 minutes.

3715.title: Kale Orange Banana Smoothie
3715.description: A fresh orange, a pair of ripe bananas, and a kale leaf are blended into a pudding-like smoothie for a wholesome breakfast drink.
ingredients: 1 leaf kale, torn into several pieces
instructions: Blend orange in a blender until mostly juice.
Add water and kale; blend again on High speed until kale is liquefied.
Break bananas into chunks and add to the blender. Start blending at a lower speed until banana is incorporated. Increase speed to blend the mixture into a pudding-like texture.

3716.title: Superfood Berry-Green Smoothie
3716.description: Almond milk, spinach greens, berries, seeds, and vanilla protein powder are blended together in this superfood smoothie sure to fill you up.
ingredients: 1 cup spinach, or more to taste
instructions: Place almond milk, clementine, raspberries, spinach, chia seeds, flaxseed meal, blueberries, and protein powder in a blender, respectively. Blend on high until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3717.title: Triple Threat Fruit Smoothie
3717.description: A wonderful, delightful fruit smoothie...it will help you cool down after a hot day in the sun.
instructions: In a blender, blend the kiwi, banana, blueberries, strawberries, ice, orange juice, and yogurt until smooth.

3718.title: Mongolian Strawberry Orange Juice Smoothie
3718.description: An icy fruit blend of fresh strawberries, orange juice, and ice.
instructions: In a blender, combine strawberries, orange juice, ice cubes, and sugar. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3719.title: Dragon Fruit Shake
3719.description: Dragon fruit (also known as pitaya) is joined by fresh tangerine and basil in this refreshing Vietnamese drink.
instructions: Cut two 1/4 inch thick slices from the peeled dragon fruit to use as a garnish; set aside. Place the remaining dragon fruit into a blender along with the tangerine segments, lime juice, basil, brown sugar, and sparkling water. Puree until smooth. Stir in the crushed ice, and pour into glasses. Garnish with the reserved dragon fruit slices to serve.

3720.title: Sour Smoothie
3720.description: A smoothie made with oranges, lemon, lime, and kiwi with a hint of honey is just the right amount of sweet and sour.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon honey, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice, orange, limes, lemon, kiwi, and honey together in a blender until smooth.

3721.title: Orange-Pear Green Smoothie with Bok Choy
3721.description: With no added sugars, this is the green smoothie you need: a refreshing blend of bok choy, kale, orange, mint, pear, pineapple, and banana.
instructions: Combine pear, grapes, water, pineapple, banana, bok choy, kale, orange, ice, and mint in a large blender. Blend, starting on low speed and increasing to high, until smooth. Turn blender to liquefy setting for a smoother texture.

3722.title: Creamy Orange-Coconut Smoothie
3722.description: A creamy smoothie made with coconut, a fresh orange, and notes of vanilla is a great way to start the day.
ingredients: 1 large navel orange, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Combine orange chunks, yogurt, orange juice, almond milk, 2 tablespoons coconut, brown sugar, and vanilla extract in a blender; process until smooth. Add ice cubes and puree until smooth and thick. Divide between 2 glasses and garnish with remaining coconut.

3723.title: Strawberry Sensation Smoothie
3723.description: Strawberry and orange flavors will be sure to perk up your morning!
instructions: Blend the strawberries, orange pieces, apple juice, vanilla yogurt, and almonds together in a blender until smooth.

3724.title: Very Cherry Smoothie
3724.description: Sweet cherries, orange juice and coconut milk make a quick and delicious smoothie.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen pitted sweet cherries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.

3725.title: Pawpaw (Papaya) And Mango Punch
3725.description: A refreshing punch made with papaya and mango.
ingredients: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place the mango and papaya into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth; add the orange juice, lime juice, sugar, orange zest, and water. Blend well. Serve over crushed ice.

3726.title: Creamy Orange Glorious
3726.description: This orange smoothie with heavy cream and vanilla, is reminiscent of a popular fast food drink.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice concentrate, cream, carbonated water, confectioners' sugar, vanilla and ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

3727.title: Orange and Coconut Cream Smoothie
3727.description: Perfectly portioned for a snack or on-the-go treat, this creamy coconut, orange, and ginger smoothie is easy to prepare and super delicious to sip.
instructions: Combine coconut cream, orange juice, and ginger in a blender. Blend until smooth.

3728.title: Orange Slush
3728.description: A yummy drink concocted of orange juice, milk and ice. Lightly sweetened and flavored with vanilla, it's like being at the mall without the crowds!
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice concentrate, milk, sugar, vanilla and ice cubes. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3729.title: Key Lime Pie Smoothie
3729.description: Key lime pie doesn't just need to be enjoyed in its traditional form; now you can drink it as a smoothie!
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) container Key lime-flavored Greek yogurt
1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice, yogurt, banana, cream, and orange juice together in a blender until smooth.

3730.title: Orange Glorious II
3730.description: This is a slightly sweeter version of the original Orange Glorious.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice concentrate, milk, water, sugar and vanilla. Add ice cubes and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3731.title: Orange Snowman
3731.description: This is one drink my kids love! It's orange and slushy and wonderful!
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice concentrate, milk, water, sugar, vanilla and ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3732.title: Orange Glorious I
3732.description: Milk, o.j., vanilla, sugar, water and ice...make an Orange Glorious combination.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender combine milk, water, orange juice concentrate, ice cubes, vanilla and sugar. Blend until smooth. Pour into three 12 oz glasses and enjoy with a straw.

3733.title: Easy and Tasty Green Smoothie
3733.description: This tasty green smoothie with spinach, fruit, and flaxseed is perfect for breakfast or a midday snack.
ingredients: 1 medium navel orange, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Combine water, spinach, orange chunks, banana, and flaxseed in a blender; process until smooth, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

3734.title: Orange Smoothie
3734.description: A great drink for orange lovers, and a fun way to cool off! Orange juice concentrate is blended with milk and ice to produce a tasty slushy drink!
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instructions: In a blender, combine orange juice concentrate, milk, water, vanilla, sugar and ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3735.title: Kinaja
3735.description: A smashing fruit smoothie. Kiwi, bananas, pineapple rings, and lots of juice are tossed into the blender with crushed ice. What emerges is four servings of tropical bliss.
instructions: In an electric blender, mix together orange juice, kiwi, bananas, pineapple, and pineapple juice until well blended. Pour the mixture into a pitcher.
Place the ice in the blender, then pour the fruit mixture over the ice. Process until the ice is blended in with the fruit juices.

3736.title: Vanilla Banamango Smoothie
3736.description: Combine a frozen banana, a mango, and a few other ingredients and make a tasty blended smoothie for breakfast or a snack.
ingredients: 0.25 cup orange juice, or to taste
instructions: Pour orange juice into the pitcher of a blender and add mango, frozen banana, carrots, vanilla yogurt, ice cubes, and ginger. Pulse several times to crush ice, then blend until smooth, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

3737.title: Tropical Delite Smoothie
3737.description: Coconut milk, mango, and orange juice blend together into a quick and tropical-tasting smoothie. Top with whipped cream and a sprinkling of chocolate if you like.
ingredients: 1 (15.25 ounce) can mango slices with juice
instructions: Place coconut milk, mango slices with their juice, orange juice, and sugar into a blender, and blend until smooth; add the shaved ice, and blend again. Pour into 4 glasses, and top each serving with a dollop of whipped cream and a sprinkling of shaved milk chocolate.

3738.title: Pacific Smoothie
3738.description: A tropical delight that hits a sweet tooth, but reminds you of sunbathing in the tropics.
instructions: Blend the ice, banana, maple syrup, brown sugar, eggnog, orange juice, and vanilla yogurt together in a blender until smooth.

3739.title: P.O.M. Spritzer
3739.description: This blend of pomelo, orange, and mango juice plus club soda makes a lovely non-alcoholic addition to a spring or summer brunch! P.O.M. is an abbreviation for the 3 fruits included.
instructions: Peel pomelo and separate the fruit from the pith. Place fruit segments into a high performance blender (such as a Vitamix®). Blend on variable 1, quickly switching to variable 10. Blend for 1 minute.
Peel mango, remove pit, and cut into slices. Add to the blender and blend for another minute.
Cut oranges in half and squeeze juice into a small container. Strain to remove pulp, if desired, and pour juice into the blender. Add club soda and blend on high speed for 1 minute. Serve chilled.

3740.title: Blueberry Smoothie
3740.description: Blueberry smoothie recipes are a favorite way to enjoy fresh or frozen berries, and this one's a winner! Tangy yogurt and a touch of sugar balance it.
instructions: Blend blueberries, yogurt, milk, sugar, vanilla, and nutmeg in a blender until frothy, scraping down the sides of the blender if needed.
Divide between 2 glasses and serve immediately.

3741.title: Blueberry, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3741.description: This is a perfect peanut butter and berry smoothie to start your day or enjoy as a snack. Flax gives a boost to this recipe. It's kid-friendly too!
instructions: Put flaxseed meal into a blender to grind and further break down.
Place banana, milk, blueberries, yogurt, peanut butter, and honey into the blender. Cover and purée until smooth.
Pour into glasses to serve.

3742.title: Healthy Blueberry Breakfast Smoothie
3742.description: Wondering what to eat for your on-the-go breakfast? Make this healthy and delicious blueberry breakfast smoothie.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
1 pinch ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Blend blueberries, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon together in a blender on low speed for 30 seconds; increase speed to high and blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add ice and blend on high until smooth, about 1 minute more.

3743.title: All-Fruit Smoothies
3743.description: There's nothing in this smoothie except pineapple juice, banana, and frozen strawberries and blueberries. It's smooth, frosty, and dairy-free.
instructions: Pour pineapple juice into a blender and add banana, strawberries, and blueberries. Cover and blend until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour into 2 glasses.

3744.title: Berries and Cream Smoothie
3744.description: Sweet, thick, and a great alternative to dessert, this berries and cream smoothie is blended up in minutes to enjoy on-the-go.
instructions: Pour cream and half-and-half into an electric blender and blend on low speed until it begins to thicken. Add sugar and vanilla extract and mix for about 30 seconds. Add blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries. Blend until smooth, adding milk if necessary to make blending easier.

3745.title: Strawberry Blueberry Smoothies
3745.description: Frozen strawberries and blueberries are combined in a yogurt smoothie sweetened with agave nectar.
instructions: Blend almond milk, strawberries, blueberries, yogurt, flax seed oil, and agave nectar in a blender until smooth.

3746.title: Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
3746.description: A blueberry and banana smoothie is topped with coconut and almonds in this quick and easy blueberry smoothie bowl recipe.
instructions: Blend blueberries, 1/2 banana, water, cashew butter, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl.
Top smoothie with sliced banana, almonds, and coconut.

3747.title: Avocado Blueberry Smoothie
3747.description: This five-ingredient smoothie uses only blueberries, avocado, yogurt, almond milk, and water.
instructions: Blend blueberries, yogurt, almond milk, water, and avocado in a blender until smooth.

3748.title: Overnight Oats Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
3748.description: Overnight oats and blueberries are blended and topped with coconut and chia seeds in this colorful smoothie bowl recipe.
ingredients: 1.25 cups unsweetened vanilla-flavored almond milk, divided
1 teaspoon maple syrup, or to taste
instructions: Combine oats and 2/3 cup almond milk in a bowl; cover and refrigerate until milk is absorbed by oats, 8 hours to overnight.
Combine oats-almond milk mixture, remaining almond milk, banana, blueberries, vanilla, and maple syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.
Pour smoothie into 2 bowls, then top with coconut, blueberries, and chia seeds.

3749.title: Almond Berry Smoothie
3749.description: Almond milk and almond butter are the star ingredients in this berry smoothie with almond milk for a nutritious, on-the-go meal that is vegan and paleo-friendly.
instructions: Combine blueberries, banana, almond milk, and almond butter in a blender; blend until smooth, adding water for a thinner smoothie.

3750.title: Starter Smoothie
3750.description: Customize this base recipe with your favorite fruits and vegetables for a tasty, calorie-conscious smoothie every time!
ingredients: 1 banana, cut into chunks and frozen
instructions: Blend blueberries, grape juice, banana, yogurt, ice, and honey in a blender until smooth, at least 3 minutes.

3751.title: Super Healthy Fruit Smoothie
3751.description: Absolutely wonderful fruit smoothie with raspberries, blueberries, strawberries and more! I have this for breakfast every morning.
instructions: Place the blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, pomegranate and mango juices, milk, and honey into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth. Pour into glasses to serve.

3752.title: Tropical Mango-Pineapple-Berry Smoothie
3752.description: A refreshing tropical mango blueberry smoothie with strawberries and pineapple juice, made creamy with vanilla yogurt. Full of flavor and antioxidants!
instructions: Combine mango, frozen strawberries, yogurt, pineapple juice, and frozen blueberries in a blender; blend until smooth.

3753.title: Berry Good Smoothie
3753.description: The natural sweetness of three types of berries brings wonderful, fresh flavor to this tasty summer smoothie with water.
instructions: Blend ice cubes in a blender until crushed. Pour in water and juice; blend.
Add frozen raspberries, mixed berries, and blueberries; blend until smooth. Pour into chilled glasses.

3754.title: Very Berry Anti-Inflammatory Smoothie
3754.description: This grape, cherry, strawberry and blueberry smoothie tastes amazing while packing in anti-inflammatory benefits!
instructions: Pour almond milk into a high-frequency blender (such as Vitamix®). Add cherries, strawberries, grapes, blueberries, and turmeric.
Secure lid, and turn onto variable speed 1. Increase speed to variable 10. Blend for 30 to 45 seconds.

3755.title: Heavenly Blueberry Smoothie
3755.description: This blueberry, banana, and flax smoothie is to die for! It tastes so good, you forget that it's good for ya!
ingredients: 1 frozen banana, thawed for 10 to 15 minutes
instructions: Cut banana into small pieces and place into the bowl of a blender. Add the soy milk, yogurt, flax seed meal, and honey. Blend on lowest speed until smooth, about 5 seconds. Gradually add the blueberries while continuing to blend on low. Once the blueberries have been incorporated, increase speed, and blend to desired consistency.

3756.title: Heart Healthy Blueberry Smoothie
3756.description: This delicious blueberry-pomegranate smoothie is perfect for when you're on the go.
ingredients: 0.25 cup granular sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instructions: Blend blueberries, pomegranate juice, yogurt, milk, oats, sweetener, and cinnamon together in a blender until smooth, about 2 minutes.

3757.title: Triple Threat Fruit Smoothie
3757.description: A wonderful, delightful fruit smoothie...it will help you cool down after a hot day in the sun.
instructions: In a blender, blend the kiwi, banana, blueberries, strawberries, ice, orange juice, and yogurt until smooth.

3758.title: Blueberry Banana Oatmeal Smoothie
3758.description: Make this recipe for a blueberry banana oatmeal smoothie when you need a quick and easy breakfast or snack.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Blend soy milk, banana, blueberries, oats, chia seeds, vanilla extract, and white sugar together in a blender until smooth.

3759.title: Strawberry and Blueberry Oatmeal Health Shake
3759.description: This strawberry and blueberry protein smoothie made with Greek yogurt, milk, and oats is a quick and easy way to fuel up for the day.
ingredients: 0.25 cup vanilla and honey Greek yogurt (such as Chobani®)
instructions: Combine blueberries, milk, strawberries, sugar, oats, and yogurt in a blender; blend until smooth. Add ice; blend until smooth.

3760.title: Avocado, Blueberry, Banana, and Chia Smoothie
3760.description: Fresh blueberries are blended with avocado, banana, almond milk, and chia seeds into a quick and easy smoothie with a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Combine almond milk, avocado, blueberries, banana, ice, and chia seeds in a blender; blend until smooth.

3761.title: Easy Acai Smoothie Bowl
3761.description: Try this easy acai smoothie bowl with bananas, blueberries and almond milk. Garnish with berries, nuts, or granola to your liking.
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp, partially defrosted in refrigerator overnight
0.75 cup almond milk, or more as needed
2 tablespoons fresh blueberries, or to taste
1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds, or to taste
1 tablespoon large coconut flakes, or to taste
instructions: Combine acai, bananas, blueberries, almond milk, and honey in a blender. Blend until smooth. Smoothie should have a thick consistency, like frozen yogurt.
Pour into 2 bowls and top with banana slices, blueberries, pomegranate seeds, and coconut.

3762.title: Purple Power Punch Smoothie (My Kids' Fave)
3762.description: This kid-pleasing power smoothie made with strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, and raspberries is sure to become your go-to smoothie of choice.
ingredients: 0.5 cup nonfat vanilla yogurt (such as Dannon® Light and Fit®)
3 tablespoons turbinado sugar (such as Sugar in the Raw®)
instructions: Pulse yogurt, strawberries, water, powdered milk, banana, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, and protein powder together in a blender until well-mixed. Add ice, sugar, and honey and blend until smooth.

3763.title: Morning Energy Booster Smoothie
3763.description: Prune juice, yogurt, berries, and flax seed are blended together creating an energy-boosting smoothie to start your day off right.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh spinach, or to taste
1 cup frozen blueberries, or to taste
instructions: Pour prune juice into a blender. Layer Greek yogurt, spinach, blueberries, strawberries, peach, and flax seeds in the blender, in this order. Start blender on low speed and gradually increase speed until smoothie is well blended.

3764.title: Blueberry-Watermelon Smoothie
3764.description: Perfect for cooling down on hot summer days, this blueberry-watermelon smoothie blends fruit and spinach together for wholesome flavor.
instructions: Combine watermelon, blueberries, banana, and cucumber in an electric blender and blend well. Add spinach last and blend until smoothie gets creamy, about 30 seconds.

3765.title: Summer Sweet Smoothies
3765.description: Fresh fruit blends with cranberry juice for a quick and sweet summertime smoothie.
instructions: Process the cranberry juice, strawberries, blueberries, watermelon, banana, and figs in a blender until smooth and creamy. Enjoy immediately or keep cool in refrigerator.

3766.title: Purple Monstrosity Fruit Smoothie
3766.description: This is a great smoothie for breakfast - and sometimes dinner! You can substitute the orange juice with any mix of juices or even soy milk! The soy milk adds more of a milk shake quality than the juice does.
ingredients: 2 frozen bananas, skins removed and cut in chunks
instructions: Place bananas, blueberries and juice in a blender, puree. Use honey and/or vanilla to taste. Use more or less liquid depending on the thickness you want for your smoothie.

3767.title: Backyard Berry Bowl
3767.description: A berry smoothie is topped with more berries, banana, and granola in this quick and easy smoothie bowl.
ingredients: 1 cup ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Blend ice, 1/2 cup strawberries, 1 banana, blackberries, and apple juice together in a blender until smooth, adding more ice depending on your desired consistency. Pour smoothie into a bowl.
Top smoothie with remaining strawberries, remaining banana, blueberries, and granola. Drizzle honey over the top.

3768.title: Banana Blueberry Peanut Butter Smoothie
3768.description: Blend up a banana, fresh blueberries, peanut butter, vanilla yogurt into a tasty post-workout protein shake with this quick and easy recipe.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla yogurt, or more to taste
instructions: Combine milk, blueberries, ice cubes, banana, vanilla yogurt, peanut butter, and chocolate protein powder in a blender; blend until smooth.

3769.title: Ginger Berry Smoothie
3769.description: This invigorating smoothie made with strawberries, blueberries, and agave gets and extra kick from fresh ginger.
ingredients: 1 cup water, or more as needed
4 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
1 (1 inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Blend water, blueberries, strawberries, ginger, and agave nectar together in a blender until thick and smooth.

3770.title: Blueberry and Spice Smoothie
3770.description: Blueberries, cinnamon, and yogurt are blended together creating this blueberry and spice smoothie perfect for breakfast or a snack.
ingredients: 0.25 cup ice cubes, or as desired
0.5 cup frozen blueberries, or to taste
1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Blend ice in a blender until crumbly; add yogurt, milk, blueberries, and cinnamon. Blend until smooth. Taste smoothie and add desired amount of sugar; blend.

3771.title: Spinach-Berry Smoothie
3771.description: If you're trying to add more spinach to your diet, try this yummy smoothie with blueberries, blackberries, and light sour cream. Feel free to use other berries to your liking.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Add spinach leaves to a blender and finely chop. Add berry juice, blueberries, sour cream, sugar, blackberries, and ice cubes. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later.

3772.title: Gordon's Berry Breakfast Drink
3772.description: This berry drink recipe makes an easy and satisfying breakfast-on-the-go and is equally wonderful served as a part of a sit down breakfast or brunch. Blend frozen blueberries and strawberries with juice, yogurt, and bananas to make this colorful and tasty drink.
instructions: Place the orange juice, pineapple juice, yogurt, blueberries, strawberries, and bananas into a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. The berry drink will be very thick. Serve immediately.

3773.title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
3773.description: A strawberry-pineapple smoothie is topped with blueberries, raspberries, almonds, and granola in this tasty berry smoothie bowl.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons frozen acai berry pulp, or as desired
instructions: Blend strawberries, pineapple, yogurt, coconut water, and acai pulp in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl. Top smoothie with kiwi, banana, blueberries, raspberries, almonds, granola, and chia seeds.

3774.title: Fruit Smoothie II
3774.description: A delicious fruit smoothie made with blueberries, apples, raspberries and grapes.
instructions: In a blender, combine blueberries, apples, raspberries, grapes, sugar and ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3775.title: Rainier Cherry Berry Smoothie
3775.description: Rainier cherries, banana, and blueberries are blended with vanilla yogurt and milk in this quick and easy recipe for a refreshing smoothie.
instructions: Combine banana, blueberries, vanilla yogurt, strawberries, cherries, and milk in a blender; blend until smooth, about 60 seconds.

3776.title: Fruity Non-Dairy Oatmeal Smoothie
3776.description: No dairy is needed in this vegan oatmeal smoothie! Fresh berries, bananas, and almond milk bring natural sweetness to this wholesome treat.
instructions: Combine bananas, almond milk, blueberries, and strawberries in a blender and puree until smooth, adding oats just before you have almost reached your desired texture. Blend until oats are mixed in.

3777.title: Ginger Fruit Smoothie
3777.description: A homemade smoothie packed with apple, grapes, and berries gets an extra kick from fresh ginger that is out of this world.
ingredients: 1 cup water, or more as needed
3 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
1 (1 inch) piece peeled fresh ginger, cut into thirds
instructions: Blend water, blueberries, grapes, apple, strawberries, ginger, and agave nectar together in a blender until thick and slushy.

3778.title: Frozen Blueberry Smoothie
3778.description: Enjoy this blueberry smoothie with kiwi and yogurt as a refresher on a hot day.
instructions: Blend blueberries, milk, yogurt, kiwi, and sugar together in a blender until smooth.

3779.title: Protein Smoothie Bowl with Berries, Chocolate Chips, and Granola
3779.description: This quick and easy smoothie bowl features protein powder, strawberries, blueberries, chocolate chips, and granola. A great way to start the day!
instructions: Combine strawberries, milk, 1/3 cup granola, blueberries, protein powder, and vanilla in a blender; blend until smooth.
Layer 1/2 of the chocolate chips on the bottom of a bowl. Pour smoothie over top, then sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips and remaining granola.

3780.title: Blueberry Almond Milk Smoothie
3780.description: This almond milk smoothie with blueberries, banana, oats, and almond butter is a great healthy breakfast.
ingredients: 2 cubes ice, or more to taste
instructions: Combine blueberries, almond milk, banana, ice cubes, oats, almond butter, acai powder, vanilla extract, and maple syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.

3781.title: Blueberry-Ginger Breakfast Smoothie
3781.description: Frozen blueberries join milk and oats in this filling, honey-sweetened smoothie with an unexpected, but delightful, bite of ginger.
instructions: Combine milk, frozen blueberries, oats, lemon juice, honey, and ginger in a blender; process until smooth.

3782.title: Blue Grapefruit Smoothie
3782.description: This grapefruit smoothie is a perfectly perky marriage of oats, banana, rice milk, and yogurt with juicy kiwi, blueberries, and grapefruit!
ingredients: 1 grapefruit - peeled, seeds removed, and white pith removed
instructions: Mix grapefruit, rice milk, blueberries, yogurt, oats, banana, kiwi, and sugar together in a blender until smooth.

3783.title: "The Jackson" Detox Smoothie
3783.description: With flaxseed oil, plenty of berries, and acai powder for antioxidants, this refreshing detox smoothie makes for a filling meal substitute.
instructions: Place 1 cup strawberries in a blender; blend on ice crush setting until smooth. Add the remaining 1/2 cup strawberries, soy milk, and blueberries; blend until well combined. Add acai powder, flaxseed oil, and stevia with a spoon. Blend until smooth.

3784.title: Blueberry Muffin Smoothie/Shake
3784.description: Blueberries, milk, lemon extract, and vanilla wafers combine to create this delicious blueberry muffin smoothie - perfect for cooling down on a hot day!
instructions: Blend milk, half-and-half, sugar, lemon extract, and cinnamon in a blender; add blueberries and blend until thick and smooth. Blend vanilla wafers and ice cubes into milk mixture until desired consistency is reached.

3785.title: Detox Smoothie
3785.description: Blueberries, spinach, soy milk, and a Granny Smith apple are blended together to make this breakfast detox smoothie full of green goodness.
instructions: Combine Granny Smith apple, spinach, blueberries, soy milk, and ice cubes in a blender; blend until smooth.

3786.title: Ann's Berry Green Smoothie
3786.description: Blueberries, strawberries, and spinach are blended with milk and honey creating a quick and easy, on-the-go strawberry smoothie.
ingredients: 1.5 cups fresh spinach, or to taste
instructions: Place strawberries in a bowl; add warm water.
Blend milk and spinach together in a blender until smooth. Add blueberries, banana, and honey and blend until smooth. Add strawberries-water mixture and lemon juice and blend until smooth.

3787.title: Blue Monster Acai Smoothie
3787.description: A smoothie made with blueberries, acai juice, Greek yogurt, and flaxseeds has a refreshing taste and is good brain food.
ingredients: 3 cubes ice, or more to taste
instructions: Combine blueberries, yogurt, juice, ice, and flax seeds in a blender; blend until smooth.

3788.title: Blueberry Vanilla Graham Protein Smoothie
3788.description: Fresh blueberries, graham crackers, and dates are blended together with hemp seeds and coconut milk to create a protein-filled smoothie.
ingredients: 1 cup coconut water, or to taste
instructions: Combine coconut water, banana, blueberries, kale, spinach, dates, almond butter, hemp seed hearts, flax seeds, oats, and protein powder in a blender. Cover and puree until smooth. Top with graham cracker crumbs.

3789.title: Vegan Blueberry Basil Smoothie
3789.description: Use up extra fresh basil in a vegan smoothie like this refreshing drink with frozen blueberries - or any berries of your choice.
ingredients: 7 leaves basil, or more to taste
2 (1 gram) packets stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine blueberries, water, basil, lime juice, and sweetener in a blender; blend until smooth.

3790.title: Marlene's Yogurt Berry Smoothie
3790.description: This satisfying yogurt berry smoothie with flax seeds and soy milk is a great way to start your day.
ingredients: 3 ounces baby carrots, cut into chunks
instructions: Pour soy milk and flax seeds into a blender. Allow flax seeds to soften, 1 to 3 minutes. Turn blender on and add yogurt, strawberries, banana, carrots, and coconut, blending well after each addition. Add blueberries and blend until smooth.

3791.title: Easy Mango Banana Smoothie
3791.description: This fresh mango banana smoothie made with milk and vanilla yogurt makes a quick, easy, and deliciously creamy breakfast or mid-afternoon snack.
instructions: Combine mangos, banana, vanilla yogurt, and milk in a blender; blend until smooth.

3792.title: Recharge-Style Strawberry Mango Smoothie
3792.description: If you're in need of a vitamin boost- this recharge cafe copy cat smoothie with strawberry and mango will hit the spot!
ingredients: 0.33 cup orange pineapple apple juice blend (such as Welch’s®)
instructions: Add banana, mango, strawberries, juice, and coconut water to a blender. Blend until smooth, stopping to scrape sides as needed. Pour into a glass; garnish with fresh strawberry.

3793.title: Lela's Protein Mango Smoothie
3793.description: Whip up this high-protein vanilla mango smoothie when you need a quick-and-easy refreshing treat.
ingredients: 0.5 mango, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: Blend mango, yogurt, almond milk, ice, protein powder, and honey together in a blender until smooth.

3794.title: Mangonada
3794.description: Mangonadas are a layered Mexican mango smoothie that are sweet, salty, tart, and fruity. A definite cool-down drink for those hot summer days.
instructions: Place 1 teaspoon chamoy on a plate. Place 1 teaspoon chili-lime seasoning on another plate. Dip rim of glass first in chamoy, then in chili-lime seasoning. Set aside.
Combine frozen mango, water, and lime juice in a blender; blend until smooth.
Place 1/2 tablespoon chamoy in the bottom of the glass. Add 1/2 teaspoon chili-lime seasoning and 1/2 of the blended mangoes. Repeat layers and top with diced fresh mango.

3795.title: Creamy Mango Smoothie
3795.description: This smoothie recipe combines the flavors of mango and vanilla.
instructions: Blend the milk, yogurt, vanilla extract, mango, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth and creamy.

3796.title: Peanut Butter Mango Smoothie
3796.description: Mango and peanut butter blend together to form this recipe for a kid-pleasing smoothie that adults will enjoy, too!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter, or to taste
instructions: Blend yogurt, banana, mango, and peanut butter together in a blender until smooth.

3797.title: Mango Watermelon Smoothie
3797.description: Mango and watermelon are blended together in this light and refreshing smoothie to make this a perfect beverage for a hot summer day.
instructions: Blend watermelon, mango, water, and sugar together in a blender until smooth.
Place ice into glasses and pour smoothie over ice.

3798.title: Mango Oatmeal Breakfast Smoothie
3798.description: Blend mango, oats, yogurt, orange juice, and banana together to make this recipe for a delicious breakfast smoothie.
instructions: Blend orange juice, mango, banana, yogurt, and oats together in a blender until smooth.

3799.title: Summertime Mango Drink
3799.description: A favorite summer beverage, this mango drink is easy and quick; you can be enjoying this cool drink in the hot sun in just about 5 minutes.
instructions: Combine mangoes, ice cubes, vanilla extract, and sugar in a blender; pour in milk. Blend until liquefied.

3800.title: Mango-Peach Smoothie
3800.description: You can use fresh or frozen fruit in this yummy mango and peach smoothie. It tastes better if the fruit is frozen, so I freeze fresh fruit for this easy treat.
ingredients: 0.5 cup orange juice, or as needed
instructions: Place peach, mango, soy milk, and orange juice into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth. Pour into glasses to serve.

3801.title: Mango Cherry Smoothie
3801.description: This mango and cherry smoothie is a tangy, delicious breakfast drink or snack to cool down on a sunny day.
instructions: Blend cherries, mango, water, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth.

3802.title: Chamoyada
3802.description: Chamoyadas are a Mexican traditional drink made with fresh mangos and chamoy sauce. This recipe uses fresh frozen mangoes and pineapple juice for an added tropical twist.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen mango cubes
instructions: Combine mango and pineapple juice in a blender; blend until smooth. Set aside.

Rub lime wedge around the rim of a glass, then dip in 1 teaspoon chili-lime seasoning. Juice lime into the glass; add 1 tablespoon chamoy and remaining 1 teaspoon chili-lime seasoning. Pour 1/2 of the mango-pineapple mixture into the prepared glass. Add remaining 1 tablespoon chamoy sauce and top with remaining mango-pineapple mixture.

3803.title: Tropical Mango-Pineapple-Berry Smoothie
3803.description: A refreshing tropical mango blueberry smoothie with strawberries and pineapple juice, made creamy with vanilla yogurt. Full of flavor and antioxidants!
instructions: Combine mango, frozen strawberries, yogurt, pineapple juice, and frozen blueberries in a blender; blend until smooth.

3804.title: Mango Banana Smoothie
3804.description: The orange mango smoothie from that famous coffee shop isn't available any longer, but you can make your own at home with this simple, 4-ingredient recipe.
instructions: Blend banana, mango, juice, and yogurt in a blender until nearly smooth.

3805.title: Restaurant Style Mango Lassi
3805.description: This mango lassi uses canned mangos to create a smoother, tastier drink.
ingredients: 2 (15.25 ounce) cans mango pulp, or mango slices with juice
instructions: Pour mangos, yogurt, milk, and ice into the bowl of a blender. Blend until smooth.

3806.title: Mango-Pineapple Smoothie
3806.description: I invented this one day when I had leftover mango and pineapple juice. A spoonful of cream of coconut added the sweetness and special flavor with a tropical flare. You may use frozen pineapple juice ice cubes instead for more of a slush drink (about 8 pineapple ice cubes). Enjoy!
instructions: In a blender, blend the vanilla yogurt, pineapple juice, banana, mango, milk, and cream of coconut until smooth.

3807.title: Licuado de Mango
3807.description: Every town in Mexico has someone selling licuados, fabulously refreshing drinks. Try experimenting with other fruit!
instructions: Place mango, milk, honey, and ice cubes into a blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

3808.title: Mango Pina Colada Smoothie
3808.description: This mango pina colada smoothie is my version of the cocktail but without alcohol.
instructions: Purée mango, coconut milk, ice, pineapple juice, cream, and sugar in a blender until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve.

3809.title: Pineapple Mango Coconut Smoothie
3809.description: Our Coconut Almond Blend is the perfect tropical base for this pineapple-mango smoothie.
ingredients: 1 cup Almond Breeze Original or Unsweetened Original almondmilk
1 cup fresh or frozen mango cubes
1 cup fresh, frozen, or juice-packed pineapple chunks
1 tablespoon toasted slivered or sliced almonds
instructions: Puree all ingredients in a blender until smooth.

3810.title: Mango Lassi II
3810.description: This creamy, smooth mango lassi is made with yogurt and mango and is absolutely heavenly.
instructions: In a blender, combine mangos, yogurt, sugar and ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.

3811.title: My Mango Lassi
3811.description: Mango lassi is very rich and luxurious drink with yogurt and mangoes. It is the perfect summer drink when served chilled.
ingredients: 1.5 cups mangos - peeled, seeded, chopped, and chilled
instructions: Combine mangos, yogurt, milk, cream, confectioners' sugar, and cardamom in a blender; blend until smooth and frothy. Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

3812.title: Acai Mango Smoothie Bowl
3812.description: Acai, mango, almond milk, oats, and chia seeds make a fantastic smoothie bowl for 2, just in time to start the day with something delicious.
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
instructions: Place almond milk, mango, bananas, rolled oats, and acai pulp in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour into 2 bowls and top with chia seeds and drizzle with maple syrup.

3813.title: Mango-Strawberry Smoothie with Yogurt
3813.description: A quick and easy mango strawberry smoothie made with nonfat vanilla yogurt. Great for an after-workout snack or just to enjoy on a hot day!
instructions: Combine mango, strawberries, and apple juice in a blender. Place ice over the fruit and pour in yogurt. Blend on high speed until smooth. Pour into a glass.

3814.title: Spinach, Avocado, and Mango Smoothie
3814.description: A delicious thick and creamy smoothie with spinach, avocado, and mango. The addition of powdered lemonade mix produces a sweet and tangy drink.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon powdered lemonade mix (such as Country Time®)
1 packet stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine spinach, mango, avocado, powdered lemonade mix, sugar substitute, and water in a blender; blend until thick and frothy.

3815.title: Pawpaw (Papaya) And Mango Punch
3815.description: A refreshing punch made with papaya and mango.
ingredients: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place the mango and papaya into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth; add the orange juice, lime juice, sugar, orange zest, and water. Blend well. Serve over crushed ice.

3816.title: Watermelon Strawberry Mango Lemonade Smoothie
3816.description: Watermelon, strawberries, and mango are blended a good amount of lemon juice creating a sweet and tasty on-the-go lemonade smoothie.
instructions: Blend watermelon, water, strawberries, mango, sugar, and lemon juice in a blender until smooth, about 5 minutes.

3817.title: Spiced Mango Lassi
3817.description: Mango lassi is the queen of mango drinks; this quick and easy recipe features bright Indian spices, frozen mango, vanilla extract, and honey.
instructions: Combine yogurt, mango chunks, mango juice, honey, vanilla extract, ground cardamom, ground cinnamon, and ground ginger in a blender; process until liquefied.

3818.title: Mango-Mint Lassi with Indian Sweet Spices
3818.description: Mint and mango are joined by star anise and cardamom in this refreshing Indian yogurt drink.
ingredients: 1 large mango - peeled, seeded, and diced
instructions: Blend the mango, brown sugar, chopped mint, star anise, cardamom, lime juice, and yogurt in a blender on high speed until smooth. Pour into glasses and garnish with fresh mint sprigs to serve.

3819.title: Ultimate Fruit Smoothie
3819.description: Milk, orange juice, strawberries, mango, peach, and pineapple combine to make this delightful smoothie that has a little tang with dash of sweet.
ingredients: 0.5 mango - peeled, seeded, and cut into chunks
0.5 fresh peach - peeled, pitted, and sliced
instructions: Blend milk, orange juice, mango, peach, pineapple, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3820.title: Mega Mango Smoothie
3820.description: Healthy meets high energy in a refreshing mango, orange, banana, and cottage cheese smoothie.
instructions: Place the mango, cottage cheese, ice cubes, orange juice, water, banana, honey, flax oil and vanilla in a blender. Blend for 2 minutes or until very smooth; serve immediately.

3821.title: Mango Craze Juice Blend
3821.description: This is a great dairy-free smoothie for the true mango lover!
ingredients: 1.5 cups chopped fresh or frozen peaches
instructions: Place mango, peaches, orange, nectarine, orange juice, and ice into a blender. Blend for 1 minute, or until smooth.

3822.title: Superfood Stevia Smoothie
3822.description: Make your morning super, with this superfood smoothie made with chia seeds and Stevia In The Raw.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets Stevia In The Raw®
instructions: In a blender, combine mango, kale, almond milk, orange juice, stevia, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth.

3823.title: Sesame Mango Smoothie
3823.description: Sesame seeds and cashew butter add a nice nutty flavor to this mango and spinach green smoothie that is a great on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer banana, mango, cucumber, spinach, cashew butter, and sesame seeds in a blender, in the order mentioned; add water. Blend until smoothie is desired consistency, adding more water if desired.

3824.title: Mango Lassi-Come-Home
3824.description: Pureed mango and mango nectar are blended with lemon yogurt, vanilla yogurt, milk, and honey to make a delicious beverage suitable for serving with your favorite curry dish.
instructions: Blend the lemon yogurt, vanilla yogurt, milk, pureed mango, honey, mango nectar, and cardamom together in a blender until completely combined. Serve immediately.

3825.title: Coconut Banango Smoothie
3825.description: Coconut milk, bananas, and mango are blended into a creamy tropical smoothie perfect for on-the-go breakfasts.
instructions: Blend mango, bananas, coconut milk, water, ice, sugar, coconut extract, and lime zest in a blender until smooth.

3826.title: Lemon Coconut Cleanser
3826.description: Fresh lemon, zucchini, spinach, and mango chunks are blended into this quick and easy smooth coconut cleanser with bright citrus flavor.
ingredients: 4 ice cubes, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango chunks, lemon, spinach, zucchini, water, ice cubes, and coconut oil in a high-speed blender; blend until smooth.

3827.title: Easy Mango Lassi
