3827.description: This delicious mango and yogurt shake is great for extinguishing the fire in your mouth after eating hot curries!
ingredients: 4 teaspoons white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place the yogurt, milk, mangoes, white sugar, and cardamom into the jar of a blender and blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour or until cold, and serve sprinkled with a little ground cardamom.

3828.title: Basil Strawberry Mango Smoothie
3828.description: A cold, refreshing smoothie with fresh strawberries and frozen mango is given an herbal kick with the inclusion of fresh basil leaves.
ingredients: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Blend the basil, mango, strawberries, and water in a blender. Add sugar and ice cubes; blend again until smooth.

3829.title: Mango- Coconut Smoothie
3829.description: The taste of the tropics--coconut and mango--make a quick and refreshing smoothie.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon Diced mango and shredded coconut for garnish
instructions: Place the first four ingredients in Osteru® Versau® Performance Blender in order listed
Add 1 cup water.
Select programmed SMOOTHIE setting.
Serve immediately. Top with diced mango and coconut, if desired.

3830.title: Mango Smoothie Bowl
3830.description: This easy mango smoothie bowl with banana and coconut milk is a great start into the day. You can change up the fruit for garnish to your liking.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk, or to taste
1 teaspoon agave syrup, or to taste
1 tablespoon coconut flakes, or more to taste
6 pieces fresh raspberries, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango, milk, banana, and agave syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.
Pour into a bowl. Garnish with rows of banana, pomegranate seeds, flaked coconut, and raspberries.

3831.title: BFF Smoothie
3831.description: This creamy strawberry and mango smoothie has a hint of mint added at the end of blending.
ingredients: 5 fresh mint leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Blend strawberries, Greek yogurt, mango, milk, and protein powder together until smooth. Add mint leaves and pulse until leaves are chopped, 4 to 5 pulses.

3832.title: Vegan Kale Smoothie
3832.description: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, banana, and almond-coconut milk for a delicious and nutritious vegan green smoothie the whole family (including your kids!) will love.
ingredients: 1 cup almond-coconut milk, or more if needed
instructions: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, 1 cup almond-coconut milk, banana, chia seeds, and flax seed in a high-performance blender (such as Vitamix®); blend until smooth. Add more coconut milk beverage if mixture is too thick.

3833.title: Spiced Mango Protein Smoothie
3833.description: A delicious mango smoothie packed with protein powder and spiced with ginger, turmeric, and nutmeg to boost your immune system.
instructions: Combine soy milk, mango, vanilla protein powder, ginger, turmeric, nutmeg, and ice cubes in a blender cup; blend until smooth.

3834.title: Acai Rainbow Smoothie Bowl for 2
3834.description: Frozen berries and acai pulp, topped with fresh fruits, granola, and agave, make for an amazing and refreshing smoothie bowl for two.
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
instructions: Place frozen berries, almond milk, banana, and acai pulp in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour into 2 bowls and top with granola, mango, strawberries, and kiwi slices. Drizzle with agave syrup.

3835.title: Rainbow Smoothie Packs
3835.description: These smoothie packs blended with Almond Breeze almondmilk will get any day started right.
ingredients: 1.5 cups fresh or frozen sliced strawberries
1 cup fresh or frozen mango cubes
1 cup fresh, frozen, or juice-packed peach slices
1.5 cups fresh, frozen, or juice-packed pineapple chunks
instructions: Place all ingredients except Almond Breeze almondmilk in a small zip-top bag. Freeze until ready to use. To prepare smoothies, place the ingredients and Almond Breeze almondmilk in a blender and puree until smooth.

3836.title: Make-Ahead Tropical Smoothie Packs
3836.description: Make the tropical fruit mix ahead and blend when ready to make these quick and easy smoothies for a refreshing treat.
ingredients: 1 medium firm banana, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Place pineapple, spinach, mango, peaches, banana, cucumber and chia seeds in a large resealable plastic bag or lidded container. Squeeze out the air. Freeze for up to 1 month.
When ready to blend, add contents of bag to blender. Add coconut milk and orange juice and blend on high until mixture is smooth. Serve immediately.

3837.title: Delicious Fruity Green Smoothie
3837.description: This delicious green smoothie has pineapple, mango, banana, blueberries, and greens of your choice and takes just minutes to make.
instructions: Combine kale and water in a blender; process until no chunks remain. Add banana, blueberries, pineapple, and mango; blend until smooth.

3838.title: Fruity Green Matcha Smoothie
3838.description: Blended with mango, spinach, and strawberries, this matcha smoothie makes a healthy, filling breakfast or on-the-go snack.
instructions: Combine milk, yogurt, strawberries, mangos, matcha, honey, and spinach in a blender, in that order. Process until smooth. Make sure you don't over-blend, this can affect the quality of your smoothie!

3839.title: Chef V's Smoothie Bowl
3839.description: Fruit, coconut water, and Greek yogurt are blended together, poured into a bowl, and topped with chia seeds in this smoothie bowl recipe.
instructions: Combine yogurt, coconut water, strawberries, peaches, mango, banana, and 1 tablespoon chia seeds in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour smoothie into a bowl and top with remaining 1 tablespoon chia seeds.

3840.title: Paleo and Vegan Tropical Acai Bowl for Two
3840.description: Start the day with this quick and easy acai bowl made with pineapple, mango, and chia seeds. Made in just minutes and totally ideal for Paleo and vegan diets.
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
1 cup iced water, or as needed
instructions: Place mango, pineapple, acai, water, and lime juice in a blender; pulse until smooth and creamy. Pour mixture into 2 bowls; sprinkle with shredded coconut and chia seeds. Drizzle with agave.

3841.title: Green Turmeric Smoothie
3841.description: This green smoothie is full of superfood ingredients like turmeric, spinach, almond butter, hemp hearts, maca, and chia seeds.
instructions: Place coconut milk, spinach, mango, banana, beet, coconut oil, parsley, turmeric, almond butter, maca powder, hemp hearts, chia seeds, bee pollen, cinnamon, ground ginger, salt, and pepper in a high-speed blender (such as Vitamix®). Blend until smooth.

3842.title: Vanilla Banamango Smoothie
3842.description: Combine a frozen banana, a mango, and a few other ingredients and make a tasty blended smoothie for breakfast or a snack.
ingredients: 0.25 cup orange juice, or to taste
instructions: Pour orange juice into the pitcher of a blender and add mango, frozen banana, carrots, vanilla yogurt, ice cubes, and ginger. Pulse several times to crush ice, then blend until smooth, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

3843.title: P.O.M. Spritzer
3843.description: This blend of pomelo, orange, and mango juice plus club soda makes a lovely non-alcoholic addition to a spring or summer brunch! P.O.M. is an abbreviation for the 3 fruits included.
instructions: Peel pomelo and separate the fruit from the pith. Place fruit segments into a high performance blender (such as a Vitamix®). Blend on variable 1, quickly switching to variable 10. Blend for 1 minute.
Peel mango, remove pit, and cut into slices. Add to the blender and blend for another minute.
Cut oranges in half and squeeze juice into a small container. Strain to remove pulp, if desired, and pour juice into the blender. Add club soda and blend on high speed for 1 minute. Serve chilled.

3844.title: Spinach and Banana Power Smoothie
3844.description: This vegan banana spinach smoothie provides a dairy-free and protein-rich pick-me-up that tastes delicious. It's easy to blend and take anywhere.
instructions: Blend soy milk and spinach together in a blender until smooth. Add banana and pulse until thoroughly blended.

3845.title: Spinach and Kale Smoothie
3845.description: This vibrant spinach and kale smoothie gives you an extra boost of energy thanks to the addition of peanut butter, banana, and chia seeds.
instructions: Combine spinach, almond milk, kale, peanut butter, and chia seeds in a blender; blend until smooth. Add banana and blend until smooth.

3846.title: Healthy Berry and Spinach Smoothie
3846.description: This spinach berry smoothie recipe gives kids and adults a hearty helping of vegetables and fruit. It's healthy, delicious, and easy to make.
ingredients: 0.25 cup fresh spinach, or to taste
instructions: Blend berries, yogurt, orange juice, spinach, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3847.title: Kale and Banana Smoothie
3847.description: This kale smoothie with banana is perfect to help get your daily fruits and veggies. Nutrient-rich kale is mixed in with this tasty, easy smoothie.
instructions: Place kale, banana, soy milk, flax seeds, and maple syrup into a blender. Cover and purée until smooth. Serve over ice.

3848.title: Banana, Avocado, and Spinach Smoothie
3848.description: This banana, avocado, and spinach smoothie recipe makes a quick and easy breakfast or snack that is perfect for a healthy, delicious meal on-the-go.
instructions: Blend banana, avocado, spinach, milk, ice cubes, honey, and vanilla together in a blender until smooth.

3849.title: Green Monster Smoothie
3849.description: Banana, spinach, and peanut butter blend with yogurt and milk for a power-packed smoothie.
instructions: Blend milk, yogurt, banana, peanut butter, spinach, and ice cubes until smooth.

3850.title: Pumpkin Spice Protein Drink
3850.description: This quick and easy pumpkin spice protein drink will fill you up and is perfect for when you're on-the-go.
instructions: Blend almond milk, bananas, pumpkin, dates, protein powder, vanilla extract, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, and ginger together in a blender until smooth.

3851.title: Green Power Oat Smoothie
3851.description: This nourishing smoothie is packed with spinach, parsley, green apple, oats, coconut milk, and honey. A great way to start your day!
ingredients: 0.25 cup Quaker® Oats (Quick or Old Fashioned, uncooked)
1 cup baby spinach leaves, tightly packed
0.5 cup cored and chopped green apple
instructions: Place oats, coconut milk, spinach, parsley, apple, honey, lemon juice, and ice in a blender and blend until smooth.

3852.title: Watermelon Refreshing Green Smoothie
3852.description: Start your day with this watermelon spinach smoothie, a perfect combination of fruits and vegetables, ideal for a quick breakfast or snack!
ingredients: 0.5 apple - peeled, cored, and diced, or more to taste
instructions: Place watermelon in a blender; mix until liquefied. Add spinach, broccoli, cucumber, apple, and celery; blend until smooth.

3853.title: Sweet Potato and Banana Smoothie
3853.description: Sweet potato and banana are blended together with soy milk and cinnamon for a creamy and colorful sweet potato smoothie.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake sweet potato in the preheated oven until tender and cooked through, about 1 hour. Remove skin, then cool in the refrigerator 8 hours to overnight.
Blend sweet potato, banana, soy milk, and cinnamon together in a blender until smooth.

3854.title: Pumpkin Smoothie
3854.description: Frozen pumpkin purée, milk, brown sugar, and cinnamon are all you need to make this fall-ready pumpkin smoothie.
instructions: Place frozen pumpkin purée into a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in the microwave on high to soften, 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour milk into a blender. Add softened pumpkin purée, brown sugar, and cinnamon; blend until smooth.

3856.title: Vitamix Green Smoothie
3856.description: Use a Vitamix blender to mix up this wholesome green smoothie that's so fruity and delicious, you won't taste the spinach!
ingredients: 15 seedless red grapes, or more to taste
instructions: Pour water into a Vitamix blender. Add grapes, banana, pear, orange, spinach, ground flax seeds, and ice, in that order. Blend until smooth and creamy.

3857.title: Green Power Mojito Smoothie
3857.description: Spinach, pineapple, banana, and fresh mint leaves are blended to create this delicious, bright green smoothie with a taste similar to a mojito!
ingredients: 3 cups ice cubes, or as desired
2 cups baby spinach leaves, or to taste
10 fresh mint leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice, spinach, pineapple, water, banana, orange, mint, lemon juice, and lime juice in a blender until smooth.

3858.title: Kale, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3858.description: Kale in smoothies is all the rage. Try this kale peanut butter smoothie made with peanut butter and bananas in vanilla-flavored almond milk.
ingredients: 0.5 bunch kale - stems removed and discarded, leaves torn into bite-size pieces
4 cubes ice, or more if desired
instructions: Blend bananas, almond milk, kale, ice, and peanut butter in a blender until smooth.

3859.title: Kale Orange Banana Smoothie
3859.description: A fresh orange, a pair of ripe bananas, and a kale leaf are blended into a pudding-like smoothie for a wholesome breakfast drink.
ingredients: 1 leaf kale, torn into several pieces
instructions: Blend orange in a blender until mostly juice.
Add water and kale; blend again on High speed until kale is liquefied.
Break bananas into chunks and add to the blender. Start blending at a lower speed until banana is incorporated. Increase speed to blend the mixture into a pudding-like texture.

3860.title: Superfood Berry-Green Smoothie
3860.description: Almond milk, spinach greens, berries, seeds, and vanilla protein powder are blended together in this superfood smoothie sure to fill you up.
ingredients: 1 cup spinach, or more to taste
instructions: Place almond milk, clementine, raspberries, spinach, chia seeds, flaxseed meal, blueberries, and protein powder in a blender, respectively. Blend on high until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3861.title: Green Detox Smoothie
3861.description: Start your day off right with this recipe for a quick and easy green smoothie featuring spinach, avocado, apple, broccoli, and pineapple juice.
instructions: Blend pineapple juice, spinach, pear, apple, avocado, and broccoli florets together in a blender until smooth.

3862.title: Tropical Smoothie with Kale
3862.description: Kale provides a nice green color to this tropical smoothie made with pineapple and banana for a quick-and-easy breakfast made with a NutriBullet or blender.
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk, or as needed
instructions: Place pineapple, kale, and banana in a blender; add almond milk. Blend until smooth.

3863.title: Kale and Berries Breakfast Smoothie
3863.description: This green kale and berry smoothie with almonds is an easy way to get a couple of servings of fruit and vegetables at breakfast time!
instructions: Combine banana, berries, kale, orange juice, water, almonds, and yogurt in a blender; blend until smooth, about 20 to 30 seconds.

3864.title: Agua Fresca de Pina y Espinacas (Pineapple Spinach Agua Fresca)
3864.description: This aqua fresca with spinach and pineapple is refreshing, delicious, and healthy! Since fresh pineapple is very sweet on its own, the sweetener is not necessarily needed.
ingredients: 4 packets stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine pineapple, spinach, and sweetener in a blender. Add 2 cups water and blend until smooth.
Pour into a pitcher and add the remaining 4 cups water.

3865.title: Keto Avocado-Spinach Smoothie
3865.description: Here's the best keto smoothie on the internet: a no-fail, super-green blend of avocado and spinach, boosted with MCT oil, coconut milk, and vanilla powder.
ingredients: 0.5 cup water, or more as needed
0.5 medium avocado, pitted and scooped from shell
instructions: Combine coconut milk, water, ice cubes, avocado, spinach, erythritol, MCT oil, and vanilla powder in a blender. Blend until smooth.

3866.title: Quick Kale and Banana Smoothie
3866.description: Coconut milk, banana, and strawberries sweeten this deceptively delicious kale and banana smoothie.
ingredients: 0.5 cup frozen strawberries, or more to taste
instructions: Blend kale, banana, coconut milk, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3867.title: Supreme Green Smoothie
3867.description: This super green smoothie gets its sweetness from fresh fruit and a hint of honey from the almondmilk.
ingredients: 2 cups Almond Breeze Hint of Honey almondmilk
1 large kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in large blender container in order given. Cover; blend on high 15 to 20 seconds or until completely smooth. Pour into glasses.

3868.title: Pumpkin Banana Smoothie
3868.description: This pumpkin banana smoothie has a hint of cinnamon and brown sugar for a delicious on-the-go breakfast in the fall.
instructions: Spoon pumpkin puree into a resealable bag and freeze, 8 hours to overnight.
Remove pumpkin from freezer and allow to soften at room temperature, 5 to 10 minutes.
Pour milk into the blender; add pumpkin, banana, brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth, about 3 minutes.

3869.title: Carrot-Banana Smoothie
3869.description: Carrots, banana, red bell pepper, and cucumbers are blended with grapefruit juice in this refreshing, on-the-go smoothie ready in 15 minutes.
instructions: Combine banana, cucumbers, red bell pepper, grapefruit juice, and carrots in a blender; blend until smooth.
Fill a glass with ice and pour smoothie over ice.

3870.title: Sweet Beet Smoothie
3870.description: This refreshing smoothie with banana, pineapple, and avocado is a beautiful color thanks to the addition of raw beets.
instructions: Juice beets and green apples, including peels, in an electric juicer.
Combine apple-beet juice, avocado, pineapple, banana, and ice in a high-speed blender; blend until smooth.

3871.title: Orange-Pear Green Smoothie with Bok Choy
3871.description: With no added sugars, this is the green smoothie you need: a refreshing blend of bok choy, kale, orange, mint, pear, pineapple, and banana.
instructions: Combine pear, grapes, water, pineapple, banana, bok choy, kale, orange, ice, and mint in a large blender. Blend, starting on low speed and increasing to high, until smooth. Turn blender to liquefy setting for a smoother texture.

3872.title: Blueberry-Watermelon Smoothie
3872.description: Perfect for cooling down on hot summer days, this blueberry-watermelon smoothie blends fruit and spinach together for wholesome flavor.
instructions: Combine watermelon, blueberries, banana, and cucumber in an electric blender and blend well. Add spinach last and blend until smoothie gets creamy, about 30 seconds.

3873.title: Skinny Vegan Green Smoothie
3873.description: This skinny vegan green smoothie is the perfect start in the day with unsweetened almond milk, strawberries, banana, and 2 cups of fresh spinach!
instructions: Combine spinach, strawberries, banana, almond milk, and agave in a blender; blend until smooth.

3874.title: Protein Packed Spinach Smoothie
3874.description: Spinach pairs with pineapple, peaches, mango, strawberries, coconut, and a little tofu to create this tropically delicious protein-packed smoothie.
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened apple juice, or to taste
instructions: Place spinach, bananas, tofu, coconut, peaches, pineapple, mango, and strawberries, respectively, in a blender; pour in apple juice. Blend until desired consistency is reached, adding more apple juice as necessary.

3875.title: Spinach, Avocado, and Mango Smoothie
3875.description: A delicious thick and creamy smoothie with spinach, avocado, and mango. The addition of powdered lemonade mix produces a sweet and tangy drink.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon powdered lemonade mix (such as Country Time®)
1 packet stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine spinach, mango, avocado, powdered lemonade mix, sugar substitute, and water in a blender; blend until thick and frothy.

3876.title: Yam Smoothie
3876.description: This smoothie is a favorite in my family and is quick and easy to make. You could also use a large can of yams in place of cooking the fresh ones.
instructions: Prick yams with a fork, and place on a plate. Cook in the microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until tender. Cool, peel and dice.
Combine the yams, yogurt, milk, ice cubes, sugar and banana in the container of a blender. Blend until smooth.

3877.title: Grapefruit Smoothie
3877.description: This grapefruit smoothie made with spinach and ginger is a refreshing and energizing way to start the day.
instructions: Blend grapefruit, water, spinach, ice cubes, ginger, and flax seeds in a blender or NutriBullet® until smooth.

3878.title: Lean and Green
3878.description: Spinach, fruit, milk, and honey are blended together in this lean and green smoothie for a great start to the day or between meals.
instructions: Blend spinach, banana, apple, strawberries, mango, milk, protein powder, and honey together in a blender until smooth.

3879.title: Cool Kale Smoothie
3879.description: Fresh kale and green grapes are blended into a refreshing green smoothie perfect for on-the-go.
instructions: Blend grapes, kale, and ice together in a blender until smooth.

3880.title: Green Banana and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3880.description: A peanut butter and banana smoothie gets a hint of green thanks to spinach added to the mix. Blend into a rich and creamy breakfast or afternoon treat.
ingredients: 0.125 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste
1 cup rice milk, or as needed
instructions: Blend oats and almonds in a blender until powdery; add spinach, banana, yogurt, peanut butter, and cinnamon. Blend, gradually adding rice milk, until desired consistency is reached.

3881.title: Caribbean Health Drink
3881.description: Freshly-blended carrot, banana, kiwi, apple, and pineapple make this delicious beverage.
instructions: Blend the carrot, banana, kiwi, apple, pineapple, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth.

3882.title: Island Greens Smoothie
3882.description: This quick green smoothie provides what you need for a fruity, veggie snack--with spinach, banana, pineapple, and almondmilk.
ingredients: 0.75 cup Almond Breeze Original or Unsweetened Original almondmilk
instructions: Place all ingredients into blender and blend on high until smooth.

3883.title: Green Protein Smoothie
3883.description: This minty green smoothie is packed with protein from vanilla protein powder, spinach, soy milk, and almonds.
ingredients: 5 cubes ice, or more to taste
instructions: Combine soy milk, spinach, protein powder, mint leaves, almonds, and ice in a blender cup; blend until smooth.

3884.title: Don't Knock it Until You Try it Zucchini Chocolate Banana Nut Milkshake
3884.description: If you've been looking for a way to work zucchini into a smoothie, here is a recipe for you!
ingredients: 2 large ripe bananas, peeled and frozen
instructions: Blend the zucchini, bananas, cocoa powder, peanuts, sugar, and half and half in a food processor until smooth, thick, and creamy.

3885.title: Green Smoothie Bowl
3885.description: A green smoothie is topped with berries, chia seeds, granola, and coconut in this colorful and hearty green smoothie bowl.
instructions: Blend spinach, banana, coconut milk, mango, and coconut water in a blender until smooth. Pour smoothie into a bowl and top with raspberries, blueberries, granola, coconut flakes, almonds, and chia seeds.

3886.title: Spinach-Berry Smoothie
3886.description: If you're trying to add more spinach to your diet, try this yummy smoothie with blueberries, blackberries, and light sour cream. Feel free to use other berries to your liking.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Add spinach leaves to a blender and finely chop. Add berry juice, blueberries, sour cream, sugar, blackberries, and ice cubes. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later.

3887.title: Superfood Stevia Smoothie
3887.description: Make your morning super, with this superfood smoothie made with chia seeds and Stevia In The Raw.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets Stevia In The Raw®
instructions: In a blender, combine mango, kale, almond milk, orange juice, stevia, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth.

3888.title: Secret Ingredient Smoothie
3888.description: Romaine lettuce, milk, strawberries, and banana all blend together in this unique quick and easy smoothie.
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup milk, or more as needed
4 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon vanilla extract, or to taste
instructions: Put romaine lettuce into the bottom of a blender pitcher; add enough milk to cover completely and blend on High until smooth.

Drop one strawberry at a time into the blender while still running on High and allow the berry to blend completely before adding the next. Blend one banana chunk at a time into the mixture in the same manner as the strawberries. Thin the smoothie with additional milk to keep smoothie blending properly. Blend vanilla extract into the smoothie.

3889.title: Sesame Mango Smoothie
3889.description: Sesame seeds and cashew butter add a nice nutty flavor to this mango and spinach green smoothie that is a great on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer banana, mango, cucumber, spinach, cashew butter, and sesame seeds in a blender, in the order mentioned; add water. Blend until smoothie is desired consistency, adding more water if desired.

3890.title: Dairy-Free Pumpkin Spice Smoothie
3890.description: Pumpkin puree, banana, and almond milk with a touch of spice make an easy and delicious, dairy-free breakfast smoothie.
ingredients: 0.75 cup almond milk, or more as needed
instructions: Place almond milk, pumpkin puree, banana, protein powder, and pumpkin pie spice in a blender. Blend until smooth, 15 to 30 seconds. If mixture is too thick, add more almond milk or water to achieve desired consistency.

3891.title: Healthy Fruit and Vegetable Smoothie
3891.description: This fruit and vegetable smoothie, made with berries, banana, kale, and spinach, is a great way to start your day or drink post-workout.
instructions: Combine milk, yogurt, strawberries, banana, blueberries, green ice cube, whey, and honey in a blender, in the order listed. Blend until smooth.

3892.title: Cucumber-Honeydew Smoothie
3892.description: Cucumber and honeydew melon combine with passion fruit juice and fresh mint in a creative smoothie that's guaranteed refreshing on a sultry summer day.
ingredients: 8 sprigs fresh mint, or amount to taste
instructions: Combine cucumber, honeydew melon, passion fruit juice, and ice in a blender. Pull leaves from mint springs and add to blender. Blend mixture until smooth. Pour into tall glasses.

3893.title: Lean Green Smoothie
3893.description: Honeydew melon, grapes, cucumber, and maybe a few pieces of broccoli make up this green, and slightly minty, summer drink.
ingredients: 3 cups honeydew melon - peeled, seeded and cubed
instructions: Place the honeydew melon, ice cubes, grapes, cucumber, broccoli, and mint into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth.

3894.title: Lemon Coconut Cleanser
3894.description: Fresh lemon, zucchini, spinach, and mango chunks are blended into this quick and easy smooth coconut cleanser with bright citrus flavor.
ingredients: 4 ice cubes, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango chunks, lemon, spinach, zucchini, water, ice cubes, and coconut oil in a high-speed blender; blend until smooth.

3895.title: Green Slime Smoothie
3895.description: This is yummy. With a name like this, your kids will love it.
instructions: Place the spinach in the freezer until frozen, at least 1 hour.
Combine the spinach, strawberries, banana, honey, and ice in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

3896.title: Virgin Mary Smoothies
3896.description: Perfect for starting your weekend off right, this smoothie is a virgin version of your favorite Bloody Mary Cocktail.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish, or more to taste
instructions: Blend tomatoes, celery, carrot, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish, and hot sauce in a blender until very smooth. Add ice cubes and blend until smooth.

3897.title: Pumpkin Peanut Butter Smoothie
3897.description: Banana, peanut butter, yogurt, and strawberries are blended together in this pumpkin smoothie for a taste of autumn to start your day.
ingredients: 3 whole frozen strawberries, or more to taste
0.25 cup whipped cream, or more to taste
instructions: Blend banana, strawberries, milk, yogurt, pumpkin puree, peanut butter, brown sugar, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, and nutmeg in a blender until smooth; add ice cubes and again blend until smooth. Pour smoothie into 4 glasses and top with whipped cream and a pinch of cinnamon.

3898.title: Beet-Red Raspberry Smoothie
3898.description: This brightly colored smoothie with raspberries, grapes, carrots, and beets is a meal in itself--and it's ready to serve in just minutes.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) container lemon non-fat Greek yogurt
instructions: Place all ingredients in Oster® Versa® Performance Blender in order listed.
Select programmed SMOOTHIE setting.
Serve immediately.

3899.title: Pumpkin Apple Pie Smoothie
3899.description: Experience the warm flavors of fall any time of the year with this pumpkin-apple pie smoothie. Top with crushed graham crackers, pecans, granola, or whipped cream if desired.
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons brown sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place apple in a plastic microwave-safe bowl; pour in enough water to cover 1/4-inch of the bottom of bowl. Partially cover bowl with a lid or paper towel. Microwave in 1 minute intervals until apple is softened, 2 to 3 minutes. Freeze apple in the same container with water until solid, 2 hours to overnight.
Blend frozen apple, almond milk, and pumpkin puree in a blender until smooth; add brown sugar and pumpkin pie spice. Blend until smooth. Add ice and blend until smooth.

3900.title: The Best Green Smoothie
3900.description: If you're looking for an easy, wholesome green smoothie packed with plant-based ingredients, look no further!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh blueberries, or to taste
instructions: Place apple, spinach, and chia seeds into a blender. Add almond milk and cinnamon and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and top with blueberries.

3901.title: Green Monster - Spinach Smoothie
3901.description: This banana and spinach smoothie is extra creamy thanks to yogurt added to the mix for a quick and easy, on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer yogurt, banana, and blueberries in a blender, respectively. Add as much spinach to blender that will fit; pour in water. Blend on high speed until smooth, adding the remaining spinach if needed. Add ice for a colder and thicker smoothie. Add more water for a thinner smoothie.

3902.title: Pumpkin Shake
3902.description: Use canned pumpkin puree, frozen banana, and Greek-style yogurt to make this quick breakfast smoothie.
ingredients: 4 cubes ice, or more if desired
instructions: Blend ice, milk, pumpkin puree, yogurt, banana, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, allspice, and vanilla in a blender until smooth.

3903.title: Green Smoothie with Ginger
3903.description: This yummy green smoothie with apple and pear gets a little tang from lemon juice and a spicy aroma from fresh ginger.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, or to taste
instructions: Combine spinach, 1 cup water, apple, pear, lemon juice, flaxseed, and ginger in a blender. Puree until smooth, adding more water if needed.

3904.title: Easy Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
3904.description: All the goodness of a pumpkin pie is blended into a smoothie and topped with crushed cinnamon graham cracker crumbs.
ingredients: 1 cinnamon graham cracker, crushed and divided
instructions: Blend almond milk, pumpkin, ice cubes, banana, brown sugar, 1/2 the crushed cinnamon graham cracker, wheat germ, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice, and cinnamon together in a blender until smooth. Garnish individual servings with remaining graham cracker crumbs.

3905.title: Pineapple Carrot Smoothie
3905.description: A pineapple and carrot smoothie with hemp seeds, ginger, and coconut milk is a hearty and spicy way to start your day.
instructions: Place banana, pineapple, carrot, hemp seeds, ginger, orange zest, cinnamon, coconut milk, and water in a blender in the order listed; blend on high until creamy and smooth.

3906.title: Vegan Kale Smoothie
3906.description: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, banana, and almond-coconut milk for a delicious and nutritious vegan green smoothie the whole family (including your kids!) will love.
ingredients: 1 cup almond-coconut milk, or more if needed
instructions: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, 1 cup almond-coconut milk, banana, chia seeds, and flax seed in a high-performance blender (such as Vitamix®); blend until smooth. Add more coconut milk beverage if mixture is too thick.

3907.title: Spinach and Banana Power Smoothie
3907.description: This vegan banana spinach smoothie provides a dairy-free and protein-rich pick-me-up that tastes delicious. It's easy to blend and take anywhere.
instructions: Blend soy milk and spinach together in a blender until smooth. Add banana and pulse until thoroughly blended.

3908.title: Spinach and Kale Smoothie
3908.description: This vibrant spinach and kale smoothie gives you an extra boost of energy thanks to the addition of peanut butter, banana, and chia seeds.
instructions: Combine spinach, almond milk, kale, peanut butter, and chia seeds in a blender; blend until smooth. Add banana and blend until smooth.

3909.title: Healthy Berry and Spinach Smoothie
3909.description: This spinach berry smoothie recipe gives kids and adults a hearty helping of vegetables and fruit. It's healthy, delicious, and easy to make.
ingredients: 0.25 cup fresh spinach, or to taste
instructions: Blend berries, yogurt, orange juice, spinach, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3910.title: Kale and Banana Smoothie
3910.description: This kale smoothie with banana is perfect to help get your daily fruits and veggies. Nutrient-rich kale is mixed in with this tasty, easy smoothie.
instructions: Place kale, banana, soy milk, flax seeds, and maple syrup into a blender. Cover and purée until smooth. Serve over ice.

3911.title: Banana, Avocado, and Spinach Smoothie
3911.description: This banana, avocado, and spinach smoothie recipe makes a quick and easy breakfast or snack that is perfect for a healthy, delicious meal on-the-go.
instructions: Blend banana, avocado, spinach, milk, ice cubes, honey, and vanilla together in a blender until smooth.

3912.title: Green Monster Smoothie
3912.description: Banana, spinach, and peanut butter blend with yogurt and milk for a power-packed smoothie.
instructions: Blend milk, yogurt, banana, peanut butter, spinach, and ice cubes until smooth.

3913.title: Green Power Oat Smoothie
3913.description: This nourishing smoothie is packed with spinach, parsley, green apple, oats, coconut milk, and honey. A great way to start your day!
ingredients: 0.25 cup Quaker® Oats (Quick or Old Fashioned, uncooked)
1 cup baby spinach leaves, tightly packed
0.5 cup cored and chopped green apple
instructions: Place oats, coconut milk, spinach, parsley, apple, honey, lemon juice, and ice in a blender and blend until smooth.

3914.title: Watermelon Refreshing Green Smoothie
3914.description: Start your day with this watermelon spinach smoothie, a perfect combination of fruits and vegetables, ideal for a quick breakfast or snack!
ingredients: 0.5 apple - peeled, cored, and diced, or more to taste
instructions: Place watermelon in a blender; mix until liquefied. Add spinach, broccoli, cucumber, apple, and celery; blend until smooth.

3916.title: Vitamix Green Smoothie
3916.description: Use a Vitamix blender to mix up this wholesome green smoothie that's so fruity and delicious, you won't taste the spinach!
ingredients: 15 seedless red grapes, or more to taste
instructions: Pour water into a Vitamix blender. Add grapes, banana, pear, orange, spinach, ground flax seeds, and ice, in that order. Blend until smooth and creamy.

3917.title: Green Power Mojito Smoothie
3917.description: Spinach, pineapple, banana, and fresh mint leaves are blended to create this delicious, bright green smoothie with a taste similar to a mojito!
ingredients: 3 cups ice cubes, or as desired
2 cups baby spinach leaves, or to taste
10 fresh mint leaves, or more to taste
instructions: Blend ice, spinach, pineapple, water, banana, orange, mint, lemon juice, and lime juice in a blender until smooth.

3918.title: Kale, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3918.description: Kale in smoothies is all the rage. Try this kale peanut butter smoothie made with peanut butter and bananas in vanilla-flavored almond milk.
ingredients: 0.5 bunch kale - stems removed and discarded, leaves torn into bite-size pieces
4 cubes ice, or more if desired
instructions: Blend bananas, almond milk, kale, ice, and peanut butter in a blender until smooth.

3919.title: Kale Orange Banana Smoothie
3919.description: A fresh orange, a pair of ripe bananas, and a kale leaf are blended into a pudding-like smoothie for a wholesome breakfast drink.
ingredients: 1 leaf kale, torn into several pieces
instructions: Blend orange in a blender until mostly juice.
Add water and kale; blend again on High speed until kale is liquefied.
Break bananas into chunks and add to the blender. Start blending at a lower speed until banana is incorporated. Increase speed to blend the mixture into a pudding-like texture.

3920.title: Superfood Berry-Green Smoothie
3920.description: Almond milk, spinach greens, berries, seeds, and vanilla protein powder are blended together in this superfood smoothie sure to fill you up.
ingredients: 1 cup spinach, or more to taste
instructions: Place almond milk, clementine, raspberries, spinach, chia seeds, flaxseed meal, blueberries, and protein powder in a blender, respectively. Blend on high until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3921.title: Green Detox Smoothie
3921.description: Start your day off right with this recipe for a quick and easy green smoothie featuring spinach, avocado, apple, broccoli, and pineapple juice.
instructions: Blend pineapple juice, spinach, pear, apple, avocado, and broccoli florets together in a blender until smooth.

3922.title: Tropical Smoothie with Kale
3922.description: Kale provides a nice green color to this tropical smoothie made with pineapple and banana for a quick-and-easy breakfast made with a NutriBullet or blender.
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk, or as needed
instructions: Place pineapple, kale, and banana in a blender; add almond milk. Blend until smooth.

3923.title: Kale and Berries Breakfast Smoothie
3923.description: This green kale and berry smoothie with almonds is an easy way to get a couple of servings of fruit and vegetables at breakfast time!
instructions: Combine banana, berries, kale, orange juice, water, almonds, and yogurt in a blender; blend until smooth, about 20 to 30 seconds.

3924.title: Agua Fresca de Pina y Espinacas (Pineapple Spinach Agua Fresca)
3924.description: This aqua fresca with spinach and pineapple is refreshing, delicious, and healthy! Since fresh pineapple is very sweet on its own, the sweetener is not necessarily needed.
ingredients: 4 packets stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine pineapple, spinach, and sweetener in a blender. Add 2 cups water and blend until smooth.
Pour into a pitcher and add the remaining 4 cups water.

3925.title: Keto Avocado-Spinach Smoothie
3925.description: Here's the best keto smoothie on the internet: a no-fail, super-green blend of avocado and spinach, boosted with MCT oil, coconut milk, and vanilla powder.
ingredients: 0.5 cup water, or more as needed
0.5 medium avocado, pitted and scooped from shell
instructions: Combine coconut milk, water, ice cubes, avocado, spinach, erythritol, MCT oil, and vanilla powder in a blender. Blend until smooth.

3926.title: Quick Kale and Banana Smoothie
3926.description: Coconut milk, banana, and strawberries sweeten this deceptively delicious kale and banana smoothie.
ingredients: 0.5 cup frozen strawberries, or more to taste
instructions: Blend kale, banana, coconut milk, and strawberries together in a blender until smooth.

3927.title: Supreme Green Smoothie
3927.description: This super green smoothie gets its sweetness from fresh fruit and a hint of honey from the almondmilk.
ingredients: 2 cups Almond Breeze Hint of Honey almondmilk
1 large kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in large blender container in order given. Cover; blend on high 15 to 20 seconds or until completely smooth. Pour into glasses.

3928.title: Orange-Pear Green Smoothie with Bok Choy
3928.description: With no added sugars, this is the green smoothie you need: a refreshing blend of bok choy, kale, orange, mint, pear, pineapple, and banana.
instructions: Combine pear, grapes, water, pineapple, banana, bok choy, kale, orange, ice, and mint in a large blender. Blend, starting on low speed and increasing to high, until smooth. Turn blender to liquefy setting for a smoother texture.

3929.title: Blueberry-Watermelon Smoothie
3929.description: Perfect for cooling down on hot summer days, this blueberry-watermelon smoothie blends fruit and spinach together for wholesome flavor.
instructions: Combine watermelon, blueberries, banana, and cucumber in an electric blender and blend well. Add spinach last and blend until smoothie gets creamy, about 30 seconds.

3930.title: Skinny Vegan Green Smoothie
3930.description: This skinny vegan green smoothie is the perfect start in the day with unsweetened almond milk, strawberries, banana, and 2 cups of fresh spinach!
instructions: Combine spinach, strawberries, banana, almond milk, and agave in a blender; blend until smooth.

3931.title: Protein Packed Spinach Smoothie
3931.description: Spinach pairs with pineapple, peaches, mango, strawberries, coconut, and a little tofu to create this tropically delicious protein-packed smoothie.
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened apple juice, or to taste
instructions: Place spinach, bananas, tofu, coconut, peaches, pineapple, mango, and strawberries, respectively, in a blender; pour in apple juice. Blend until desired consistency is reached, adding more apple juice as necessary.

3932.title: Spinach, Avocado, and Mango Smoothie
3932.description: A delicious thick and creamy smoothie with spinach, avocado, and mango. The addition of powdered lemonade mix produces a sweet and tangy drink.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon powdered lemonade mix (such as Country Time®)
1 packet stevia sugar substitute (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine spinach, mango, avocado, powdered lemonade mix, sugar substitute, and water in a blender; blend until thick and frothy.

3933.title: Grapefruit Smoothie
3933.description: This grapefruit smoothie made with spinach and ginger is a refreshing and energizing way to start the day.
instructions: Blend grapefruit, water, spinach, ice cubes, ginger, and flax seeds in a blender or NutriBullet® until smooth.

3934.title: Lean and Green
3934.description: Spinach, fruit, milk, and honey are blended together in this lean and green smoothie for a great start to the day or between meals.
instructions: Blend spinach, banana, apple, strawberries, mango, milk, protein powder, and honey together in a blender until smooth.

3935.title: Cool Kale Smoothie
3935.description: Fresh kale and green grapes are blended into a refreshing green smoothie perfect for on-the-go.
instructions: Blend grapes, kale, and ice together in a blender until smooth.

3936.title: Green Banana and Peanut Butter Smoothie
3936.description: A peanut butter and banana smoothie gets a hint of green thanks to spinach added to the mix. Blend into a rich and creamy breakfast or afternoon treat.
ingredients: 0.125 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste
1 cup rice milk, or as needed
instructions: Blend oats and almonds in a blender until powdery; add spinach, banana, yogurt, peanut butter, and cinnamon. Blend, gradually adding rice milk, until desired consistency is reached.

3937.title: Island Greens Smoothie
3937.description: This quick green smoothie provides what you need for a fruity, veggie snack--with spinach, banana, pineapple, and almondmilk.
ingredients: 0.75 cup Almond Breeze Original or Unsweetened Original almondmilk
instructions: Place all ingredients into blender and blend on high until smooth.

3938.title: Green Protein Smoothie
3938.description: This minty green smoothie is packed with protein from vanilla protein powder, spinach, soy milk, and almonds.
ingredients: 5 cubes ice, or more to taste
instructions: Combine soy milk, spinach, protein powder, mint leaves, almonds, and ice in a blender cup; blend until smooth.

3939.title: Green Smoothie Bowl
3939.description: A green smoothie is topped with berries, chia seeds, granola, and coconut in this colorful and hearty green smoothie bowl.
instructions: Blend spinach, banana, coconut milk, mango, and coconut water in a blender until smooth. Pour smoothie into a bowl and top with raspberries, blueberries, granola, coconut flakes, almonds, and chia seeds.

3940.title: Spinach-Berry Smoothie
3940.description: If you're trying to add more spinach to your diet, try this yummy smoothie with blueberries, blackberries, and light sour cream. Feel free to use other berries to your liking.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Add spinach leaves to a blender and finely chop. Add berry juice, blueberries, sour cream, sugar, blackberries, and ice cubes. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately or refrigerate for later.

3941.title: Superfood Stevia Smoothie
3941.description: Make your morning super, with this superfood smoothie made with chia seeds and Stevia In The Raw.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets Stevia In The Raw®
instructions: In a blender, combine mango, kale, almond milk, orange juice, stevia, and chia seeds. Blend until smooth.

3942.title: Secret Ingredient Smoothie
3942.description: Romaine lettuce, milk, strawberries, and banana all blend together in this unique quick and easy smoothie.
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup milk, or more as needed
4 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon vanilla extract, or to taste
instructions: Put romaine lettuce into the bottom of a blender pitcher; add enough milk to cover completely and blend on High until smooth.

Drop one strawberry at a time into the blender while still running on High and allow the berry to blend completely before adding the next. Blend one banana chunk at a time into the mixture in the same manner as the strawberries. Thin the smoothie with additional milk to keep smoothie blending properly. Blend vanilla extract into the smoothie.

3943.title: Sesame Mango Smoothie
3943.description: Sesame seeds and cashew butter add a nice nutty flavor to this mango and spinach green smoothie that is a great on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer banana, mango, cucumber, spinach, cashew butter, and sesame seeds in a blender, in the order mentioned; add water. Blend until smoothie is desired consistency, adding more water if desired.

3944.title: Healthy Fruit and Vegetable Smoothie
3944.description: This fruit and vegetable smoothie, made with berries, banana, kale, and spinach, is a great way to start your day or drink post-workout.
instructions: Combine milk, yogurt, strawberries, banana, blueberries, green ice cube, whey, and honey in a blender, in the order listed. Blend until smooth.

3945.title: Lemon Coconut Cleanser
3945.description: Fresh lemon, zucchini, spinach, and mango chunks are blended into this quick and easy smooth coconut cleanser with bright citrus flavor.
ingredients: 4 ice cubes, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango chunks, lemon, spinach, zucchini, water, ice cubes, and coconut oil in a high-speed blender; blend until smooth.

3946.title: Green Slime Smoothie
3946.description: This is yummy. With a name like this, your kids will love it.
instructions: Place the spinach in the freezer until frozen, at least 1 hour.
Combine the spinach, strawberries, banana, honey, and ice in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

3947.title: The Best Green Smoothie
3947.description: If you're looking for an easy, wholesome green smoothie packed with plant-based ingredients, look no further!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh blueberries, or to taste
instructions: Place apple, spinach, and chia seeds into a blender. Add almond milk and cinnamon and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and top with blueberries.

3948.title: Green Monster - Spinach Smoothie
3948.description: This banana and spinach smoothie is extra creamy thanks to yogurt added to the mix for a quick and easy, on-the-go breakfast.
instructions: Layer yogurt, banana, and blueberries in a blender, respectively. Add as much spinach to blender that will fit; pour in water. Blend on high speed until smooth, adding the remaining spinach if needed. Add ice for a colder and thicker smoothie. Add more water for a thinner smoothie.

3949.title: Green Smoothie with Ginger
3949.description: This yummy green smoothie with apple and pear gets a little tang from lemon juice and a spicy aroma from fresh ginger.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, or to taste
instructions: Combine spinach, 1 cup water, apple, pear, lemon juice, flaxseed, and ginger in a blender. Puree until smooth, adding more water if needed.

3950.title: Vegan Kale Smoothie
3950.description: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, banana, and almond-coconut milk for a delicious and nutritious vegan green smoothie the whole family (including your kids!) will love.
ingredients: 1 cup almond-coconut milk, or more if needed
instructions: Combine kale, mango, pineapple, 1 cup almond-coconut milk, banana, chia seeds, and flax seed in a high-performance blender (such as Vitamix®); blend until smooth. Add more coconut milk beverage if mixture is too thick.

3951.title: Iced Green Smoothie
3951.description: This nutrient-packed green juice gets its color from spinach and its taste from apple, banana, and a bit of lemon juice.
ingredients: 0.5 medium apple - peeled, cored, and cut into chunks
instructions: Fill a glass with ice.
Blend spinach and water until smooth. Add apple, banana, and lemon juice; blend to desired consistency. Pour over ice.

3952.title: Any Way You Want It Kale Smoothie
3952.description: Packed with kale, banana, milk, yogurt, and sweetened with a bit of maple syrup or honey, this kale smoothie is as delicious as it is versatile!
ingredients: 3 frozen strawberries, or more to taste
instructions: Blend kale, yogurt, and peanuts together in a blender until smooth. Add milk, banana, strawberries, and maple syrup and blend until desired consistency is reached.

3953.title: Detox Smoothie
3953.description: Blueberries, spinach, soy milk, and a Granny Smith apple are blended together to make this breakfast detox smoothie full of green goodness.
instructions: Combine Granny Smith apple, spinach, blueberries, soy milk, and ice cubes in a blender; blend until smooth.

3954.title: The Drink by Will
3954.description: This green smoothie with tomato, radishes, spirulina powder, and carrot is a savory way to start the day.
instructions: Pour water into a blender. Add tomato, carrot, kale, radishes, lemon, spirulina powder; top with ice cubes. Blend vegetable mixture until smooth.

3955.title: Apple and Kale Smoothie
3955.description: Instead of refueling with a sugary sports drink, try this energizing combination of protein-rich cottage cheese, wholesome kale and applesauce.
ingredients: 1 cup Nordica 1% or Fat Free Cottage Cheese
1 cup chopped frozen kale or spinach
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, applesauce, kale, banana, water, ice, lemon juice, vanilla (if using) and cinnamon in a blender. Blend on high speed for 2 minutes or until very smooth. Serve immediately.

3956.title: Easy and Tasty Green Smoothie
3956.description: This tasty green smoothie with spinach, fruit, and flaxseed is perfect for breakfast or a midday snack.
ingredients: 1 medium navel orange, peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Combine water, spinach, orange chunks, banana, and flaxseed in a blender; process until smooth, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

3957.title: Frozen Pineapple and Spinach Smoothie
3957.description: Fresh baby spinach, vegan yogurt and milk, and chia seeds provide wholesome flavor to this frozen pineapple smoothie for two.
ingredients: 1 cup lightly packed baby spinach leaves
instructions: Thaw frozen pineapple chunks for 5 minutes.
Combine pineapple chunks, spinach, yogurt, milk, and chia seeds in an electric blender and process until smooth, about 2 minutes.

3958.title: Delicious Fruity Green Smoothie
3958.description: This delicious green smoothie has pineapple, mango, banana, blueberries, and greens of your choice and takes just minutes to make.
instructions: Combine kale and water in a blender; process until no chunks remain. Add banana, blueberries, pineapple, and mango; blend until smooth.

3959.title: Wild Pina Colada Green Smoothie
3959.description: This pina colada green smoothie is loaded with pineapple, coconut, dandelion greens, and cashews delivering a taste of the tropics.
ingredients: 0.25 cup chopped pitted dates, or more to taste
instructions: Blend pineapple, coconut water, ice cubes, dandelion greens, coconut, cashews, and dates in a blender until smooth and creamy.

3960.title: Ann's Berry Green Smoothie
3960.description: Blueberries, strawberries, and spinach are blended with milk and honey creating a quick and easy, on-the-go strawberry smoothie.
ingredients: 1.5 cups fresh spinach, or to taste
instructions: Place strawberries in a bowl; add warm water.
Blend milk and spinach together in a blender until smooth. Add blueberries, banana, and honey and blend until smooth. Add strawberries-water mixture and lemon juice and blend until smooth.

3961.title: Fruity Green Matcha Smoothie
3961.description: Blended with mango, spinach, and strawberries, this matcha smoothie makes a healthy, filling breakfast or on-the-go snack.
instructions: Combine milk, yogurt, strawberries, mangos, matcha, honey, and spinach in a blender, in that order. Process until smooth. Make sure you don't over-blend, this can affect the quality of your smoothie!

3962.title: Good Morning Green Smoothie
3962.description: Packed with vegetables and fruit, this gluten-free and dairy-free green smoothie is a powerful way to start the day.
instructions: Blend water, romaine lettuce, cucumber, avocado, celery, spinach, and lemon juice together in a blender on high until smooth, about 30 seconds. Add ice, apple, and banana to blender and blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3963.title: Matcha-Berry Swirl Smoothie
3963.description: This quick and easy smoothie is packed with colorful fruits and vegetables and blended with matcha green tea powder to energize every sip.
instructions: Combine spinach, 1 cup orange juice, peaches, pineapple, 1 halved banana, and green tea powder in a blender; blend until combined. Pour smoothie into a glass.
Rinse out the blender.
Combine 1 cup orange juice, raspberries, strawberries, and 1 halved banana in the blender; blend until combined. Pour berry smoothie into a separate glass.
Combine smoothies by pouring them at the same time from opposite sides of the serving glass.

3964.title: My Green Protein Smoothie
3964.description: Packed with healthy ingredients like kale, spinach, and fruit, this green smoothie is great as a snack but also works for a pre- or post-workout meal.
instructions: Combine kale, spinach, strawberries, yogurt, banana, apple, and protein powder in a blender; pulse on low speed until ingredients are broken up and gently mixed. Increase to high speed, and blend until smooth and greens are broken down, 30 to 60 seconds.
Taste and add sugar if you like.

3965.title: Green Turmeric Smoothie
3965.description: This green smoothie is full of superfood ingredients like turmeric, spinach, almond butter, hemp hearts, maca, and chia seeds.
instructions: Place coconut milk, spinach, mango, banana, beet, coconut oil, parsley, turmeric, almond butter, maca powder, hemp hearts, chia seeds, bee pollen, cinnamon, ground ginger, salt, and pepper in a high-speed blender (such as Vitamix®). Blend until smooth.

3966.title: Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
3966.description: A blueberry and banana smoothie is topped with coconut and almonds in this quick and easy blueberry smoothie bowl recipe.
instructions: Blend blueberries, 1/2 banana, water, cashew butter, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl.
Top smoothie with sliced banana, almonds, and coconut.

3967.title: Acai Bowl
3967.description: Acai berry sorbet is topped with granola, strawberries, and banana this the fruity recipe for an acai bowl similar to those found in Hawaii.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons unsweetened coconut flakes, or as desired
instructions: Place acai sorbet in a bowl and top with a layer of granola. Line strawberry and banana slices on granola layer and top with coconut flakes and a drizzle of honey.

3968.title: Overnight Oats Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
3968.description: Overnight oats and blueberries are blended and topped with coconut and chia seeds in this colorful smoothie bowl recipe.
ingredients: 1.25 cups unsweetened vanilla-flavored almond milk, divided
1 teaspoon maple syrup, or to taste
instructions: Combine oats and 2/3 cup almond milk in a bowl; cover and refrigerate until milk is absorbed by oats, 8 hours to overnight.
Combine oats-almond milk mixture, remaining almond milk, banana, blueberries, vanilla, and maple syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.
Pour smoothie into 2 bowls, then top with coconut, blueberries, and chia seeds.

3969.title: Easy Acai Smoothie Bowl
3969.description: Try this easy acai smoothie bowl with bananas, blueberries and almond milk. Garnish with berries, nuts, or granola to your liking.
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp, partially defrosted in refrigerator overnight
0.75 cup almond milk, or more as needed
2 tablespoons fresh blueberries, or to taste
1 tablespoon pomegranate seeds, or to taste
1 tablespoon large coconut flakes, or to taste
instructions: Combine acai, bananas, blueberries, almond milk, and honey in a blender. Blend until smooth. Smoothie should have a thick consistency, like frozen yogurt.
Pour into 2 bowls and top with banana slices, blueberries, pomegranate seeds, and coconut.

3970.title: Acai Mango Smoothie Bowl
3970.description: Acai, mango, almond milk, oats, and chia seeds make a fantastic smoothie bowl for 2, just in time to start the day with something delicious.
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
instructions: Place almond milk, mango, bananas, rolled oats, and acai pulp in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour into 2 bowls and top with chia seeds and drizzle with maple syrup.

3971.title: Backyard Berry Bowl
3971.description: A berry smoothie is topped with more berries, banana, and granola in this quick and easy smoothie bowl.
ingredients: 1 cup ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Blend ice, 1/2 cup strawberries, 1 banana, blackberries, and apple juice together in a blender until smooth, adding more ice depending on your desired consistency. Pour smoothie into a bowl.
Top smoothie with remaining strawberries, remaining banana, blueberries, and granola. Drizzle honey over the top.

3972.title: Green Smoothie Bowl
3972.description: A green smoothie is topped with berries, chia seeds, granola, and coconut in this colorful and hearty green smoothie bowl.
instructions: Blend spinach, banana, coconut milk, mango, and coconut water in a blender until smooth. Pour smoothie into a bowl and top with raspberries, blueberries, granola, coconut flakes, almonds, and chia seeds.

3973.title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
3973.description: A strawberry-pineapple smoothie is topped with blueberries, raspberries, almonds, and granola in this tasty berry smoothie bowl.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons frozen acai berry pulp, or as desired
instructions: Blend strawberries, pineapple, yogurt, coconut water, and acai pulp in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl. Top smoothie with kiwi, banana, blueberries, raspberries, almonds, granola, and chia seeds.

3974.title: Banana Coconut Smoothie Bowl
3974.description: This banana and peach smoothie is topped with coconut, almonds, and raisins creating a paleo-friendly smoothie bowl for a quick breakfast.
instructions: Blend 1/2 banana, peaches, applesauce, water, and coconut oil together in a blender until smooth; pour into a serving bowl.
Slice remaining half banana and arrange on top of smoothie. Add shredded coconut, almonds, and raisins.

3975.title: Protein Smoothie Bowl with Berries, Chocolate Chips, and Granola
3975.description: This quick and easy smoothie bowl features protein powder, strawberries, blueberries, chocolate chips, and granola. A great way to start the day!
instructions: Combine strawberries, milk, 1/3 cup granola, blueberries, protein powder, and vanilla in a blender; blend until smooth.
Layer 1/2 of the chocolate chips on the bottom of a bowl. Pour smoothie over top, then sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips and remaining granola.

3976.title: Mango Smoothie Bowl
3976.description: This easy mango smoothie bowl with banana and coconut milk is a great start into the day. You can change up the fruit for garnish to your liking.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk, or to taste
1 teaspoon agave syrup, or to taste
1 tablespoon coconut flakes, or more to taste
6 pieces fresh raspberries, or more to taste
instructions: Combine mango, milk, banana, and agave syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.
Pour into a bowl. Garnish with rows of banana, pomegranate seeds, flaked coconut, and raspberries.

3977.title: Snow Miser Smoothie Bowl
3977.description: Inspired by Snow Miser from "The Year Without Santa Claus," this vibrant, fresh smoothie bowl is the perfect pick-me-up for breakfast, or any time of the day!
ingredients: 1 small apple - peeled, cored, and cut into chunks
1 small pear - peeled, cored, and cut into chunks
instructions: Combine the banana, apple, and pear in an electric blender. Add ice cubes, skyr, all but one big spoonful of coconut, and spirulina.

Remove 3 or 4 balls of dragon fruit using a fruit baller, then add the remaining dragon fruit to the blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl. Top with reserved dragon fruit balls and remaining coconut.

3978.title: Acai Rainbow Smoothie Bowl for 2
3978.description: Frozen berries and acai pulp, topped with fresh fruits, granola, and agave, make for an amazing and refreshing smoothie bowl for two.
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
instructions: Place frozen berries, almond milk, banana, and acai pulp in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour into 2 bowls and top with granola, mango, strawberries, and kiwi slices. Drizzle with agave syrup.

3979.title: Chef V's Smoothie Bowl
3979.description: Fruit, coconut water, and Greek yogurt are blended together, poured into a bowl, and topped with chia seeds in this smoothie bowl recipe.
instructions: Combine yogurt, coconut water, strawberries, peaches, mango, banana, and 1 tablespoon chia seeds in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour smoothie into a bowl and top with remaining 1 tablespoon chia seeds.

3980.title: Paleo and Vegan Tropical Acai Bowl for Two
3980.description: Start the day with this quick and easy acai bowl made with pineapple, mango, and chia seeds. Made in just minutes and totally ideal for Paleo and vegan diets.
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen unsweetened acai pulp (such as Sambazon®)
1 cup iced water, or as needed
instructions: Place mango, pineapple, acai, water, and lime juice in a blender; pulse until smooth and creamy. Pour mixture into 2 bowls; sprinkle with shredded coconut and chia seeds. Drizzle with agave.

3981.title: Pumpkin-Spice Latte Bombs
3981.description: Inspired by cocoa bombs, these white chocolate spheres contain instant coffee and pumpkin pie spice that meld into a hot cup of coffee turning it into your own pumpkin-spice latte at home.
instructions: Break 4 ounces of the white chocolate into small pieces and place in a medium microwave-safe bowl; microwave on HIGH, stirring at 30-second intervals, until melted, about 1 1/2 minutes. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the melted chocolate into each of 6 (1 3/4-inch) silicone ball molds. Immediately flip mold over onto a cutting board or plate to allow chocolate to drip off and coat the mold. Let stand 2 minutes. Flip back over and use an offset spatula to scrape the tops of molds to clean them off, placing any dripped chocolate back into the bowl. Place silicone mold in freezer to set, about 5 minutes. Release chocolate "cups" from silicone molds; set aside. Repeat with another 4 ounces of chocolate.
While the molds chill, stir together beverage mix and pumpkin pie spice in a small bowl. Spoon 2 teaspoons of the mixture into 6 of the "cups."

Place the bowl of the leftover melted chocolate back in the microwave; microwave on HIGH until melted, about 30 seconds. Spoon or pour into a small zip-top plastic bag or piping bag and snip off 1/16-inch of the corner. Pipe a thin chocolate line along the edge of the 6 filled white chocolate cups. Place remaining 6 cups on top, using the white chocolate line as glue. Smooth out with your finger, and gently place in silicone mold; freeze until set, about 5 minutes.
Remove the balls from freezer, and dip an offset spatula in very hot water; use it to smooth out edges of the chocolate ball seam. Set aside.

Break remaining 2 ounces of chocolate into pieces, and place in a small microwave-safe bowl; microwave on HIGH until melted, about 30 seconds. Add food coloring, and stir to combine. Place in a separate ziplock bag and snip off 1/16-inch from a corner. Pipe in a zig-zag pattern on the balls. Freeze until set, about 5 minutes.
To serve, brew an 8- to 10-ounce cup of your favorite coffee. Place a bomb in the hot cup of coffee and stir to melt.

3982.title: Starbucks Caramel Frappuccino Copycat Recipe
3982.description: See how to make a caramel frappuccino at home by blending coffee with milk, caramel sauce, and ice. Top with whipped cream and even more caramel if desired!
ingredients: 1 cup strongly brewed black coffee, cooled
instructions: Blend ice, coffee, milk, caramel sauce, and sugar together in a blender on high speed until smooth.
Pour into two 16-ounce glasses.

3983.title: Mexican Mocha
3983.description: Mexican mocha is a wonderful hot drink with cocoa powder, chili, cinnamon, and coffee.
instructions: Combine powdered sugar, cocoa powder, cinnamon, and chili powder in the bottom of a mug.
Pour hot coffee on top and stir until dissolved. Pour in half-and-half creamer and stir.
Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.

3985.title: How to Make a Cafe Latte
3985.description: Learn how to make a cafe latte for a warm, delicious mug of steamy milk and bold espresso right at home. This is a great recipe for all coffee lovers.
ingredients: 1.3300000429153 cups hot freshly brewed dark roast espresso coffee
instructions: Heat milk in a saucepan set over medium-low heat. Whisk briskly with a wire whisk to create foam.
Brew espresso and pour into four cups. Pour in milk, holding back the foam with a spoon. Spoon foam over the top.

3986.title: Iced Caramel Macchiato
3986.description: This iced caramel macchiato is made with cold brew coffee and milk, vanilla syrup, and a drizzle of caramel sauce for a sweet and creamy summer drink.
ingredients: 4 ounces Gevalia® Cold Brew Concentrate - House Blend
instructions: Pour vanilla syrup into a drinking glass. Add ice cubes, then pour in milk.
Slowly pour in cold brew concentrate. Drizzle with caramel sauce.

3987.title: Homemade Coffee Creamer
3987.description: This homemade coffee creamer recipe uses sweetened condensed milk, skim milk, and vanilla extract to make the easiest, quickest cream for your coffee.
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk, skim milk, and vanilla in an airtight container; shake well to blend. Label the container with the expiration date of the milk used.

3988.title: Mexican Coffee Cocktail
3988.description: This Mexican coffee cocktail is a simple-to-make, invigorating warm cocktail made with coffee liqueur, tequila, coffee, and topped with whipped cream.
ingredients: 1 fluid ounce coffee-flavored liqueur (such as Kahlua®)
instructions: Stir together coffee liqueur and tequila in a mug. Pour in hot coffee and top with whipped cream.

3989.title: Baileys Flat White Martini
3989.description: This espresso martini with Baileys Original Irish Cream is as easy as 1, 2, 3. Impress your guests with this fancy cocktail at your next dinner party!
instructions: Pour Baileys, vodka, and espresso into a cocktail shaker. Add ice; shake well and strain into a martini glass.

3990.title: Homemade Caramel Latte
3990.description: This caramel coffee latte recipe is tastier than Starbucks and simple to make on the stovetop with milk, brown sugar, caramel sauce, and vanilla.
instructions: Combine milk and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat until frothy and close to simmering, about 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low; whisk in caramel sauce and vanilla. Stir in coffee.

3991.title: French Press Cold Brew
3991.description: Perfect French press cold brew with a coffee-to-water ratio that is just right. Learn how to make cold brew coffee at home with this easy recipe.
ingredients: 2 cups filtered water, at room temperature
instructions: Pour ground coffee into a French press container and add water. Place plunger lid on top and press the plunger down 1 to 2 inches to make sure all coffee grounds are fully submerged; do not press all the way down. Let coffee steep at room temperature for 16 to 18 hours.
Strain coffee through a coffee filter in a small strainer. Transfer to an airtight bottle or jar and keep in the refrigerator for up to a week.

3992.title: Vanilla Latte
3992.description: Enjoy this vanilla latte without waiting in the drive-through line! Use your home espresso machine and steaming wand to get coffee shop results, at home.
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand of an espresso machine.
Pour espresso over vanilla syrup in a large coffee mug. Pour steamed milk over espresso, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over top.

3993.title: Eggnog Latte
3993.description: It wouldn't be Christmas without one (or several!). If you have a home espresso machine, this is a great holiday coffee treat.
instructions: Pour milk and eggnog into a steaming pitcher and heat to between 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Brew the shot of espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk and eggnog into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over the top. Sprinkle nutmeg on top of the foam.

3994.title: Pumpkin Spice Coffee
3994.description: Give your cuppa joe a nice, warm spicy taste with allspice and cinnamon. Just add the spices to coffee in your drip machine.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons half-and-half cream, or to taste
1 teaspoon white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Mix the ground coffee, allspice, and cinnamon in a small bowl, and place into the filter of a drip coffee maker. Pour 4 cups of water into the coffee maker, and turn on the machine. When coffee has finished dripping, pour into 2 cups. Stir in cream and sugar to taste.

3995.title: Coffee Nudge
3995.description: So good on a blustery day! Warms you from the inside out.
instructions: In the bottom of 8 coffee mugs, pour 1 ounce each coffee liqueur and brandy. Pour in 1/2 ounce each creme de cacao. Fill each cup with hot coffee and garnish with a dollop of whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles.

3996.title: Coffee Liqueur
3996.description: A simple syrup, vanilla and instant coffee are combined with vodka and vanilla in this homemade version of the popular after dinner cordial.
instructions: In a 3 quart saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar and water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in instant coffee, and allow to cool.
When cool, stir in vanilla extract and vodka. Pour into clean bottles. Close bottles tightly, and store in a cool dark place.

3997.title: Irish Cream and Coffee
3997.description: Irish cream coffee simply uses Irish cream liqueur instead of cream and sugar to create an after-dinner coffee cocktail. Easy and delicious!
ingredients: 1 (1.5 fluid ounce) jigger Irish cream liqueur
instructions: Pour hot brewed coffee into a glass mug; stir in Irish cream liqueur.

3998.title: Dalgona Coffee (Whipped Coffee)
3998.description: Make your own light and creamy whipped coffee to serve over milk when you can't get to a cafe or coffee shop.
instructions: Whisk boiling water, instant coffee, and sugar together until coffee is dissolved. Continue to whisk until mixture becomes thick and forms a peak, 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour milk into a glass. Pour the frothy coffee on top of the milk.

3999.title: Spanish Coffee
3999.description: This Spanish coffee cocktail spiked with overproof rum, triple sec, and coffee liqueur is lit on fire for dramatic effect.
ingredients: 0.75 fluid ounce triple sec (such as Bols®)
2.5 fluid ounces coffee-flavored liqueur (such as Kahlua®)
instructions: Pour sugar into a shallow dish. Wet the rim of the glass and dip in sugar to coat. Add rum and triple sec. Use a long match or lighter to carefully ignite the mixture. Turn glass slowly until sugar begins to caramelize. Pour in coffee liqueur to put out the flame. Top with hot coffee.

4001.title: Coffee Shake
4001.description: This is a blended-coffee treat much like an iced cappuccino you might buy at a restaurant. You can make it non-dairy by using soy milk.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Combine the instant coffee, milk, vanilla extract, sugar, ice, and chocolate syrup in a blender; blend until smooth.

4002.title: Frozen Caramel Coffee
4002.description: Cold brew coffee concentrate, milk, and caramel ice cream syrup are blended together and topped with whipped topping and a drizzle of caramel syrup.
ingredients: 0.5 cup Gevalia® Cold Brew Concentrate - Vanilla
2 teaspoons white sugar, or to taste
1 tablespoon whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®)
2 teaspoons caramel ice cream topping, or to taste
instructions: Place cold brew concentrate, milk, 2 tablespoons caramel ice cream syrup, and sugar in blender; blend until mixed, 5 to 10 seconds. Add ice cubes and blend well, about 5 seconds. Pour into a glass.
Serve topped with whipped topping and a drizzle of caramel syrup.

4003.title: Homemade Coffee Creamer (Pumpkin Spice)
4003.description: Brighten up your morning coffee with your own delicious homemade pumpkin spice coffee creamer.
instructions: Whisk 4 ounces cream, maple syrup, pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, and vanilla extract together in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat pumpkin mixture in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between intervals, until heated through and completely blended, 1 to 3 minutes.
Pour sweetened condensed milk, remaining 10 ounces cream, and pumpkin mixture into a container, cover the container with a lid, and shake until completely mixed. Store in the refrigerator.

4004.title: White Chocolate Mocha
4004.description: This is a white chocolate version of a classic mocha. No reason to head to the cafe--stay in and use your home espresso machine to brew up this delicious espresso drink.
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Measure the white chocolate syrup into a large coffee mug. Brew espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Top with whipped cream and serve.

4005.title: Mocha
4005.description: This is a chocolate and coffee-lover's favorite! Using a home espresso machine, mix espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk--then top with whipped cream.
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Measure the chocolate syrup into a large coffee mug. Brew espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Top with whipped cream.

4006.title: Hot Buttered Rum Single Serving
4006.description: Nothing sets the mood on a cold winter day better than a roaring fire and a hot buttered rum. This is a single-serving recipe.
ingredients: 1 cup boiling water, or as needed
instructions: Place butter, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and vanilla extract in the bottom of an Irish coffee glass. Pour in rum and hot water. Stir.

4007.title: Easy Pumpkin Spice Latte
4007.description: Make your own pumpkin-spice latte-style treat from brewed coffee with this recipe.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white sugar, or to taste
1 tablespoon whipped cream topping, or to taste
instructions: Mix half-and-half, sugar, and pumpkin pie spice together in a coffee mug. Pour coffee into mug; stir to blend.
Heat in microwave until hot, about 15 seconds. Top with whipped cream.

4008.title: Flavored Latte
4008.description: Use this basic recipe to make your favorite flavored latte with a home espresso machine.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons any flavor of flavored syrup
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Measure the flavored syrup into a large coffee mug. Brew espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over the top.

4009.title: Mexican-Style Coffee
4009.description: Mixing warm coffee with tequila and coffee liqueur makes for a perfect 'apres ski.'
instructions: Pour the coffee into a mug. Stir in the coffee liqueur and tequila. Garnish with whipped topping, cinnamon, and cocoa powder.

4010.title: Vanilla Coffee Creamer
4010.description: Homemade vanilla coffee creamer can be made easily with 3 simple ingredients for a tasty addition to your morning coffee.
instructions: Combine half-and-half, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla extract together in a container with a lid; cover container and shake vigorously until creamer is smooth.

4011.title: Iced Lemon Coffee
4011.description: Iced lemon coffee is great refreshing drink on a hot summer day. Just store your leftover coffee in the fridge so you can make this little pick-me-up in a jiffy.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon stevia powder, or to taste
instructions: Combine coffee, ice cubes, lemon juice, and stevia in a glass. Stir. Garnish with a slice of lemon.

4012.title: Banana Milk Coffee
4012.description: Milk and banana are blended together until creamy and poured over cold brew coffee and ice in this naturally sweetened breakfast in a cup.
instructions: Combine milk, banana, and simple syrup in a blender; blend until very smooth, about 1 minute.
Fill two 16-ounce glasses with ice cubes. Divide coffee between the glasses. Pour banana milk on top, dividing it evenly between the glasses.

4014.title: Thai Coffee
