4014.description: Thai coffee, as is served in Thai restaurants.
instructions: Place coffee and cardamom in the filter of your coffee machine. Place enough water to make 2 cups of coffee in the machine. Turn on the coffee machine.
Pour brewed coffee into 2 coffee cups, and stir 1 tablespoon sweetened condensed milk into each cup. Serve.

4015.title: Chocolate-y Iced Mocha
4015.description: Use coffee, almond milk, cocoa mix, and chocolate syrup to make your own iced mocha at home.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar-free chocolate syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup coffee in microwave in a mug until warmed, about 30 seconds. Stir cocoa mix into the coffee until dissolved.
Fill a large glass with ice cubes. Pour 1 cup cold coffee and almond milk over the ice cubes; stir the cocoa mixture and chocolate syrup into the coffee and almond milk.

4016.title: 3-Minute Mochaccino
4016.description: Instant coffee granules and cocoa powder can help deliver a delicious cold beverage from your blender in a matter of minutes.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cocoa powder, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon vanilla extract, or more to taste
instructions: Blend milk, ice cubes, sugar, instant coffee granules, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract in a blender until smooth.
Lightly coat the inside of a glass with chocolate syrup. Pour the coffee mixture into the glass. Top with whipped cream to serve.

4017.title: Biscoff® Latte
4017.description: This recipe gives your morning latte a fun twist with Biscoff® cookie butter and just a pinch of cinnamon.
instructions: Heat milk and brown sugar in a small saucepan until frothy, close to simmering. Reduce heat to low. Whisk in cookie butter and cinnamon, then mix in coffee.

4018.title: Cold-Brewed Coffee
4018.description: Once you try cold-brewing your coffee, you may never go back to your coffee maker! Coarsely ground coffee, cold water, and a bit of time and patience delivers a less-acidic brew you'll love.
instructions: Put coffee grounds in a large container. Slowly pour water over grounds.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and steep at room temperature for 18 to 24 hours.

Line a strainer with several layers of cheesecloth and place atop a pitcher; strain coffee through the cheesecloth into the pitcher. Discard the grounds. To get a clearer brew, strain coffee again through coffee filters. Store in refrigerator.

4019.title: Blended Mocha Drink
4019.description: Make your own blended mocha at home with brewed espresso, sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, and chocolate syrup.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Stir espresso and sweetened condensed milk together in a bowl. Add milk and stir; pour into a blender. Add ice and chocolate syrup to the espresso mixture. Blend until smooth.

4020.title: Delicious Homemade Iced Coffee
4020.description: Skip the line and expense at the coffee shop and make this easy, delicious homemade iced coffee instead.
ingredients: 4 cups ice cubes, or as needed
1 cup white sugar, or to taste
instructions: Place 2 cups of ice cubes into a 2-quart pitcher; slowly pour coffee over ice and stir until ice is melted. Stir sugar into coffee and mix thoroughly until sugar is completely dissolved. Add milk, stirring just until combined. Stir in remaining 2 cups ice, adding more as needed; refrigerate until well chilled, about 30 minutes.
Stir before serving. Pour over ice in tall glasses or into recycled serving-size glass bottles or insulated tumblers.

4021.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Iced Coffee
4021.description: Get ready for a spring in your step with this creamy peanut butter coffee made with soy milk, chocolate syrup, and homemade coffee ice cubes.
ingredients: 1 packet granular no-calorie sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instructions: Pour coffee into an ice cube tray; freeze until coffee ice cubes form, 1 to 2 hours.
Combine coffee ice cubes, soy milk, chocolate syrup, peanut butter, vanilla extract, and no-calorie sweetener in a blender. Cover and blend until frothy.

4022.title: Gingerbread Coffee
4022.description: Molasses and spices are stirred into hot coffee and topped off with a generous dollop of whipped cream and sprinkled with cloves.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the molasses, brown sugar, baking soda, ginger and cinnamon until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes.

Add about a 1/4 cup of coffee to each cup, then stir in about a tablespoon of the spice mixture until dissolved. Fill cup to within an inch of the top with coffee. Stir in half and half to taste, then garnish with whipped cream and a light dusting of cloves.

4024.title: Brown Sugar Latte
4024.description: This brown sugar latte is flavored with caramel sauce and is a sweet alternative to a regular coffee latte.
instructions: Combine milk, caramel sauce, and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Froth mixture using a stick blender.
Pour hot milk mixture into a mug, holding back the foam with the back of a spoon. Add coffee and pour foam on top.

4025.title: Iced Horchata Coffee
4025.description: Iced cold brew coffee with strained rice-almond water makes a delicious Mexican-inspired hot-weather beverage in this coffee horchata recipe with cinnamon.
ingredients: 16 ounces Gevalia® Cold Brew Concentrate - House Blend
instructions: Combine rice, water, and almonds in a blender. Blend the mixture until well combined, about 2 minutes. The mixture will be coarse.
Strain mixture through a fine sieve or cheesecloth into a pitcher; discard solids. Stir in cold brew concentrate and blue agave.
Serve over ice. Garnish with cinnamon sticks.

4026.title: Frozen Caramel Latte
4026.description: This frothy, blended espresso drink will wake you up and make you happy any time of day. Sweetened with caramel sauce and topped with whipped cream, this is one delicious frozen latte.
instructions: Place the espresso, caramel sauce, and sugar into a blender pitcher. Blend on high until the caramel and sugar dissolve into the espresso. Pour in the milk and add the ice; continue blending until smooth and frothy. Top with whipped cream to serve.

4028.title: Hot Mocha
4028.description: This warming drink, a treat for coffee and chocolate lovers alike, combines the two under a layer of creamy foamed milk. Skim milk foams easily and makes a deceptively lean, yet rich topping. Enjoy it in the morning, as an afternoon break, and as a lean, luscious, liquid dessert.
ingredients: 1 packet Sweet'N Low granulated sugar substitute, or to taste
instructions: In a small mug or coffee cup, mix the cocoa and Sweet'N Low together. Add a few tablespoons of the coffee and stir until the cocoa is completely dissolved. Pour in the remaining coffee.
Foam the milk. Spoon a generous amount over the hot mocha. Garnish with a pinch of cocoa powder, if desired.

4029.title: Pumpkin Spice Coffee Syrup
4029.description: Make your own pumpkin spice syrup with this copycat recipe using pumpkin pie filling, pumpkin pie spice, and other fall spices.
instructions: Mix water and sugar together in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring regularly, until sugar is completely dissolved completely, about 5 minutes.

Stir 6 tablespoons pumpkin pie filling, cinnamon sticks, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, vanilla, and pumpkin pie spice into the sugar syrup; bring to a simmer. Cook until mixture is well spiced, 8 to 10 minutes.
Strain mixture through a sheet of cheesecloth into a bowl. Return liquid to the saucepan over low heat.
Stir condensed milk and remaining 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie filling into the spiced syrup. Cook, stirring regularly, until pumpkin dissolves into the liquid, about 5 minutes.

4030.title: Abbey's White Chocolate Latte
4030.description: I created this white chocolate masterpiece for my little sister, Abbey, who's a latte fanatic. She was blown away, and drained it to the last drop! This makes one VERY large, indulgent latte, and could probably serve two. Enjoy!
instructions: Combine the milk and cream in a saucepan, and whisk over high heat until hot and frothy. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla and sugar. Whisk together hot espresso and white chocolate chips in a mug until smooth. If you are making two, pour half into another mug. Top with the frothy hot milk and stir to blend in the flavoring.

4031.title: Simple Coffee Drink
4031.description: Leftover coffee becomes a refreshing and sweet drink with the addition of milk and sweetener.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets granular sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instructions: Mix milk, coffee, and sweetener together in a glass until sweetener is dissolved.

4032.title: Sara's Iced Coffee
4032.description: A lightly sweetened, creamy iced coffee with just a hint of vanilla. Very refreshing and delicious on a hot summer day. Yum!
instructions: Stir vanilla extract and sugar into boiling water until sugar has dissolved. Refrigerate until cool, about 30 minutes.
Chill four glasses, if desired.
Divide ice and chilled coffee evenly between four glasses. Stir in sugar mixture and cream to taste.

4033.title: Amaretto Coffee Creamer
4033.description: Make amaretto coffee creamer from condensed milk, nonfat milk, and almond extract using this quick and easy recipe.
instructions: Combine condensed milk, nonfat milk, almond extract, and cinnamon in a glass Mason jar; cover and shake well. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Shake before using, as condensed milk will settle to the bottom.

4034.title: Cold Brew and Tonic
4034.description: Refreshing in the morning, or any time of day, this easy cold brew and tonic drink is sure to pep you up!
instructions: Fill a glass with ice cubes. Pour in tonic water, then cold brew coffee.

4035.title: Iced Mocha Frappé
4035.description: Blend up sweet, homemade iced mocha frappés that taste like those at McDonald's with this quick-and-easy five-ingredient recipe.
instructions: Pour coffee into an ice cube tray. Freeze until solid, 3 to 4 hours.
Place frozen coffee cubes in a blender. Add milk, chocolate syrup, and sugar; blend until smooth.
Pour coffee mixture into 2 glasses and top with whipped cream.

4036.title: Coconut Oil Coffee
4036.description: Start your morning off right with this mind-blowing recipe for hot coffee with coconut oil and butter.
instructions: Blend coffee, coconut oil, and butter together in a blender until oil and butter are melted and coffee is frothy.

4037.title: Almond Milk Frappuccino
4037.description: This almond milk frappuccino tastes just like Starbucks. Use 4 simple ingredients to make a homemade version of the coffee shop favorite.
instructions: Blend ice, almond milk, espresso, and honey in a blender until smooth.

4038.title: Sous Vide "Cold Brew" Coffee
4038.description: Use your sous vide immersion cooker to speed up the time it takes to make cold brew coffee to just 2 hours instead of 24.
instructions: Place 1/4 cup coffee grounds into each jar, then top with water. Screw on the lids until just barely tightened; do not overtighten.

Fill a large pot with enough water to cover the jars completely and place a sous vide immersion cooker into the water. Set temperature to 150 degrees F (65 degrees C) according to manufacturer's directions.
Submerge mason jars into the water bath and set timer for 2 hours.

Remove jars to a cooling rack and let cool until easily handled. Strain the mixture through a coffee filter to stop the steeping process. Pour over ice and serve, or return to rinsed-out jars and store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

4039.title: Vietnamese Coffee
4039.description: Hot cocoa and non-dairy creamer add rich chocolaty goodness to this traditional Vietnamese drink made with condensed milk and strong coffee.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk, or more to taste
1 teaspoon non-dairy creamer (such as Coffee-Mate®), or more to taste
1 teaspoon hot cocoa mix (such as Godiva®), or more to taste
instructions: Pour some boiling water in a glass. Let sit to warm the glass, about 1 minute. Pour out water.
Pour condensed milk into the warmed glass. Top with coffee. Stir in creamer and hot cocoa mix.

4040.title: Fat-Free Vanilla Coffee Creamer
4040.description: Skip the store-bought version and make this quick, easy, budget-friendly, fat-free vanilla coffee creamer at home instead.
ingredients: 0.5 (12 fluid ounce) can fat-free evaporated milk
1 tablespoon granular sucrolose sweetener (such as Splenda®), or more to taste
instructions: Pour evaporated milk into a small saucepan; add vanilla extract. Stir in sweetener. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, to allow alcohol in extract to cook off, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the burner and let cool before using, or place in an airtight container and refrigerate.

4041.title: Pumpkin Spiced Latte
4041.description: Use a blender to whip up this frothy pumpkin spice-flavored latte made with double-strength brewed coffee, milk, sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin pie spice.
instructions: Combine the hot milk, sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin pie spice in a blender; blend until frothy. Pour the mixture into 3 coffee mugs to about 2/3 full. Pour 2 ounces coffee into each mug. Garnish each mug with whipped topping and pumpkin pie spice.

4042.title: Starbucks® Mocha Frappuccino® Replica
4042.description: It's easy to make a replica of the Starbucks® Mocha Frappuccino®: steep your own cold brew, then shake it with condensed milk and cocoa! Keep the concentrate in your fridge for a month.
ingredients: 0.5 pound dark roast ground coffee beans
instructions: Mix 6 cups water and coffee in a 1/2-gallon jar (such as Ball®) until grounds are completely saturated. Steep for 24 hours at room temperature, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the coffee to the refrigerator and chill for 1 hour.
Place a small colander on top of a tall, lidded plastic container. Line colander with a 6-inch square of cheesecloth; fit a coffee filter on top.

Pour about 1 cup of the coffee into the colander until filter begins to clog. Lift the corners of the cheesecloth carefully; twist the cloth and filter to extract the liquid. Drain the remaining liquid 1 cup at a time, using a new coffee filter each time. Repeat the process with the grounds, filtering 1 cup at a time; squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Refrigerate the concentrate until ready to use.
Combine concentrate, 1% milk, and condensed milk in a 1/2-gallon jar.
Dissolve 3 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon sugar and cocoa powder together in a bowl of hot tap water. Add to the coffee-milk mixture; cover the jar and shake well.

4043.title: Pumpkin Spice Latte
4043.description: My take on our corner coffee shop's seasonal pumpkin latte. I loved it so much I HAD to do something! You can use canned 'pumpkin pie mix' if you like, since it contains the pumpkin pie spice ingredients already.
instructions: Brew your espresso. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, whisk together the pumpkin, vanilla, sugar, pumpkin pie spice and milk. Warm over medium heat, whisking constantly, until hot and frothy. Do not bring to a boil. Pour the espresso into a mug and pour the pumpkin spiced milk over it.

4044.title: How to Make a Cafe Latte
4044.description: Learn how to make a cafe latte for a warm, delicious mug of steamy milk and bold espresso right at home. This is a great recipe for all coffee lovers.
ingredients: 1.3300000429153 cups hot freshly brewed dark roast espresso coffee
instructions: Heat milk in a saucepan set over medium-low heat. Whisk briskly with a wire whisk to create foam.
Brew espresso and pour into four cups. Pour in milk, holding back the foam with a spoon. Spoon foam over the top.

4045.title: Homemade Caramel Latte
4045.description: This caramel coffee latte recipe is tastier than Starbucks and simple to make on the stovetop with milk, brown sugar, caramel sauce, and vanilla.
instructions: Combine milk and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat until frothy and close to simmering, about 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low; whisk in caramel sauce and vanilla. Stir in coffee.

4046.title: Vanilla Latte
4046.description: Enjoy this vanilla latte without waiting in the drive-through line! Use your home espresso machine and steaming wand to get coffee shop results, at home.
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand of an espresso machine.
Pour espresso over vanilla syrup in a large coffee mug. Pour steamed milk over espresso, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over top.

4047.title: Eggnog Latte
4047.description: It wouldn't be Christmas without one (or several!). If you have a home espresso machine, this is a great holiday coffee treat.
instructions: Pour milk and eggnog into a steaming pitcher and heat to between 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Brew the shot of espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk and eggnog into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over the top. Sprinkle nutmeg on top of the foam.

4048.title: Easy Pumpkin Spice Latte
4048.description: Make your own pumpkin-spice latte-style treat from brewed coffee with this recipe.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons white sugar, or to taste
1 tablespoon whipped cream topping, or to taste
instructions: Mix half-and-half, sugar, and pumpkin pie spice together in a coffee mug. Pour coffee into mug; stir to blend.
Heat in microwave until hot, about 15 seconds. Top with whipped cream.

4049.title: Flavored Latte
4049.description: Use this basic recipe to make your favorite flavored latte with a home espresso machine.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons any flavor of flavored syrup
instructions: Pour milk into a steaming pitcher and heat to 145 degrees F to 165 degrees F (65 to 70 degrees C) using the steaming wand. Measure the flavored syrup into a large coffee mug. Brew espresso, then add to mug. Pour the steamed milk into the mug, using a spoon to hold back the foam. Spoon foam over the top.

4050.title: Biscoff® Latte
4050.description: This recipe gives your morning latte a fun twist with Biscoff® cookie butter and just a pinch of cinnamon.
instructions: Heat milk and brown sugar in a small saucepan until frothy, close to simmering. Reduce heat to low. Whisk in cookie butter and cinnamon, then mix in coffee.

4051.title: Brown Sugar Latte
4051.description: This brown sugar latte is flavored with caramel sauce and is a sweet alternative to a regular coffee latte.
instructions: Combine milk, caramel sauce, and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Froth mixture using a stick blender.
Pour hot milk mixture into a mug, holding back the foam with the back of a spoon. Add coffee and pour foam on top.

4052.title: Frozen Caramel Latte
4052.description: This frothy, blended espresso drink will wake you up and make you happy any time of day. Sweetened with caramel sauce and topped with whipped cream, this is one delicious frozen latte.
instructions: Place the espresso, caramel sauce, and sugar into a blender pitcher. Blend on high until the caramel and sugar dissolve into the espresso. Pour in the milk and add the ice; continue blending until smooth and frothy. Top with whipped cream to serve.

4053.title: Abbey's White Chocolate Latte
4053.description: I created this white chocolate masterpiece for my little sister, Abbey, who's a latte fanatic. She was blown away, and drained it to the last drop! This makes one VERY large, indulgent latte, and could probably serve two. Enjoy!
instructions: Combine the milk and cream in a saucepan, and whisk over high heat until hot and frothy. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla and sugar. Whisk together hot espresso and white chocolate chips in a mug until smooth. If you are making two, pour half into another mug. Top with the frothy hot milk and stir to blend in the flavoring.

4054.title: Pumpkin Spiced Latte
4054.description: Use a blender to whip up this frothy pumpkin spice-flavored latte made with double-strength brewed coffee, milk, sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin pie spice.
instructions: Combine the hot milk, sugar, vanilla extract, and pumpkin pie spice in a blender; blend until frothy. Pour the mixture into 3 coffee mugs to about 2/3 full. Pour 2 ounces coffee into each mug. Garnish each mug with whipped topping and pumpkin pie spice.

4055.title: Pumpkin Spice Latte
4055.description: My take on our corner coffee shop's seasonal pumpkin latte. I loved it so much I HAD to do something! You can use canned 'pumpkin pie mix' if you like, since it contains the pumpkin pie spice ingredients already.
instructions: Brew your espresso. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, whisk together the pumpkin, vanilla, sugar, pumpkin pie spice and milk. Warm over medium heat, whisking constantly, until hot and frothy. Do not bring to a boil. Pour the espresso into a mug and pour the pumpkin spiced milk over it.

4056.title: Campfire S'Mores Latte
4056.description: Chocolate, marshmallow topping, and espresso are mixed with warm milk and topped with graham cracker crumbs creating a s'mores latte.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons marshmallow ice cream topping (such as Smucker's®)
instructions: Pour espresso into a mug; stir in marshmallow topping, sugar, and cocoa powder until well blended.

Heat milk in a saucepan over medium-low heat until lightly boiling, 3 to 5 minutes; remove from heat and froth milk with a frothing wand or a whisk. Pour frothed milk over espresso mixture. Top latte with whipped cream and graham cracker crumbs.

4057.title: Quick Pumpkin Spice Latte
4057.description: Drink in the season with this heavenly pumpkin spice latte that is quick and easy to make.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Whisk 1/2 cup milk, sugar, pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, and vanilla extract in a small saucepan over low heat. Simmer for 5 minutes. Whisk in remaining 1/2 cup milk.
Pour milk mixture through a fine-mesh sieve to remove pulp. Return milk mixture to saucepan and simmer, whisking, 2 minutes. Add espresso and whisk until foamy, 1 minute.

4058.title: White Chocolate Raspberry Latte
4058.description: This latte is made with sugar-free white chocolate and raspberry syrups and soy milk for a low in calories delicious latte with optional white chocolate chips.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sugar-free white chocolate-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
1 tablespoon sugar-free raspberry syrup (such as Torani®)
instructions: Pour white chocolate and raspberry flavored syrups into a mug.

Heat soy milk in a sauce pan over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Add white chocolate chips and vanilla extract. Using an immersion blender, froth milk. Pour into mug, holding the foam back with a spoon. Pour in coffee and add foam on top.

4059.title: Brown Sugar-Caramel Latte
4059.description: Sometimes coffee is a dessert in itself. This is one of my favorite morning treats to make a Monday seem less intimidating. You'll need a battery-powered milk frother or it's just not the same.
instructions: Stir brown sugar into half-and-half until dissolved. Whip with a milk frother or small whisk. Pour coffee into a mug, and stir in caramel sauce until dissolved. Pour frothed half-and-half into coffee, and serve.

4061.title: Green Tea Latte
4061.description: Green tea powder and soy milk make a great version of the traditional latte.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the soy milk, water, green tea powder and sugar. Warm over medium heat while whisking until hot and foamy. Pour into mugs and enjoy.

4062.title: Turmeric Iced Coffee Latte
4062.description: This anti-inflammatory iced coffee is spiced with turmeric, ginger, and cinnamon, and can be made with any dairy or plant based milk.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
instructions: Pour coconut milk, vanilla extract, and 1 packet stevia powder into a glass and stir to combine. Fill glass with ice cubes.

Combine water, instant coffee granules, 1 packet stevia powder, turmeric, ginger and cinnamon in a microwave-safe glass; stir to mix. Microwave for 30 seconds. Stir. Continue microwaving at 15-second intervals until hot and foamy. Carefully pour over the iced coconut milk.

4063.title: Spicy Pumpkin Spice Latte
4063.description: Enjoy the tastes of the season year-round with this recipe for DIY pumpkin spice lattes.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste
10 fluid ounces hot strongly brewed coffee
2 tablespoons whipped cream, or more to taste
1 pinch pumpkin pie spice, or to taste
instructions: Whisk almond milk, pumpkin puree, vanilla extract, sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice, and pepper together in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is almost boiling; remove from heat and whisk until frothy, about 1 minute. Divide mixture between 2 mugs.
Slowly pour coffee into each mug. Top with whipped cream and pinch pumpkin pie spice.

4064.title: Brown Sugar Coconut Latte
4064.description: This latte is made with 2 types of coconut milk, coconut oil, coconut extract, and brown sugar for the die-hard coconut fan.
ingredients: 0.5 cup unsweetened coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
instructions: Combine canned coconut milk, coconut milk beverage, brown sugar, coconut oil, and coconut extract in a saucepan. Heat over low heat until hot. Use an immersion blender to froth milk mixture until foamy.
Pour coconut milk mixture into a large mug, holding foam back with the back of a spoon. Pour in coffee and add foam on top.

4065.title: Whipped Coffee Iced Latte
4065.description: Whip instant coffee, sugar, and water until foamy and serve over cold milk for a refreshing homemade iced latte.
instructions: Combine boiling water, coffee granules, and sugar in a large mug and whip with an immersion blender until foamy, about 2 minutes. Set aside.
Fill a large glass with ice cubes. Pour milk over ice cubes. Top with the coffee foam.

4066.title: Pumpkin Latte Mix
4066.description: Pumpkin and vanilla flavored creamers combine with instant coffee for a tasty latte mix that makes a great gift.
ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin spice flavored powdered creamer
instructions: Stir together the vanilla creamer, pumpkin spice creamer, instant coffee granules, and sugar. Store the latte mix in an airtight container.
For 1 serving, place 2 tablespoons latte mix in a coffee cup. Add 1 cup boiling water, and stir to dissolve.

4067.title: Skinny White Chocolate-Coconut Latte
4067.description: Any type of milk, dairy or non-dairy, can be used for this skinny white chocolate-coconut latte made with 2 types of sugar-free syrups. You will still have a delicious coffee drink.
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®), heated
1 tablespoon sugar-free white chocolate-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
1 tablespoon sugar-free coconut-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
instructions: Combine coconut milk, white chocolate-flavored syrup, and coconut-flavored syrup in a mug. Pour hot coffee on top and garnish with a dollop of whipped cream.

4068.title: Skinny White Chocolate Peanut Butter Latte
4068.description: All the great flavors of white chocolate and peanut butter are combined in this skinny vegan latte without all the calories.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sugar-free white chocolate-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
2 tablespoons powdered peanut butter (such as PB2®)
2 (1 gram) packets stevia sweetener (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Pour white chocolate syrup into a mug.

Heat almond milk, peanut butter powder, and sweetener in a saucepan over medium heat until simmering. Remove from heat and froth with an immersion blender. Pour milk into the mug, holding foam back with the back of a spoon. Add coffee and top with foam.

4069.title: Vegan Mocha Latte
4069.description: A delicious vegan mocha latte made with any type of nut milk or soy milk that's ready in just minutes.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
2 tablespoons vegan chocolate chips (such as Enjoy Life®)
1 tablespoon vegan whipped cream (such as So Delicious® Cocowhip™)
instructions: Combine coconut milk beverage and chocolate chips in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a slow boil, whisking constantly, until chocolate chips are melted, 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in espresso powder and cinnamon until completely incorporated. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Top with vegan whipped cream.

4070.title: White Chocolate Peanut Butter Latte
4070.description: This latte with peanut butter and white chocolate is a dream for anyone who likes a sweet cup of coffee.
instructions: Heat milk and sweetener in a saucepan over medium heat. Blend with an immersion blender until frothy.
Combine peanut butter and white chocolate syrup in a mug. Pour in hot milk, holding foam with the back of a spoon. Add coffee and foam.

4071.title: Pumpkin Spice Latte Concentrate
4071.description: Use this homemade pumpkin spice latte concentrate recipe to make your own pumpkin spiced latte at home!
ingredients: 1 pinch pumpkin pie spice, or to taste
instructions: Stir together water, pumpkin, brown and white sugars, and pumpkin pie spice in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Remove from heat. Cool completely. To Make One Pumpkin Spiced Latte:
Stir together milk and 3 tablespoons Pumpkin Spiced Latte Concentrate in a microwave-proof 12- to 16-ounce mug.

Heat in a microwave until hot, but not boiling, about 1 minute. Whisk until frothy. Pour hot espresso into milk mixture; stir gently. Top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of pumpkin pie spice. Makes a 10-ounce latte (1 1/4 cups).

4072.title: Mexican Mocha
4072.description: Mexican mocha is a wonderful hot drink with cocoa powder, chili, cinnamon, and coffee.
instructions: Combine powdered sugar, cocoa powder, cinnamon, and chili powder in the bottom of a mug.
Pour hot coffee on top and stir until dissolved. Pour in half-and-half creamer and stir.
Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.

4073.title: Chocolate-y Iced Mocha
4073.description: Use coffee, almond milk, cocoa mix, and chocolate syrup to make your own iced mocha at home.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar-free chocolate syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup coffee in microwave in a mug until warmed, about 30 seconds. Stir cocoa mix into the coffee until dissolved.
Fill a large glass with ice cubes. Pour 1 cup cold coffee and almond milk over the ice cubes; stir the cocoa mixture and chocolate syrup into the coffee and almond milk.

4074.title: 3-Minute Mochaccino
4074.description: Instant coffee granules and cocoa powder can help deliver a delicious cold beverage from your blender in a matter of minutes.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cocoa powder, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon vanilla extract, or more to taste
instructions: Blend milk, ice cubes, sugar, instant coffee granules, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract in a blender until smooth.
Lightly coat the inside of a glass with chocolate syrup. Pour the coffee mixture into the glass. Top with whipped cream to serve.

4075.title: Blended Mocha Drink
4075.description: Make your own blended mocha at home with brewed espresso, sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, and chocolate syrup.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Stir espresso and sweetened condensed milk together in a bowl. Add milk and stir; pour into a blender. Add ice and chocolate syrup to the espresso mixture. Blend until smooth.

4076.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Iced Coffee
4076.description: Get ready for a spring in your step with this creamy peanut butter coffee made with soy milk, chocolate syrup, and homemade coffee ice cubes.
ingredients: 1 packet granular no-calorie sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
instructions: Pour coffee into an ice cube tray; freeze until coffee ice cubes form, 1 to 2 hours.
Combine coffee ice cubes, soy milk, chocolate syrup, peanut butter, vanilla extract, and no-calorie sweetener in a blender. Cover and blend until frothy.

4077.title: Iced Mocha Frappé
4077.description: Blend up sweet, homemade iced mocha frappés that taste like those at McDonald's with this quick-and-easy five-ingredient recipe.
instructions: Pour coffee into an ice cube tray. Freeze until solid, 3 to 4 hours.
Place frozen coffee cubes in a blender. Add milk, chocolate syrup, and sugar; blend until smooth.
Pour coffee mixture into 2 glasses and top with whipped cream.

4078.title: Starbucks® Mocha Frappuccino® Replica
4078.description: It's easy to make a replica of the Starbucks® Mocha Frappuccino®: steep your own cold brew, then shake it with condensed milk and cocoa! Keep the concentrate in your fridge for a month.
ingredients: 0.5 pound dark roast ground coffee beans
instructions: Mix 6 cups water and coffee in a 1/2-gallon jar (such as Ball®) until grounds are completely saturated. Steep for 24 hours at room temperature, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the coffee to the refrigerator and chill for 1 hour.
Place a small colander on top of a tall, lidded plastic container. Line colander with a 6-inch square of cheesecloth; fit a coffee filter on top.

Pour about 1 cup of the coffee into the colander until filter begins to clog. Lift the corners of the cheesecloth carefully; twist the cloth and filter to extract the liquid. Drain the remaining liquid 1 cup at a time, using a new coffee filter each time. Repeat the process with the grounds, filtering 1 cup at a time; squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Refrigerate the concentrate until ready to use.
Combine concentrate, 1% milk, and condensed milk in a 1/2-gallon jar.
Dissolve 3 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon sugar and cocoa powder together in a bowl of hot tap water. Add to the coffee-milk mixture; cover the jar and shake well.

4079.title: Iced Mocha Cola
4079.description: Cola and coffee over ice with a shot of half-and-half delivers a unique spin on iced mocha beverages.
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle cola-flavored carbonated beverage, or as needed.
instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. Add instant coffee granules. Slowly pour cola into the glass. Gently stir half-and-half into the cola to integrate.

4080.title: Mocha Coffee Cooler
4080.description: Coffee, non-dairy creamer, and cocoa give this refreshing, icy-cold drink a classic mocha flavor.
instructions: Pour coffee into a blender and add creamer, sugar, cocoa, vanilla extract, and ice. Pour vegetable oil over ice cubes and spray cooking spray into blender. Blend until smooth, about 1 1/2 minutes.

4081.title: Orange Mocha
4081.description: Add some sweet citrus to your coffee drink through the introduction of orange juice.
instructions: Stir coffee, orange juice, milk, sugar, and cocoa powder together in a mug until the sugar and cocoa dissolve.

4082.title: White Chocolate Butterscotch Mocha
4082.description: Try this delicious homemade mocha made with white chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, heavy cream, and coffee.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets stevia sweetener (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine white chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, and sweetener in a mug. Add coffee and heavy cream and stir until chips are melted and heavy cream is fully incorporated. Top with whipped cream.

4083.title: Skinny Dark Chocolate Mocha
4083.description: If you like dark chocolate, this is the mocha for you. Plus it's 'skinny' due to the use of sweetener and dark cocoa powder.
ingredients: 2 (1 gram) packets stevia sweetener (such as Truvia®)
instructions: Combine almond milk, cocoa powder, sweetener, and vanilla extract in a saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium-low heat. Froth cocoa-milk mixture using an immersion blender.
Pour hot chocolate milk into a mug, holding back the foam with the back of a spoon. Add coffee and top with foam.

4084.title: Skinny Chocolate Mocha Shake
4084.description: Cold brew coffee concentrate, sugar-free hot cocoa mix, soy milk, and chocolate syrup make a delicious cold mocha--and you won't miss the calories.
ingredients: 1 cup Gevalia® Cold Brew Concentrate - House Blend
1 envelope sugar free instant cocoa mix
instructions: Place cold brew concentrate in ice cube tray(s); place in freezer until frozen solid, 2 to 4 hours.
Dissolve hot cocoa mix in hot water.
Place coffee cubes in a blender. Add cocoa mixture, soy milk, chocolate syrup, and sweetener. Blend until icy and frothy, 1 or 2 minutes.

4085.title: Vegan Mocha Latte
4085.description: A delicious vegan mocha latte made with any type of nut milk or soy milk that's ready in just minutes.
ingredients: 0.75 cup coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
2 tablespoons vegan chocolate chips (such as Enjoy Life®)
1 tablespoon vegan whipped cream (such as So Delicious® Cocowhip™)
instructions: Combine coconut milk beverage and chocolate chips in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a slow boil, whisking constantly, until chocolate chips are melted, 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in espresso powder and cinnamon until completely incorporated. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Top with vegan whipped cream.

4086.title: Easy Blended Mocha
4086.description: Take cold brew to the next level and blend it with sweetened condensed milk, ice, and a touch of cocoa powder to make an easy blended mocha.
instructions: Place ice, coffee, and cocoa powder in a blender; blend until no big ice chunks remain. Add water and sweetened condensed milk; blend until smooth.

4087.title: Homemade Coffee Creamer
4087.description: This homemade coffee creamer recipe uses sweetened condensed milk, skim milk, and vanilla extract to make the easiest, quickest cream for your coffee.
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk, skim milk, and vanilla in an airtight container; shake well to blend. Label the container with the expiration date of the milk used.

4089.title: Homemade Coffee Creamer (Pumpkin Spice)
4089.description: Brighten up your morning coffee with your own delicious homemade pumpkin spice coffee creamer.
instructions: Whisk 4 ounces cream, maple syrup, pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice, and vanilla extract together in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat pumpkin mixture in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between intervals, until heated through and completely blended, 1 to 3 minutes.
Pour sweetened condensed milk, remaining 10 ounces cream, and pumpkin mixture into a container, cover the container with a lid, and shake until completely mixed. Store in the refrigerator.

4090.title: Vanilla Coffee Creamer
4090.description: Homemade vanilla coffee creamer can be made easily with 3 simple ingredients for a tasty addition to your morning coffee.
instructions: Combine half-and-half, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla extract together in a container with a lid; cover container and shake vigorously until creamer is smooth.

4092.title: Amaretto Coffee Creamer
4092.description: Make amaretto coffee creamer from condensed milk, nonfat milk, and almond extract using this quick and easy recipe.
instructions: Combine condensed milk, nonfat milk, almond extract, and cinnamon in a glass Mason jar; cover and shake well. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Shake before using, as condensed milk will settle to the bottom.

4093.title: Fat-Free Vanilla Coffee Creamer
4093.description: Skip the store-bought version and make this quick, easy, budget-friendly, fat-free vanilla coffee creamer at home instead.
ingredients: 0.5 (12 fluid ounce) can fat-free evaporated milk
1 tablespoon granular sucrolose sweetener (such as Splenda®), or more to taste
instructions: Pour evaporated milk into a small saucepan; add vanilla extract. Stir in sweetener. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, to allow alcohol in extract to cook off, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the burner and let cool before using, or place in an airtight container and refrigerate.

4094.title: Coconut Cream Coffee Creamer
4094.description: Coconut and vanilla extract give this homemade coffee creamer a boost of flavor without all the additives.
instructions: Combine cream, milk, and sugar in a small pot over low heat until steam appears, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in coconut and vanilla extracts. Cool and store in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

4095.title: Coffee Creamer
4095.description: Use this recipe to turn milk and water into homemade coffee creamer with powdered milk, sugar, and vanilla extract.
ingredients: 0.66666668653488 cup milk, or more to taste
instructions: Combine powdered milk, sugar, boiling water, and vanilla extract in a blender and blend until smooth; add milk. Transfer creamer to a container with a tight seal and keep refrigerated.

4096.title: Coconut Milk Coffee Creamer
4096.description: Give your morning coffee a sweet, dairy-free twist with this homemade coconut milk creamer, sweetened with real maple syrup.
instructions: Put coconut milk, syrup, and vanilla extract in a glass jar with a lid. Shake to mix.

4098.title: Homemade Cinnamon Coffee Creamer
4098.description: Take your basic coffee to the next level with this homemade cinnamon coffee creamer that mixes up in just minutes and stores for up to 2 weeks in the fridge.
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) can fat-free sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Mix condensed milk, almond milk, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and almond extract together until well blended.

4099.title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Spice Coffee Creamer
4099.description: Make your own coffee creamer at home with this pumpkin spice-flavored recipe you can enjoy year round.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown sugar substitute (such as Swerve®)
2 tablespoons sugar-free pumpkin flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
instructions: Combine half-and-half, pumpkin, brown sugar substitute, syrup, and pumpkin spice in a saucepan. Stir to combine and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thoroughly warmed, 6 to 7 minutes. Do not boil.

4100.title: Homemade Caramel Coffee Creamer
4100.description: With just 5 ingredients and a little time at the stove you can make this delicious homemade caramel-flavored coffee creamer.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup (such as Karo®)
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in 1/2 cup half-and-half, brown sugar, and corn syrup; bring to a boil. Boil, without stirring, until a small amount of syrup dropped into cold water forms a soft ball that flattens when removed from water and placed on a flat surface, about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining half-and-half and vanilla extract.

4101.title: Homemade Peppermint Coffee Creamer
4101.description: Pass on the seasonal, store-bought creamer and make your own at home in 15 minutes with just 5 ingredients.
instructions: Combine half-and-half and milk in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat until steaming, about 10 minutes; do not bring to a boil.
Stir in sugar. Heat until sugar has dissolved, about 2 more minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in vanilla and peppermint extracts.

4102.title: Vegan Sugar-Free Coconut Coffee Creamer
4102.description: This 5-ingredient, low-calorie, sugar-free homemade coffee creamer is easy and simple to make. And it's delicious too!
ingredients: 0.5 cup unsweetened coconut milk beverage (such as Silk®)
0.25 cup erythritol confectioners' sweetener (such as Swerve®)
2 tablespoons sugar-free coconut-flavored syrup (such as Torani®)
instructions: Combine coconut milk, coconut milk beverage, sweetener, coconut syrup, and coconut extract in a large Mason jar with a lid. Shake to combine ingredients.

4103.title: Homemade Vanilla Coffee Creamer
4103.description: If you're tired of all the plastic and processing of store-bought creamers, try making your own. You only need a handful of ingredients and the creamer will last about 10 days.
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) can fat-free sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Combine half-and-half and condensed milk in a small pot over medium-low heat; warm until steaming. Add cinnamon and vanilla extract. Heat for 5 more minutes, being careful not to boil.
Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Pour in a glass container and store in the refrigerator for up to 10 days.

4104.title: Peppermint Coffee Creamer
4104.description: With just 5 ingredients, you can make your own peppermint coffee creamer to enjoy during the holidays or any time of the year.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons stevia powder, or to taste
0.5 teaspoon peppermint extract, or more to taste
instructions: Combine milk, whipping cream, and stevia in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Heat until bubbles start to appear on the outer edges of the saucepan, 5 to 7 minutes; do not boil. Remove from the heat and stir in vanilla and peppermint extracts.

4105.title: Chocolate-Peppermint Coffee Creamer
4105.description: Whether you make this for your own pantry or as a gift for coffee drinking friends, you'll love this quick and easy recipe for holiday peppermint-flavored coffee creamer.
instructions: Combine coffee creamer, confectioners' sugar, and cocoa powder in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until blended. Pour peppermint extract in slowly, with the processor running, until evenly distributed.
Transfer into small jars and seal with lids. Attach instructions that say "Add 2 tablespoons to a cup of hot coffee, hot chocolate, or steamed milk."

4107.title: Homemade Vanilla-Flavored Coffee Creamer
4107.description: When you've run out of your powdered creamer and just can't function without it, try this homemade version and flavor it as you like.
instructions: Whisk condensed milk, nonfat milk, and vanilla extract together in a bowl (or use a blender) until well combined.

4108.title: Simple Syrup
4108.description: Learn how to make simple syrup with just 2 ingredients: sugar and water. Use as a sweetener in homemade cocktails and drinks, or as a glaze for cakes.
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a medium saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil, stirring, until sugar has dissolved. Allow to cool.
Pour into a clean jar and seal with a tight-fitting lid; store in the refrigerator for up to one month.

4109.title: Lavender Simple Syrup
4109.description: Make lavender syrup at home with fresh lavender blossoms steeped in simple syrup to create a sweet and aromatic flavoring for beverages and desserts.
instructions: Combine water, sugar, and lavender blossoms in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let syrup steep for about 30 minutes.
Pour syrup into a sterilized glass jar through a mesh strainer to remove blossoms; let cool.

4110.title: Mint Simple Syrup
4110.description: This mint simple syrup recipe uses fresh mint leaves, sugar, and water to create a refreshing syrup to use in cocktails, glazes, and frozen desserts.
instructions: Combine water, sugar, and mint leaves in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Simmer for 1 minute; remove from heat and let syrup steep, about 30 minutes.
Pour syrup into a sterilized glass jar through a mesh strainer to remove mint leaves; let cool.

4111.title: Rosemary Simple Syrup
4111.description: This rosemary simple syrup is made by steeping fresh rosemary leaves in sugar and water to create an herbal syrup for cocktails, sorbets, or cakes.
instructions: Combine water, sugar, and rosemary leaves in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Simmer for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let syrup steep for 30 minutes.
Pour syrup into a sterilized glass jar through a mesh strainer to remove rosemary leaves; let cool.

4112.title: Raspberry Syrup for Drinks
4112.description: This raspberry syrup recipe uses 3 simple ingredients to quickly make a sweet, fruit-forward flavor and color enhancer for teas, cocktails, or sodas.
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil in a small saucepan, stirring occasionally, until sugar is dissolved, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in raspberries, and mash with a potato masher or fork. Let steep for at least 1 hour.
Drain mixture through a fine mesh strainer, pressing raspberry pulp with a spatula to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard solids and store syrup in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

4113.title: Basil Simple Syrup
4113.description: This basil simple syrup is made with fresh basil leaves steeped in sugar water to create a sweet herbal base for summer cocktails and frozen treats.
instructions: Combine water, sugar, and basil leaves in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let syrup steep for 30 minutes.
Drain syrup through a mesh strainer into a sterilized glass jar; discard basil leaves. Let cool, then cover and store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

4114.title: Cinnamon Dolce Latte Syrup
4114.description: Make your own cinnamon dolce syrup during the holiday season to make a latte or apple cider extra special and rich.
instructions: Place a saucepan over medium-high heat; add water, brown sugar, and white sugar. Whisk until sugar dissolves, 3 to 5 minutes. Whisk cinnamon into sugar mixture until incorporated. Continue whisking mixture until just before boiling and syrup-consistency, 3 to 5 more minutes. Remove saucepan from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Cool syrup completely, at least 1 hour. Pour syrup into a glass container and seal; store in refrigerator for up to 10 days.

4115.title: Billy's Favorite Gingerbread Spiced Coffee Syrup
4115.description: This is a delightful spicy syrup that you can use to spice up coffee, tea, apple cider, you name it, it's all good!
ingredients: 1 (1 inch) piece fresh ginger root, sliced
1 cinnamon stick, broken into large pieces
instructions: In a saucepan over medium-high heat, combine water, sugar, and honey. Stir in ginger, cinnamon stick, cloves, allspice, peppercorns, and nutmeg; bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool for 20 minutes, then strain through a fine mesh sieve, or double layer cheesecloth.

4116.title: Peppermint Coffee Syrup
4116.description: This peppermint syrup is a snap to prepare and gives a minty kick to your holiday drinks. Try it with eggnog, hot cocoa, or caffe latte.
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium; stir 4 to 5 minutes. Add peppermint extract and remove from heat. Cool syrup for 5 minutes; pour into glass jar with tight-fitting lid.

4117.title: Hibiscus Syrup
4117.description: This ruby red hibiscus syrup has sweet, tart, and floral accents that will add extra zing and beautiful color to your homemade drinks and cocktails.
ingredients: 1 (1/2 inch) piece fresh ginger root, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring water, white sugar, hibiscus, brown sugar, ginger, and lemon zest to a boil. Reduce heat and let simmer until sugars dissolve and flowers soften, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and steep syrup until flavors combine, about 5 minutes.
Strain syrup into a container through a fine-mesh strainer, pressing solids with a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard solids.
Store syrup in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

4118.title: Coffee Syrup
4118.description: This coffee syrup is simple to make and so versatile---pour it over your pancakes, add it into a glass of milk or a cocktail, or mix it into your favorite baked goods recipe.
instructions: Combine sugar, water, and ground coffee in a pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a rolling boil, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool, about 30 minutes.
Place a fine sieve on top of a lidded container and pour syrup through to strain out any coffee grinds if desired. Cover with lid and store in the refrigerator.

4119.title: Habanero Simple Syrup
4119.description: Simple syrup infused with habanero peppers is a spicy and colorful addition to tequila-based cocktails or even lemonade.
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Slowly stir sugar into boiling water until sugar is dissolved, 2 to 3 minutes. Add habanero peppers to sugar-water mixture, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until syrup is thickened and pepper has slightly colored the syrup, about 15 minutes.
Remove saucepan from heat and let syrup cool, about 1 hour. Remove peppers from syrup and store syrup in a glass jar.

4120.title: Brandy Simple Syrup
4120.description: Simple Syrup is brushed on cakes for added moisture and flavor. This one can be flavored with brandy or rum.
instructions: In a saucepan, combine water, sugar and lemon zest. Bring mixture to a boil and continue boiling for 5 minutes. Strain into a sealable container, removing the lemon zest. Allow to cool, then cover and store in refrigerator.
When ready to use, mix in brandy. Brush onto cake layers before frosting.

4121.title: Lemon Verbena Simple Syrup
4121.description: This intensely fragrant lemon verbena simple syrup combines citrus, floral, and woody notes into a flavor booster for drinks and sorbets.
instructions: Combine water, sugar, and lemon verbena leaves in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Simmer for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let syrup steep, about 30 minutes.
Pour syrup into a sterilized glass jar through a mesh strainer to remove lemon verbena leaves; let cool. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

4122.title: Simple Syrup with Truvia® Natural Sweetener
4122.description: Simple syrup sweetened with Truvia® natural sweetener will provide a savings of 100 calories or 26 grams of sugar per serving compared to the sugar-sweetened version.
instructions: Add Truvia® natural sweetener to 1/2 cup of warm water.
Shake or blend until dissolved completely.
Store refrigerated. For best results, use within a day of making.

4123.title: Pumpkin Spice Coffee Syrup
4123.description: Make your own pumpkin spice syrup with this copycat recipe using pumpkin pie filling, pumpkin pie spice, and other fall spices.
instructions: Mix water and sugar together in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring regularly, until sugar is completely dissolved completely, about 5 minutes.

Stir 6 tablespoons pumpkin pie filling, cinnamon sticks, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, vanilla, and pumpkin pie spice into the sugar syrup; bring to a simmer. Cook until mixture is well spiced, 8 to 10 minutes.
Strain mixture through a sheet of cheesecloth into a bowl. Return liquid to the saucepan over low heat.
Stir condensed milk and remaining 2 tablespoons pumpkin pie filling into the spiced syrup. Cook, stirring regularly, until pumpkin dissolves into the liquid, about 5 minutes.

4124.title: Vanilla Honey Simple Syrup
4124.description: This simple recipe will make a quick honey syrup for pancakes from just honey, milk, vanilla extract, and butter.
instructions: Combine milk and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Heat honey and butter together in a microwave-safe bowl in the microwave for 30 seconds; stir into milk mixture.
Allow to cool completely before use. Chill in the refrigerator if too hot.

4125.title: Homemade Grenadine
4125.description: It's extremely easy to make homemade grenadine. It's a two-ingredient operation. Your cocktails will thank you.
instructions: Pour sugar and pomegranate juice into a sauce pan and warm over low heat, whisking continuously until the sugar dissolves. Cool, pour into a bottle or jar, and store sealed in the refrigerator.

4126.title: Ginger Syrup
4126.description: Fresh ginger, lemon juice, and peppercorns give a spicy change to regular simple syrup. Try it in your next cocktail!
ingredients: 0.25 cup coarsely chopped unpeeled fresh ginger
instructions: Mix together water, sugar, ginger, lemon juice, and peppercorns in a saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until sugar dissolves. Let cool, 15 to 30 minutes.
Strain syrup through a fine-mesh sieve; discard solids. Chill, covered, for up to 2 weeks.

4127.title: Blueberry-Lavender Simple Syrup
4127.description: Blueberries and dried lavender buds are used to infused this simple syrup that tastes great as an addition to lemonade, cocktails, or even coffee drinks.
instructions: Combine water, blueberries, sugar, and honey in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce temperature to a light simmer. Add in lavender, stir to combine, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Let mixture cool for 10 minutes, then strain into a jar using a fine mesh strainer. Use the back of a spoon to mash the berries through the strainer to release juices. Refrigerate for up to 1 month.

4128.title: Pumpkin Spice Syrup
4128.description: Serve this hot pumpkin spice syrup over pumpkin pancakes or your favorite flapjacks.
instructions: Bring corn syrup, water, brown sugar, and butter to a rolling boil. Whisk pumpkin, ginger, nutmeg, allspice, and cinnamon into corn syrup mixture; cook, stirring constantly, until flavors blend, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve hot.

4129.title: Cranberry Simple Syrup
4129.description: Use this simple syrup any time you want to infuse cranberry flavor into a festive holiday cocktail, cider, or punch.
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water in a saucepan over medium heat. Add cranberries and simmer on low until cranberries have softened but before they begin to pop, about 15 minutes. Cool, strain, and refrigerate.

4130.title: Pomegranate Grenadine
4130.description: Homemade grenadine made with pomegranate juice is naturally colored and adds a nice brightness and flavor to your favorite drinks.
instructions: Combine 3 cups pomegranate juice and sugar together in a saucepan; heat to 244 degrees F (118 degrees C) or until a small amount of mixture dropped into cold water forms a firm ball. Remove saucepan from heat and cover with a lid; let cool until pan is cool enough to touch. Stir remaining 1 cup pomegranate juice into mixture. Refrigerate.

4131.title: Chocolate Caramel Latte Syrup
4131.description: Foolproof chocolate caramel syrup makes a wonderful exciting latte! Better than you know who!
instructions: In a saucepan, stir together the cream, corn syrup, white sugar, brown sugar and salt. Bring to a rolling boil over medium-high heat and continue to boil until it becomes thick and deep brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the chocolate and butter until smooth.

4132.title: Overnight Matzo Bake
4132.description: This Passover-friendly matzo bake with raisins, apricots, apples, and sour cream, is chilled overnight for easy prep.
instructions: Lightly coat a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Set aside.

Break matzo sheets into bite-sized pieces. Whisk together eggs, milk, sugar, sour cream, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg in a large bowl. Stir in raisins, apricots, apples, and matzo pieces. Transfer to the prepared baking dish, smoothing into an even layer. Cover with aluminum foil and transfer to a refrigerator to chill for 8 hours, or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Remove baking dish from the refrigerator and uncover.
Bake in the preheated oven until puffed and set, 40 to 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and let sit at room temperature for at least 15 minutes.

4134.title: Easy French Toast Casserole
4134.description: This French toast casserole is an easy overnight option for a weekend or holiday breakfast. Do all the work the night before and bake it the next morning.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) loaf crusty French bread, cut into bite-sized pieces, or more as needed
1 tablespoon brown sugar, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste
instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Make the French toast: Stir brown sugar and butter together in a saucepan over medium-low heat until butter is melted and sugar has dissolved, 2 to 4 minutes.
Pour butter-brown sugar mixture into the prepared baking dish. Scatter French bread pieces over top in a 1 1/2- to 2-inch layer.

Whisk milk, eggs, and vanilla together in a bowl until well combined. Pour over bread pieces, then press bread down with a spatula so the bread absorbs the liquid. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate, 8 hours to overnight.
When ready to bake, remove French toast from the refrigerator and discard plastic wrap. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Make topping: Mix brown sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl. Sprinkle over the French toast.
Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is browned and bubbling, about 30 minutes, covering with aluminum foil at any point if the top is browning too much.
To serve, cut into squares and invert onto serving plates.

4135.title: Ham and Cheese Croissant Casserole
4135.description: Croissants, ham and Swiss cheese sandwiches, baked casserole-style, make a perfect weekend breakfast or casual lunch.
instructions: Whisk together butter, Dijon, onion, maple syrup, and Worcestershire in a small bowl. Evenly spread butter mixture on the cut sides of the croissants.
Place the croissant bottom halves on a cutting board; layer on ham, folding to fit the croissant. Sprinkle cheese evenly among the croissants; place top halves on each.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Spray a casserole dish or a cast iron skillet large enough to accommodate croissants with cooking spray. Place croissants in a single layer in the prepared pan.

Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a medium bowl, and pour evenly over the croissants. Sprinkle each croissant with bagel seasoning. Set the dish aside for about 10 minutes.

Bake in the preheated oven until croissants are golden brown and egg mixture is perfectly set, 32 to 38 minutes. Check casserole at about 25 minutes, and if croissants are getting very browned, cover with foil. Serve hot.

4136.title: Overnight Breakfast Bake with Ham, Cheese, and Croissants
4136.description: This overnight breakfast bake with ham, cheese, and croissants will surely be a hit with the family.
instructions: Spray an 8x8-inch baking pan with cooking spray.
Cut croissants into 1 inch cubes (about 4 cups, loosely packed) and spread out on the bottom of the prepared pan. Sprinkle evenly with cheese and ham.
Combine eggs, milk, sour cream, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Beat the mixture until well blended using a wire whisk or an egg beater.
Pour egg mixture evenly over the top of the croissants, cheese, and ham.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil and place in the refrigerator for 8 hours.
When ready to bake, set the dish out of the refrigerator on the counter, Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Uncover casserole, place in the center of the preheated oven, and bake until the casserole is set, and a knife inserted into the middle of the casserole comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes.
Cut into serving pieces and garnish with chopped green onions.

4137.title: Super Easy Egg Casserole
4137.description: Baked egg casserole that's super easy to make and delicious. Beaten eggs are baked with Cheddar cheese, bell pepper, bacon, green onions, and garlic.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon minced garlic, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Mix eggs, cheese, bacon, bread, red bell pepper, green onion, milk, garlic, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until well-combined; pour into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until eggs are set, about 20 to 25 minutes.

4138.title: Leftover Ham -n- Potato Casserole
4138.description: This easy, cheesy ham and potato casserole is the perfect choice for a post-holiday breakfast or an easy weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 6 small potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
0.667 pound leftover cooked ham, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 10 to 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

When the potatoes are almost finished, melt 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add ham and onion; cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Drain potatoes; add to the ham mixture and stir to combine. Transfer to the prepared baking dish.
Melt remaining 4 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and stir until the mixture becomes paste-like and light golden brown, about 5 minutes.

Gradually whisk milk into the flour mixture; season with salt and black pepper. Continue cooking and stirring until thickened, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in Cheddar cheese until melted.
Pour cheese sauce over ham and potatoes. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until sauce is bubbly and browned, 25 to 30 minutes.

4139.title: Best Breakfast Casserole (Hash Browns & Eggs)
4139.description: This breakfast casserole with hash browns also features eggs, pork sausage, and Cheddar cheese for a classic brunch dish with all your favorites.
ingredients: 1 (2 pound) package frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease an 8-inch square pan; add hash brown potatoes and arrange in an even layer.
Place sausage and onion in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until the sausage is browned and crumbled, about 10 minutes; drain.

Meanwhile, whisk eggs, milk, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl until well combined; pour over the potatoes and sprinkle with 1/2 of the Cheddar cheese. Add sausage mixture on top and sprinkle with remaining Cheddar. Cover with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove foil; return casserole to the oven and bake until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, about 10 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

4140.title: Overnight Blueberry French Toast
4140.description: This blueberry French toast casserole is filled with fresh berries and covered with blueberry sauce for a scrumptious holiday breakfast or brunch.
ingredients: 12 slices day-old bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Prepare casserole: Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange 1/2 of the bread cubes in the dish and top with cream cheese cubes. Sprinkle blueberries over the cream cheese, then top with remaining bread cubes.
Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla extract, and syrup together in a large bowl until well-combined; pour over the bread cubes. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Remove casserole from the refrigerator about 30 minutes before baking. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake casserole in the preheated oven, covered, for 30 minutes. Uncover, and continue baking until center is firm and surface is lightly browned, about 25 to 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, prepare blueberry sauce: Mix sugar, water, and cornstarch together in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in blueberries, reduce heat to low, and simmer until all the blueberries burst, about 10 minutes. Stir in butter.
Serve portions of casserole on plates and pour warm syrup over top.

4141.title: Restaurant-Style Hashbrown Casserole
4141.description: This quick and easy hashbrown casserole is made with frozen hashbrown potatoes, chopped onions, a can of cream of chicken soup, and Cheddar cheese.
ingredients: 1 (2 pound) package frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x13-inch dish with nonstick cooking spray.
Gently mix potatoes, soup, cheese, onion, butter, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Pour into the prepared dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until browned, about 1 hour.

4142.title: Christmas Breakfast Sausage Casserole
4142.description: This cheesy breakfast sausage casserole is easy to prep, chill overnight, and bake on Christmas morning for a comforting dish everyone will enjoy!
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, toasted and cut into cubes
instructions: Crumble sausage into a medium skillet. Cook over medium heat until evenly brown; drain.
In a medium bowl, mix together mustard powder, salt, eggs and milk. Add the sausage, bread cubes, and cheese, and stir to coat evenly.
Pour into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator for 8 hours, or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Cover, and bake 45 to 60 minutes.
Uncover, and reduce temperature to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until set

4143.title: Cheesy Amish Breakfast Casserole
4143.description: This Amish breakfast casserole has bacon, onion, hash browns, eggs, and 3 types of cheese baked into a hearty, comforting dish, perfect for a crowd.
ingredients: 4 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir bacon and onion until bacon is evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain.
Transfer bacon and onion to a large bowl. Stir in eggs, potatoes, Cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, and Swiss cheese. Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until eggs are set and cheese is melted, 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

4144.title: Sausage Casserole
4144.description: This sausage casserole features shredded potatoes and onions baked with eggs, sausage, cottage cheese, and Cheddar for a family-favorite breakfast.
ingredients: 3 cups shredded potatoes, drained and pressed
1 (16 ounce) container small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Heat a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Cook sausage in the hot skillet until evenly browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.

Stir together shredded potatoes and butter in the prepared baking dish; lightly press mixture into the bottom and sides of the dish. Mix together sausage, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese, onion, and eggs in a bowl. Pour over potato mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of casserole comes out clean, about 1 hour. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

4145.title: Cheesy Ham and Hash Brown Casserole
4145.description: This ham and hash brown casserole is a family-friendly dish made with hash brown potatoes and ham in a creamy sauce for a yummy, lazy day breakfast.
ingredients: 1 (32 ounce) package frozen hash brown potatoes
2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed cream of potato soup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Mix together hash browns, condensed soup, sour cream, Cheddar cheese, and ham in a bowl until well combined. Spread evenly into the prepared dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly brown, about 1 hour.

4146.title: Jimmy Dean Breakfast Casserole
4146.description: This breakfast casserole with bread, sausage, eggs, cheese, tomatoes, mushrooms, and onion is a hearty, all-in-one breakfast dish that's easy to make.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package Regular Flavor Jimmy Dean Pork Sausage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until thoroughly cooked and no longer pink, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Combine eggs, milk, dry mustard, and salt in a large bowl; stir well.

Distribute 1/2 of the bread evenly into the prepared dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sausage, 1/2 of the cheese, 1/2 of the tomato, 1/2 of the mushroom, 1/2 of the green onion, and 1/2 of the black pepper. Repeat layers one more time. Pour egg mixture evenly over casserole.
Bake uncovered until eggs are set, 55 to 60 minutes. Tent with foil if the top begins to brown too quickly.

4147.title: French Toast Casserole
4147.description: Bake this easy French toast casserole for a delicious breakfast treat that everyone will love. Super quick to make with simple ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease an 8x8-inch baking pan.

Line the bottom of the prepared pan with bread cubes. Beat milk, eggs, 2 tablespoons sugar, salt, and vanilla together in a large bowl until well combined; pour over bread cubes and stir to coat. Dot with margarine; let stand for 15 minutes.
Combine remaining 2 tablespoons sugar with cinnamon; sprinkle over top of casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden, about 45 to 50 minutes.

4148.title: Southern Grits Casserole
4148.description: This grits casserole made with sausage, grits, and Cheddar cheese is ready in an hour and can be kept warm in a slow cooker at your breakfast buffet.
ingredients: 0.5 cup butter, cut into pieces, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a large baking dish.

Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan; stir in grits. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer until liquid has been absorbed, about 5 minutes. Mix in 2 cups Cheddar cheese and 1/2 of the butter until melted.
Cook sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and add to grits mixture.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a bowl. Pour into the skillet used to cook the sausage. Lightly scramble eggs over medium-low heat, then mix into grits mixture.
Pour grits mixture into the prepared baking dish. Dot with remaining butter, sprinkle with remaining 1 cup Cheddar, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

4149.title: Sausage and Egg Casserole
4149.description: This sausage and egg casserole is the perfect combination of eggs, sausage, bread, and cheese. Everyone loves this tender and delicious recipe.
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir in sausage. Cook and stir until sausage is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Drain and discard any excess grease.

Beat eggs in a large bowl; stir in milk, salt, and mustard. Fold bread cubes, Cheddar cheese, and sausage into the egg mixture. Pour into a lightly greased 7x11-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate, 8 hours to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Remove casserole from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, about 40 minutes.

4150.title: Eggs Benedict Casserole
4150.description: This eggs Benedict casserole delivers all the flavors of the popular breakfast dish with an easy overnight recipe that's great for when guests come.
ingredients: 0.75 pound Canadian bacon, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Prepare casserole: Whisk together milk, eggs, green onions, onion powder, and salt in a large bowl until well combined. Set aside.

Layer 1/2 of the Canadian bacon in the prepared baking dish. Cover with English muffins. Top with remaining Canadian bacon, then pour egg mixture over everything. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate, 8 hours to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Remove plastic wrap from the baking dish. Sprinkle casserole with paprika and cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until eggs are nearly set, about 30 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking until eggs are completely set, about 15 minutes more.

When casserole is almost finished baking, make sauce: Whisk together remaining milk and Hollandaise sauce mix in a saucepan over medium heat. Add margarine; cook, stirring frequently, until boiling. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 1 minute.
Slice casserole into 10 pieces. Drizzle warm sauce over each piece.

4151.title: Christmas Brunch Casserole
4151.description: This Christmas breakfast casserole with hash browns is made the night before and baked the next morning for an early morning meal or a tasty brunch.
ingredients: 4 cups frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate and crumble when cool enough to handle. Drain grease from the skillet.
Cook onions and mushrooms in the residual grease in the skillet until onions are translucent and mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes.

Grease a 9x13-inch casserole dish with 1 tablespoon of butter. Place potatoes into the bottom of the dish; sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic salt. Top with crumbled bacon, then add onions and mushrooms.
Whisk milk, eggs, and parsley together in a mixing bowl; pour over casserole and top with Cheddar. Cover and refrigerate, 8 hours to overnight.
When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven until set, about 1 hour.

4153.title: Farmer's Casserole
4153.description: A farmer's casserole is a tasty, make-ahead breakfast dish with ham, eggs, hash browns, and spicy pepper Jack cheese that the whole family will love!
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray.
Arrange hash brown potatoes evenly in the bottom of the prepared dish. Sprinkle with pepper Jack cheese, then ham, and finally green onions.
Whisk evaporated milk, eggs, pepper, and salt together in a medium bowl; pour over layers in the baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

4154.title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
4154.description: Cream of mushroom soup, Cheddar cheese, and breakfast sausage are the cornerstone of this hearty breakfast casserole.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir the sausage in the hot skillet until crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Drain and discard any excess grease. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread the bread cubes into the prepared dish; sprinkle the browned sausage and Cheddar cheese overtop.

Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl until smooth; add the salt, mustard powder, and 2 cups of milk and whisk until evenly blended. Pour the egg mixture over the bread cubes. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat an oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Whisk together the cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup milk; pour over the casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven until firm and golden brown, about 1 1/2 hours.

4155.title: Cheesy Bacon, Sausage, and Egg Hash Brown Skillet
4155.description: This hash brown skillet features fluffy eggs and melted Cheddar cheese topped with crisp bacon pieces and sausage slices for a satisfying breakfast.
ingredients: 1 link smoked pineapple-bacon chicken sausage, cut into slices
2.5 cups frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
